records.key: (bool) Adjust cell masks using the nucleus/pathogen masks.
records.source: (bool) Adjust cell masks using the nucleus/pathogen masks.
records.translation: (bool) Aðlaga frumugrímur með kjarna-/sýklagrímunum.

records.key: (bool) Zero every pixel below the background intensity in the chosen object's channel before segmentation. Applies to the object selected above — with 'cell + nucleus' chosen, each channel uses its own background.
records.source: (bool) Zero every pixel below the background intensity in the chosen object's channel before segmentation. Applies to the object selected above — with 'cell + nucleus' chosen, each channel uses its own background.
records.translation: (bool) Setja hvern pixil undir bakgrunnsstyrk á núll í rás valins hlutar fyrir hlutun. Á við um hlutinn sem valinn er hér að ofan — þegar 'cell + nucleus' er valið notar hver rás sinn eigin bakgrunn.

records.key: (float) Cellpose cell-probability threshold — lower keeps more (dimmer) objects.
records.source: (float) Cellpose cell-probability threshold — lower keeps more (dimmer) objects.
records.translation: (float) Þröskuldur frumulíkinda í Cellpose — lægra gildi heldur fleiri (daufari) hlutum.

records.key: (float) Cellpose cell-probability threshold.
records.source: (float) Cellpose cell-probability threshold.
records.translation: (float) Þröskuldur frumulíkinda í Cellpose.

records.key: (float) Cellpose flow threshold — higher keeps more masks.
records.source: (float) Cellpose flow threshold — higher keeps more masks.
records.translation: (float) Flæðisþröskuldur Cellpose — hærra gildi heldur fleiri grímum.

records.key: (float) Cellpose flow threshold.
records.source: (float) Cellpose flow threshold.
records.translation: (float) Flæðisþröskuldur Cellpose.

records.key: (float) Nominal overlap between neighbours, as a fraction of the tile. Only seeds the search — registration corrects it.
records.source: (float) Nominal overlap between neighbours, as a fraction of the tile. Only seeds the search — registration corrects it.
records.translation: (float) Áætluð skörun milli nágranna, sem hlutfall af reitnum. Þetta er aðeins upphafsgildi leitarinnar — samstillingin leiðréttir það.

records.key: (float) straightness_threshold — tracks at or above this are flagged as stage-drift / artefact candidates.
records.source: (float) straightness_threshold — tracks at or above this are flagged as stage-drift / artefact candidates.
records.translation: (float) straightness_threshold — ferlar við eða yfir þessu gildi eru merktir sem mögulegt rek smásjárborðs eða gervimerki.

records.key: (int) Image channel index segmented for the tracked object.
records.source: (int) Image channel index segmented for the tracked object.
records.translation: (int) Vísir myndrásarinnar sem er hlutuð fyrir rakta hlutinn.

records.key: (int) Image channel index used for cell segmentation.
records.source: (int) Image channel index used for cell segmentation.
records.translation: (int) Vísir myndrásar sem notuð er við hlutun frumna.

records.key: (int) Image channel index used for nucleus segmentation.
records.source: (int) Image channel index used for nucleus segmentation.
records.translation: (int) Vísir myndrásar sem notuð er við hlutun kjarna.

records.key: (int) Image channel index used for organelle segmentation.
records.source: (int) Image channel index used for organelle segmentation.
records.translation: (int) Vísir myndrásar sem notuð er við hlutun frumulíffæra.

records.key: (int) Image channel index used for pathogen segmentation.
records.source: (int) Image channel index used for pathogen segmentation.
records.translation: (int) Vísir myndrásar sem notuð er við hlutun sýkla.

records.key: (int) Pixels below this intensity are set to 0 in the chosen object's channel when 'Remove background' is on. Everything above it is left where it is.
records.source: (int) Pixels below this intensity are set to 0 in the chosen object's channel when 'Remove background' is on. Everything above it is left where it is.
records.translation: (int) Pixlar undir þessum styrk eru settir á 0 í rás valins hlutar þegar kveikt er á 'Remove background'. Allt fyrir ofan hann er látið óbreytt.

records.key: (int) Plane index of the pathogen mask, used to split tracks by infection state. 'none' treats every track as uninfected.
records.source: (int) Plane index of the pathogen mask, used to split tracks by infection state. 'none' treats every track as uninfected.
records.translation: (int) Vísir plans sýklagrímunnar, notaður til að skipta ferlum eftir sýkingarstöðu. 'none' meðhöndlar alla ferla sem ósýkta.

records.key: (int) Signal-to-noise ratio used to set the normalisation intensity range for the chosen object's channel.
records.source: (int) Signal-to-noise ratio used to set the normalisation intensity range for the chosen object's channel.
records.translation: (int) Hlutfall merkis og suðs sem notað er til að ákvarða styrkbil stöðlunar fyrir rás valins hlutar.

records.key: (int) The channel registration is measured on. Every channel then shares that one solution — aligning channels independently would shear the composite.
records.source: (int) The channel registration is measured on. Every channel then shares that one solution — aligning channels independently would shear the composite.
records.translation: (int) Rásin sem samstillingin er mæld á. Allar rásir deila síðan þeirri einu lausn — ef rásir væru samstilltar hver í sínu lagi myndi samsetta myndin skekkjast.

records.key: (int) Wells with fewer objects than this are dropped. They are drawn blank, never as zero, and the number dropped is reported.
records.source: (int) Wells with fewer objects than this are dropped. They are drawn blank, never as zero, and the number dropped is reported.
records.translation: (int) Brunnum með færri hluti en þetta er sleppt. Þeir eru teiknaðir auðir, aldrei sem núll, og fjöldi þeirra sem sleppt er er tilkynntur.

records.key: (str) 'cpsam', or a path to a custom Cellpose checkpoint. Every pre-SAM name (cyto, cyto2, cyto3, nuclei…) resolves to cpsam.
records.source: (str) 'cpsam', or a path to a custom Cellpose checkpoint. Every pre-SAM name (cyto, cyto2, cyto3, nuclei…) resolves to cpsam.
records.translation: (str) 'cpsam', eða slóð að sérsniðnum Cellpose-vistunarpunkti. Öll heiti frá því fyrir SAM (cyto, cyto2, cyto3, nuclei…) vísa á cpsam.

records.key: (str) How the field sequence maps onto the grid. A serpentine acquisition needs snake-row.
records.source: (str) How the field sequence maps onto the grid. A serpentine acquisition needs snake-row.
records.translation: (str) Hvernig röð sjónsviða varpast á hnitanetið. Myndataka í slöngumynstri (serpentine) þarf snake-row.

records.key: (str) How the objects in a well are collapsed to one number. 'median' limits the influence of outlying objects; 'count' plots objects per well and ignores the measurement.
records.source: (str) How the objects in a well are collapsed to one number. 'median' limits the influence of outlying objects; 'count' plots objects per well and ignores the measurement.
records.translation: (str) Hvernig hlutum í brunni er steypt saman í eina tölu. 'median' takmarkar áhrif frávikshluta; 'count' teiknar fjölda hluta á brunn og hunsar mælinguna.

records.key: (str) Numeric column aggregated per well and drawn as colour.
records.source: (str) Numeric column aggregated per well and drawn as colour.
records.translation: (str) Tölulegur dálkur sem er tekinn saman á brunn og teiknaður sem litur.

records.key: (str) Object(s) to segment. 'cell + nucleus' runs both passes.
records.source: (str) Object(s) to segment. 'cell + nucleus' runs both passes.
records.translation: (str) Hlutur eða hlutir til hlutunar. 'cell + nucleus' keyrir báðar umferðir.

records.key: (str) The 'Robust' range clips colours to the 2nd–98th percentile so one extreme well cannot flatten the plate.
records.source: (str) The 'Robust' range clips colours to the 2nd–98th percentile so one extreme well cannot flatten the plate.
records.translation: (str) 'Robust'-bilið klippir liti við 2.–98. hundraðshlutamark svo einn öfgabrunnur geti ekki flatt út litakvarða plötunnar.

records.key: 2D gates on a scatter, 3D in a volume, xD on more measurements than can be drawn at once.
records.source: 2D gates on a scatter, 3D in a volume, xD on more measurements than can be drawn at once.
records.translation: 2D-valmörk á dreifiriti, 3D í rúmmáli, xD á fleiri mælingum en hægt er að teikna í einu.

records.key:
Filename metadata regex
Named groups map onto spaCR's downstream fields — most importantly plateID, wellID, fieldID, and chanID.
records.source:
Filename metadata regex
Named groups map onto spaCR's downstream fields — most importantly plateID, wellID, fieldID, and chanID.
records.translation:
Reglusegð fyrir lýsigögn í skráarheitum
Nefndir hópar varpast á reiti sem spaCR notar síðar í ferlinu — mikilvægastir eru plateID, wellID, fieldID og chanID.

records.key: ✓ All required fields captured.
records.source: ✓ All required fields captured.
records.translation: ✓ Allir nauðsynlegir reitir fundust.

records.key: A NaN here is usually meaningful: a pathogen feature is NaN for a cell with no pathogen. Dropping the feature keeps every object; dropping the rows keeps every feature but changes which population you are looking at.
records.source: A NaN here is usually meaningful: a pathogen feature is NaN for a cell with no pathogen. Dropping the feature keeps every object; dropping the rows keeps every feature but changes which population you are looking at.
records.translation: NaN hér hefur yfirleitt merkingu: sýkilseiginleiki er NaN fyrir frumu sem hefur engan sýkil. Ef eiginleikanum er sleppt haldast allir hlutir; ef röðunum er sleppt haldast allir eiginleikar en það breytir því hvaða þýði þú ert að skoða.

records.key: A flood that reaches a bright seam — debris, a saturated membrane, a well rim — walks out along it and takes the field. This reads the flood's width outward from the click and cuts it where it suddenly and persistently widens. It does nothing to a flood that did not run away.
records.source: A flood that reaches a bright seam — debris, a saturated membrane, a well rim — walks out along it and takes the field. This reads the flood's width outward from the click and cuts it where it suddenly and persistently widens. It does nothing to a flood that did not run away.
records.translation: Flóðfylling sem nær björtum saumi — rusli, mettaðri himnu, brún brunns — rennur út eftir honum og tekur yfir sjónsviðið. Þetta les breidd flóðfyllingarinnar út frá smellinum og sker hana þar sem hún breikkar skyndilega og varanlega. Þetta hefur engin áhrif á flóðfyllingu sem hljóp ekki út.

records.key: A gate is not a gate until it is named — the name is what makes it re-appliable and what the hierarchy is read by:
records.source: A gate is not a gate until it is named — the name is what makes it re-appliable and what the hierarchy is read by:
records.translation: Valmörk eru ekki valmörk fyrr en þau hafa fengið heiti — heitið gerir kleift að beita þeim aftur og eftir því er stigveldið lesið:

records.key: A gene's fraction in a well is the sum of its guide fractions, matching the aggregation used by regression. Gene-level sweep results therefore use the same guide aggregation as the fitted gene effect.
records.source: A gene's fraction in a well is the sum of its guide fractions, matching the aggregation used by regression. Gene-level sweep results therefore use the same guide aggregation as the fitted gene effect.
records.translation: Hlutfall gens í brunni er summa hlutfalla leiðara þess, sem samsvarar samantektinni sem aðhvarfið notar. Niðurstöður skönnunar á genastigi nota því sömu samantekt leiðara og metin genaáhrif.

records.key: A generalised linear model whose FAMILY AND LINK are picked from the response by pick_glm_family_and_link rather than assumed, and the run prints the pair it chose. Where the family comes out Poisson, log(cell_count) enters as an offset, so the coefficients are effects on a per-cell rate.
records.source: A generalised linear model whose FAMILY AND LINK are picked from the response by pick_glm_family_and_link rather than assumed, and the run prints the pair it chose. Where the family comes out Poisson, log(cell_count) enters as an offset, so the coefficients are effects on a per-cell rate.
records.translation: Almennt línulegt líkan þar sem DREIFINGARFJÖLSKYLDA OG TENGIFALL eru valin út frá svöruninni með pick_glm_family_and_link frekar en gefin fyrir fram, og keyrslan prentar parið sem var valið. Þegar fjölskyldan verður Poisson fer log(cell_count) inn sem hliðrun (offset), svo stuðlarnir eru áhrif á tíðni á hverja frumu.

records.key: A linear support-vector fit (hinge loss) on the response BINARISED at hinge_threshold, so it asks which guides SEPARATE high wells from low wells rather than how far they move the score. It has no likelihood: the p-values are bootstrap Wald values over hinge_n_boot resamples, not a likelihood-ratio test.
records.source: A linear support-vector fit (hinge loss) on the response BINARISED at hinge_threshold, so it asks which guides SEPARATE high wells from low wells rather than how far they move the score. It has no likelihood: the p-values are bootstrap Wald values over hinge_n_boot resamples, not a likelihood-ratio test.
records.translation: Línuleg stoðvigramátun (hinge-tap) á svörunina TVÍGILDAÐA við hinge_threshold, svo hún spyr hvaða leiðarar SKILJA háa brunna frá lágum brunnum frekar en hve mikið þeir hreyfa skorið. Hún hefur ekkert sennileikafall: p-gildin eru bootstrap Wald-gildi yfir hinge_n_boot endurúrtök, ekki sennileikahlutfallspróf.

records.key: A measurements.db, or a CSV of per-well values
records.source: A measurements.db, or a CSV of per-well values
records.translation: measurements.db, eða CSV-skrá með gildum á brunn

records.key: A sparse Poisson GLM with a horseshoe prior -- spaCRPower's power-analysis model -- with offset(log(cell_count)). The prior shrinks the bulk of the guides hard toward zero while leaving a genuinely large effect close to untouched, which suits a screen where most guides are expected to do nothing.
records.source: A sparse Poisson GLM with a horseshoe prior -- spaCRPower's power-analysis model -- with offset(log(cell_count)). The prior shrinks the bulk of the guides hard toward zero while leaving a genuinely large effect close to untouched, which suits a screen where most guides are expected to do nothing.
records.translation: Strjált Poisson GLM með horseshoe-fyrirframdreifingu -- aflgreiningarlíkan spaCRPower -- með offset(log(cell_count)). Fyrirframdreifingin dregur megnið af leiðurunum fast að núlli en lætur raunveruleg stór áhrif nánast ósnert, sem hentar skimun þar sem búist er við að flestir leiðarar geri ekkert.

records.key: A trimmed runaway ends in a straight line, which no cell has. These two put the boundary back on the image: one re-floods at a tolerance that does not escape, the other lets the edge settle onto the nearest intensity gradient.
records.source: A trimmed runaway ends in a straight line, which no cell has. These two put the boundary back on the image: one re-floods at a tolerance that does not escape, the other lets the edge settle onto the nearest intensity gradient.
records.translation: Snyrt flóðfylling sem hljóp út endar í beinni línu, sem engin fruma hefur. Þessar tvær aðgerðir setja mörkin aftur á myndina: önnur flóðfyllir aftur með þoli sem sleppur ekki út, hin lætur brúnina setjast á næsta styrkhalla.

records.key: Abandon the crop pass in flight; its result is dropped.
records.source: Abandon the crop pass in flight; its result is dropped.
records.translation: Hætta við myndskurðarumferðina sem er í gangi; niðurstöðu hennar er hent.

records.key: Absolute directory on the execution host. Small settings and log files are stored below <workdir>/spacr-jobs/.
records.source: Absolute directory on the execution host. Small settings and log files are stored below <workdir>/spacr-jobs/.
records.translation: Algild slóð möppu á hýsitölvunni sem keyrir verkið. Litlar stillinga- og annálsskrár eru vistaðar undir <workdir>/spacr-jobs/.

records.key: Add a label mask layer from a file
records.source: Add a label mask layer from a file
records.translation: Bæta við merkjagrímulagi úr skrá

records.key: Add another group. Each group is one inner list — one class, one condition, one crop mode.
records.source: Add another group. Each group is one inner list — one class, one condition, one crop mode.
records.translation: Bæta við öðrum hópi. Hver hópur er einn innri listi — einn flokkur, eitt skilyrði, einn myndskurðarhamur.

records.key: Add at least one mask folder. A spaCR project without object masks has nothing to measure and nothing to crop.
records.source: Add at least one mask folder. A spaCR project without object masks has nothing to measure and nothing to crop.
records.translation: Bættu við að minnsta kosti einni grímumöppu. spaCR-verkefni án hlutgríma hefur ekkert til að mæla og ekkert til að skera út.

records.key: Adding names for several image channels or image layers keeps the same number of rows.
records.source: Adding names for several image channels or image layers keeps the same number of rows.
records.translation: Ef nöfnum er bætt við fyrir margar myndrásir eða myndlög helst fjöldi raða óbreyttur.

records.key: Adds a table to the working set. Picking nucleus does not switch to nucleus — it merges nucleus measurements alongside the ones already loaded, so a gate can put a cell measurement on one axis and a nuclear one on another.
records.source: Adds a table to the working set. Picking nucleus does not switch to nucleus — it merges nucleus measurements alongside the ones already loaded, so a gate can put a cell measurement on one axis and a nuclear one on another.
records.translation: Bætir töflu við vinnusafnið. Að velja nucleus skiptir ekki yfir í nucleus — það sameinar kjarnamælingar við þær sem þegar eru hlaðnar, svo valmörk geta sett frumumælingu á einn ás og kjarnamælingu á annan.

records.key: Any encoder timm can resolve. The model-zoo entry records which one, with the checksum of its weights: two runs' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless the backbone, the weights and the channel policy all match.
records.source: Any encoder timm can resolve. The model-zoo entry records which one, with the checksum of its weights: two runs' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless the backbone, the weights and the channel policy all match.
records.translation: Hvaða kóðari sem timm getur fundið. Færslan í líkanaskránni skráir hver þeirra það er, ásamt gátsummu vægjanna: vídd 17 í tveimur keyrslum er sama talan en ekki sami hluturinn nema grunnnetið, vægin og rásareglan passi öll saman.

records.key: Any measurement as a plate heatmap, with the edge-effect test beside it. The outer ring of a plate evaporates faster than the interior — a hit sitting in it is more likely to be an artefact than biology. Read-only: the database is opened with mode=ro.
records.source: Any measurement as a plate heatmap, with the edge-effect test beside it. The outer ring of a plate evaporates faster than the interior — a hit sitting in it is more likely to be an artefact than biology. Read-only: the database is opened with mode=ro.
records.translation: Hvaða mæling sem er sem plötuhitakort, með jaðaráhrifaprófinu við hliðina. Ytri hringur plötu gufar hraðar upp en innri hlutinn — jákvæð niðurstaða sem lendir þar er líklegri til að vera tæknilegt frávik en líffræði. Aðeins lestur: gagnagrunnurinn er opnaður með mode=ro.

records.key: Ask a question about the table you are gating without leaving the screen.
records.source: Ask a question about the table you are gating without leaving the screen.
records.translation: Spurðu spurningar um töfluna sem þú ert að setja valmörk á án þess að yfirgefa skjáinn.

records.key: Assign conditions, controls, and replicates before acquisition. Layout checks identify row, column, and plate-edge confounding. Export writes plate_map.csv using the same identifiers as spaCR measurements, allowing the design to be reused by the analysis pipeline without manual re-entry.
records.source: Assign conditions, controls, and replicates before acquisition. Layout checks identify row, column, and plate-edge confounding. Export writes plate_map.csv using the same identifiers as spaCR measurements, allowing the design to be reused by the analysis pipeline without manual re-entry.
records.translation: Úthlutaðu skilyrðum, viðmiðum og endurtekningum fyrir myndatöku. Uppsetningarathuganir greina ruglun vegna raðar, dálks og plötujaðars. Útflutningur skrifar plate_map.csv með sömu auðkennum og spaCR-mælingar, svo greiningarferlið getur endurnýtt hönnunina án þess að slá hana inn aftur handvirkt.

records.key: Assign grouping variables to rows and columns, select a measurement as the value, and choose one or more summary statistics. Each table cell reports its sample size; empty groups remain blank rather than being represented as zero. Results can be exported or passed to Graph Builder.
records.source: Assign grouping variables to rows and columns, select a measurement as the value, and choose one or more summary statistics. Each table cell reports its sample size; empty groups remain blank rather than being represented as zero. Results can be exported or passed to Graph Builder.
records.translation: Úthlutaðu flokkunarbreytum á raðir og dálka, veldu mælingu sem gildi og veldu eina eða fleiri samantektartölur. Hver töflureitur sýnir úrtaksstærð sína; tómir hópar eru hafðir auðir frekar en að vera sýndir sem núll. Hægt er að flytja niðurstöður út eða senda þær í Graph Builder.

records.key: Automatic pass/fail checks on the finished masks — object counts, size and split ratios, border and foreground fractions, and how much of a plate may fail before the run is called off. Tighten them once you know what a good field looks like; loosen them when an unusual but legitimate plate keeps being rejected.
records.source: Automatic pass/fail checks on the finished masks — object counts, size and split ratios, border and foreground fractions, and how much of a plate may fail before the run is called off. Tighten them once you know what a good field looks like; loosen them when an unusual but legitimate plate keeps being rejected.
records.translation: Sjálfvirkar standast/falla-athuganir á fullgerðu grímunum — fjöldi hluta, stærð og skiptingarhlutföll, jaðar- og forgrunnshlutföll og hve stór hluti plötu má falla áður en keyrslan er stöðvuð. Hertu þær þegar þú veist hvernig gott sjónsvið lítur út; slakaðu á þeim þegar óvenjulegri en gildri plötu er sífellt hafnað.

records.key: Available memory could not be measured, so the worker count is limited to {workers}.
records.source: Available memory could not be measured, so the worker count is limited to {workers}.
records.translation: Ekki var hægt að mæla tiltækt minni, svo fjöldi vinnsluferla er takmarkaður við {workers}.

records.key: Available on a module screen, which is what owns the settings panel these values would be written into.
records.source: Available on a module screen, which is what owns the settings panel these values would be written into.
records.translation: Tiltækt á skjá einingar, sem á stillingaspjaldið sem þessi gildi yrðu skrifuð í.

records.key: Axis-label size relative to the base font size.
records.source: Axis-label size relative to the base font size.
records.translation: Stærð ásmerkinga miðað við grunnleturstærð.

records.key: Axis-tick label size relative to the base font size.
records.source: Axis-tick label size relative to the base font size.
records.translation: Stærð kvarðamerkinga ása miðað við grunnleturstærð.

records.key: Back to the limits the data asks for, after zooming or spinning too far. Gates are untouched — this moves the view, never them.
records.source: Back to the limits the data asks for, after zooming or spinning too far. Gates are untouched — this moves the view, never them.
records.translation: Aftur að mörkunum sem gögnin kalla á, eftir að hafa þysjað eða snúið of langt. Valmörk haldast óbreytt — þetta færir sýnina, aldrei þau.

records.key: Base font size for saved figures. Title, label and tick sizes are scaled relative to this value.
records.source: Base font size for saved figures. Title, label and tick sizes are scaled relative to this value.
records.translation: Grunnleturstærð fyrir vistaðar myndir. Stærðir titils, merkinga og kvarðamerkja eru kvarðaðar miðað við þetta gildi.

records.key: Binomial GLM whose dispersion is estimated from the Pearson chi-square instead of being fixed at 1, for a fraction that varies more than binomial sampling allows; the cell count enters as var_weights. Choose it over logit when the residual deviance says the response is overdispersed.
records.source: Binomial GLM whose dispersion is estimated from the Pearson chi-square instead of being fixed at 1, for a fraction that varies more than binomial sampling allows; the cell count enters as var_weights. Choose it over logit when the residual deviance says the response is overdispersed.
records.translation: Tvíkosta GLM þar sem dreifnin er metin út frá Pearson kí-kvaðrat í stað þess að vera föst í 1, fyrir hlutfall sem breytist meira en tvíkosta úrtak leyfir; frumufjöldinn fer inn sem var_weights. Veldu þetta frekar en logit þegar leifafrávikið sýnir að svörunin er ofdreifð.

records.key: Binomial GLM with a logit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights -- which is what tells the variance function that a fraction measured from 400 cells is firmer evidence than the same fraction measured from 30. Coefficients are log-odds.
records.source: Binomial GLM with a logit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights -- which is what tells the variance function that a fraction measured from 400 cells is firmer evidence than the same fraction measured from 30. Coefficients are log-odds.
records.translation: Tvíkosta GLM með logit-tengli á hlutfalli, vegið með frumufjölda brunnsins sem var_weights -- það er það sem segir dreifnifallinu að hlutfall mælt út frá 400 frumum er traustari vísbending en sama hlutfall mælt út frá 30. Stuðlarnir eru log-odds.

records.key: Binomial GLM with a probit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights. It differs from logit only in the link: the fitted probabilities are near-identical, and the coefficients are on a different scale and are not log-odds.
records.source: Binomial GLM with a probit link on a fraction, weighted by the well's cell count as var_weights. It differs from logit only in the link: the fitted probabilities are near-identical, and the coefficients are on a different scale and are not log-odds.
records.translation: Tvíkosta GLM með probit-tengli á hlutfalli, vegið með frumufjölda brunnsins sem var_weights. Það er aðeins frábrugðið logit í tenglinum: aðfelldu líkurnar eru nánast eins, en stuðlarnir eru á öðrum kvarða og eru ekki log-odds.

records.key: Blue channel drawn as magenta, for tritanopia.
records.source: Blue channel drawn as magenta, for tritanopia.
records.translation: Blá rás birt sem magenta, fyrir tritanópíu.

records.key: Build a set of crops to annotate by streaming them from the merged arrays or from the coordinates in measurements.db, without measuring the plate again. The result is registered as a new png_list table.
records.source: Build a set of crops to annotate by streaming them from the merged arrays or from the coordinates in measurements.db, without measuring the plate again. The result is registered as a new png_list table.
records.translation: Búðu til safn myndskurða til merkingar með því að streyma þeim úr sameinuðu fylkjunum eða út frá hnitunum í measurements.db, án þess að mæla plötuna aftur. Niðurstaðan er skráð sem ný png_list-tafla.

records.key: Builds a containment tree from the cell_id links written during measurement. Selecting a node highlights the corresponding object in other open views; selecting it with its contents also highlights all descendants. Child objects whose cell_id does not identify a measured cell are listed separately as potential segmentation or linking discrepancies.
records.source: Builds a containment tree from the cell_id links written during measurement. Selecting a node highlights the corresponding object in other open views; selecting it with its contents also highlights all descendants. Child objects whose cell_id does not identify a measured cell are listed separately as potential segmentation or linking discrepancies.
records.translation: Byggir innihaldstré út frá cell_id-tengingunum sem skrifaðar voru við mælingu. Þegar hnútur er valinn er samsvarandi hlutur auðkenndur í öðrum opnum sýnum; ef hann er valinn ásamt innihaldi sínu eru allir afkomendur einnig auðkenndir. Undirhlutir þar sem cell_id vísar ekki á mælda frumu eru taldir upp sér sem hugsanlegt misræmi í hlutun eða tengingu.

records.key: Candidate cells
records.source: Candidate cells
records.translation: Frumur sem koma til greina

records.key: Case-insensitive literal search across the visible source table. This is not a regex field and only changes which rows you see; it does not change condition assignments.
records.source: Case-insensitive literal search across the visible source table. This is not a regex field and only changes which rows you see; it does not change condition assignments.
records.translation: Lesstafaleit, óháð há- og lágstöfum, í sýnilegu upprunatöflunni. Þetta er ekki regex-reitur og breytir aðeins því hvaða raðir þú sérð; það breytir ekki úthlutun skilyrða.

records.key: Cells per montage row
records.source: Cells per montage row
records.translation: Frumur í hverri röð myndasamsetningar

records.key: Channel shown and segmented. Bound to the segmentation channel, so the frame you look at is the frame Cellpose sees.
records.source: Channel shown and segmented. Bound to the segmentation channel, so the frame you look at is the frame Cellpose sees.
records.translation: Rásin sem er sýnd og hlutuð. Tengd hlutunarrásinni, svo ramminn sem þú horfir á er ramminn sem Cellpose sér.

records.key: Channel {index}: {name}
records.source: Channel {index}: {name}
records.translation: Rás {index}: {name}

records.key: Channels drawn as cyan / magenta / yellow (publication style, not a colour-blind mode).
records.source: Channels drawn as cyan / magenta / yellow (publication style, not a colour-blind mode).
records.translation: Rásir birtar sem blágrænt / magenta / gult (útgáfustíll, ekki litblinduhamur).

records.key: Channels drawn in {mode} primaries.
records.source: Channels drawn in {mode} primaries.
records.translation: Rásir birtar í {mode} grunnlitum.

records.key: Channels:
records.source: Channels:
records.translation: Rásir:

records.key: Check images to combine their objects. Double-click a crop to open its source image. This affects the preview only.
records.source: Check images to combine their objects. Double-click a crop to open its source image. This affects the preview only.
records.translation: Hakaðu við myndir til að sameina hluti þeirra. Tvísmelltu á myndskurð til að opna upprunamynd hans. Þetta hefur aðeins áhrif á forskoðunina.

records.key: Check the plaque diameter and thresholds on one sampled field before running the assay.
records.source: Check the plaque diameter and thresholds on one sampled field before running the assay.
records.translation: Athugaðu þvermál sýkingarskella og þröskulda á einu sjónsviði úr úrtakinu áður en mælingin er keyrð.

records.key: Children whose cell_id names no cell in their field. The masks disagree — the child segmentation found an object the parent segmentation did not. Double-click to open one.
records.source: Children whose cell_id names no cell in their field. The masks disagree — the child segmentation found an object the parent segmentation did not. Double-click to open one.
records.translation: Undirhlutir þar sem cell_id vísar ekki á neina frumu í sjónsviði þeirra. Grímurnar eru ósammála — hlutun undirhlutanna fann hlut sem hlutun yfirhlutanna fann ekki. Tvísmelltu til að opna einn.

records.key: Choose a single merged intensity channel or the first three channels as an RGB composite.
records.source: Choose a single merged intensity channel or the first three channels as an RGB composite.
records.translation: Veldu eina sameinaða styrkleikarás eða fyrstu þrjár rásirnar sem RGB-samsetningu.

records.key: Choose a well column to preview its mapping
records.source: Choose a well column to preview its mapping
records.translation: Veldu brunnsdálk til að forskoða vörpun hans

records.key: Choose intensity images and label masks
records.source: Choose intensity images and label masks
records.translation: Veldu styrkleikamyndir og merkjagrímur

records.key: Choose the experimental unit kept intact across training and evaluation sets. Well-, field-, or plate-level grouping reduces information leakage between related cells.
records.source: Choose the experimental unit kept intact across training and evaluation sets. Well-, field-, or plate-level grouping reduces information leakage between related cells.
records.translation: Veldu tilraunaeininguna sem er haldið óskiptri milli þjálfunar- og matsgagnasetta. Flokkun eftir brunni, sjónsviði eða plötu dregur úr upplýsingaleka milli skyldra frumna.

records.key: Choose the ink, background, grid, size and resolution for the saved file, preview the result, then export it. The figure on screen is not changed.
records.source: Choose the ink, background, grid, size and resolution for the saved file, preview the result, then export it. The figure on screen is not changed.
records.translation: Veldu blek, bakgrunn, hnitanet, stærð og upplausn fyrir vistuðu skrána, forskoðaðu niðurstöðuna og fluttu hana síðan út. Myndinni á skjánum er ekki breytt.

records.key: Choose the reducer and the shared random seed and distance metric. The method-specific groups below grey themselves automatically when another reducer is selected.
records.source: Choose the reducer and the shared random seed and distance metric. The method-specific groups below grey themselves automatically when another reducer is selected.
records.translation: Veldu víddarminnkunaraðferðina, sameiginlega slembifræið og fjarlægðarmælikvarðann. Aðferðarsértæku hóparnir hér fyrir neðan verða sjálfkrafa gráir þegar önnur aðferð er valin.

records.key: Choose the reducer and the shared random seed and distance metric. The method-specific groups below grey themselves automatically.
records.source: Choose the reducer and the shared random seed and distance metric. The method-specific groups below grey themselves automatically.
records.translation: Veldu víddarminnkunaraðferðina, sameiginlega slembifræið og fjarlægðarmælikvarðann. Aðferðarsértæku hóparnir hér fyrir neðan verða sjálfkrafa gráir.

records.key: Choose which of the annotation's wells to include. A well left out is removed from both sides of the comparison.
records.source: Choose which of the annotation's wells to include. A well left out is removed from both sides of the comparison.
records.translation: Veldu hvaða brunna merkingarinnar á að taka með. Brunnur sem er sleppt er fjarlægður úr báðum hliðum samanburðarins.

records.key: Choose which of the screen's crop folders to download. Only needed to display images — the measurement functions do not read them. About 8 GB per plate.
records.source: Choose which of the screen's crop folders to download. Only needed to display images — the measurement functions do not read them. About 8 GB per plate.
records.translation: Veldu hvaða myndskurðarmöppur skimunarinnar á að sækja. Þær þarf aðeins til að birta myndir — mælingaföllin lesa þær ekki. Um 8 GB á hverja plötu.

records.key: Choose which of the screen's measurement databases to download. These are what the measurement and cell functions read. About 0.5 GB per plate.
records.source: Choose which of the screen's measurement databases to download. These are what the measurement and cell functions read. About 0.5 GB per plate.
records.translation: Veldu hvaða mæligagnagrunna skimunarinnar á að sækja. Það eru þeir sem mælinga- og frumuföllin lesa. Um 0.5 GB á hverja plötu.

records.key: Choose which table of the database the gates were drawn on.
records.source: Choose which table of the database the gates were drawn on.
records.translation: Veldu á hvaða töflu gagnagrunnsins valmörkin voru teiknuð.

records.key: Classify attached and invaded parasites from two-colour differential staining. Estimate the intensity threshold per field and flag fields that lack two distinguishable populations.
records.source: Classify attached and invaded parasites from two-colour differential staining. Estimate the intensity threshold per field and flag fields that lack two distinguishable populations.
records.translation: Flokkaðu sníkjudýr sem eru viðloðandi og sem hafa ráðist inn, út frá tvílita mismunalitun. Áætlaðu styrkleikaþröskuldinn fyrir hvert sjónsvið og merktu sjónsvið sem skortir tvo aðgreinanlega hópa.

records.key: Click a cell of the matrix to see the objects it counted.
records.source: Click a cell of the matrix to see the objects it counted.
records.translation: Smelltu á reit í fylkinu til að sjá hlutina sem hann taldi.

records.key: Click a cell rather than the class name: a confusion is a (true, predicted) pair.
records.source: Click a cell rather than the class name: a confusion is a (true, predicted) pair.
records.translation: Smelltu á reit frekar en heiti flokksins: ruglingur er par (raunverulegt, spáð).

records.key: Click a well to see what is behind it.
records.source: Click a well to see what is behind it.
records.translation: Smelltu á brunn til að sjá hvað liggur að baki honum.

records.key: Click to open the frames of this field side by side.
records.source: Click to open the frames of this field side by side.
records.translation: Smelltu til að opna ramma þessa sjónsviðs hlið við hlið.

records.key: Click to show the timelapse settings — the ones that mean nothing until a field has a time axis: the time axis itself, the frame interval, and how objects are linked from one frame to the next. Hiding them keeps their values: they still reach the run and the settings file.
records.source: Click to show the timelapse settings — the ones that mean nothing until a field has a time axis: the time axis itself, the frame interval, and how objects are linked from one frame to the next. Hiding them keeps their values: they still reach the run and the settings file.
records.translation: Smelltu til að sýna tímaraðarstillingarnar — þær sem skipta engu máli fyrr en sjónsvið hefur tímaás: tímaásinn sjálfan, bilið milli ramma og hvernig hlutir eru tengdir frá einum ramma til þess næsta. Ef þær eru faldar halda þær gildum sínum: þau berast samt til keyrslunnar og stillingaskrárinnar.

records.key: Click to show the volumetric settings — the ones that mean nothing until a field has a z axis: which axis it is, how the stack is segmented or projected, and the voxel geometry that says how far apart two planes really are. Hiding them keeps their values: they still reach the run and the settings file.
records.source: Click to show the volumetric settings — the ones that mean nothing until a field has a z axis: which axis it is, how the stack is segmented or projected, and the voxel geometry that says how far apart two planes really are. Hiding them keeps their values: they still reach the run and the settings file.
records.translation: Smelltu til að sýna rúmmálsstillingarnar — þær sem skipta engu máli fyrr en sjónsvið hefur z-ás: hvaða ás það er, hvernig staflinn er hlutaður eða varpaður og voxla-rúmfræðina sem segir hversu langt er í raun milli tveggja plana. Ef þær eru faldar halda þær gildum sínum: þau berast samt til keyrslunnar og stillingaskrárinnar.

records.key: Cluster with these parameters and turn what it finds into gates — the same gates a drawn shape makes, so they save, re-apply and export identically.
records.source: Cluster with these parameters and turn what it finds into gates — the same gates a drawn shape makes, so they save, re-apply and export identically.
records.translation: Klasaðu með þessum færibreytum og breyttu því sem finnst í valmörk — sömu valmörk og teiknað form býr til, svo þau vistast, eru endurbeitt og flutt út á nákvæmlega sama hátt.

records.key: Column created/updated on png_list when labels are applied.
records.source: Column created/updated on png_list when labels are applied.
records.translation: Dálkur sem er búinn til/uppfærður í png_list þegar merkingum er beitt.

records.key: Combined — other gates added to or subtracted from each other, chosen in the gates panel
records.source: Combined — other gates added to or subtracted from each other, chosen in the gates panel
records.translation: Samsett — önnur valmörk lögð saman eða dregin hvert frá öðru, valin á valmarkaspjaldinu

records.key: Compare any measurement between the cells this tab picked for each gene and the rest of the screen. Cell, well or plate level; five ways of drawing it; the test chosen from the normality and variance checks and reported with n; and one folder holding the figure, the data, the statistics and the settings.
records.source: Compare any measurement between the cells this tab picked for each gene and the rest of the screen. Cell, well or plate level; five ways of drawing it; the test chosen from the normality and variance checks and reported with n; and one folder holding the figure, the data, the statistics and the settings.
records.translation: Berðu hvaða mælingu sem er saman milli frumnanna sem þessi flipi valdi fyrir hvert gen og afgangsins af skimuninni. Á stigi frumu, brunns eða plötu; fimm leiðir til að teikna hana; prófið valið út frá athugunum á normaldreifingu og dreifni og birt með n; og ein mappa sem geymir myndina, gögnin, tölfræðina og stillingarnar.

records.key: Compares two runs from the same project. The report groups changed settings by their settings-panel category, compares object, well, and field counts per plate, and identifies hits that were added, removed, or re-ranked. Incompatible runs are not compared unless the compatibility warning is overridden.
records.source: Compares two runs from the same project. The report groups changed settings by their settings-panel category, compares object, well, and field counts per plate, and identifies hits that were added, removed, or re-ranked. Incompatible runs are not compared unless the compatibility warning is overridden.
records.translation: Ber saman tvær keyrslur úr sama verkefni. Skýrslan flokkar breyttar stillingar eftir flokki þeirra á stillingaspjaldinu, ber saman fjölda hluta, brunna og sjónsviða á hverri plötu og greinir jákvæðar niðurstöður sem var bætt við, fjarlægðar eða endurraðaðar. Ósamrýmanlegar keyrslur eru ekki bornar saman nema samrýmanleikaviðvöruninni sé hnekkt.

records.key: Composite (channels 1–3)
records.source: Composite (channels 1–3)
records.translation: Samsett (rásir 1–3)

records.key: Continue from the atomic field checkpoint in the destination. Every TIFF in a completed field is validated before it is skipped; missing or corrupt fields are converted again. API: spacr.convert.convert(..., resume=True).
records.source: Continue from the atomic field checkpoint in the destination. Every TIFF in a completed field is validated before it is skipped; missing or corrupt fields are converted again. API: spacr.convert.convert(..., resume=True).
records.translation: Halda áfram frá atómíska sjónsviðsvistunarpunktinum í áfangastaðnum. Hver TIFF-skrá í fullgerðu sjónsviði er sannreynd áður en henni er sleppt; sjónsvið sem vantar eða eru skemmd eru umbreytt aftur. API: spacr.convert.convert(..., resume=True).

records.key: Control point, outline and crop-thumbnail rendering after the embedding is fitted. These presentation choices never move or refit a sample.
records.source: Control point, outline and crop-thumbnail rendering after the embedding is fitted. These presentation choices never move or refit a sample.
records.translation: Stjórnaðu birtingu punkta, útlína og smámynda myndskurða eftir að innfellingin hefur verið aðfelld. Þessir framsetningarkostir færa aldrei sýni né aðfella þau aftur.

records.key: Control wells used for the comparison. A gene name selects all associated guides; a guide name selects only that guide.
records.source: Control wells used for the comparison. A gene name selects all associated guides; a guide name selects only that guide.
records.translation: Viðmiðunarbrunnar sem notaðir eru í samanburðinum. Genaheiti velur öll tengd leiðsögu-RNA; heiti leiðsögu-RNA velur aðeins það eina.

records.key: Controls are listed by default: a screen whose positive control is not near the top has a problem, and that is only visible if it is in the list.
records.source: Controls are listed by default: a screen whose positive control is not near the top has a problem, and that is only visible if it is in the list.
records.translation: Viðmið eru sjálfgefið talin upp: skimun þar sem jákvæða viðmiðið er ekki nálægt toppnum á við vandamál að stríða, og það sést aðeins ef það er á listanum.

records.key: Correction applied before segmentation: the intensity floor treated as empty and the signal-to-noise gate a field has to clear. Raise the floor when autofluorescence is being segmented as objects; lower it when genuinely dim cells disappear.
records.source: Correction applied before segmentation: the intensity floor treated as empty and the signal-to-noise gate a field has to clear. Raise the floor when autofluorescence is being segmented as objects; lower it when genuinely dim cells disappear.
records.translation: Leiðrétting sem beitt er fyrir hlutun: styrkleikagólfið sem er meðhöndlað sem tómt og lágmark merkis á móti suði sem sjónsvið þarf að standast. Hækkaðu gólfið þegar sjálfsflúrljómun er hlutuð sem hlutir; lækkaðu það þegar raunverulega daufar frumur hverfa.

records.key: Could not open those crops
records.source: Could not open those crops
records.translation: Ekki tókst að opna þessa myndskurði

records.key: Count per cell
records.source: Count per cell
records.translation: Fjöldi á hverja frumu

records.key: Crop to the bounding box
records.source: Crop to the bounding box
records.translation: Skera að afmörkunarkassanum

records.key: Crops per forward pass. Lower it if the card runs out of memory; it changes speed and nothing else.
records.source: Crops per forward pass. Lower it if the card runs out of memory; it changes speed and nothing else.
records.translation: Myndskurðir í hverri framrás. Lækkaðu þetta ef skjákortið verður uppiskroppa með minni; það breytir hraðanum og engu öðru.

records.key: Cross-fit grouping, independent morphology features and probability threshold for hit-like candidates; these are not genotype calls.
records.source: Cross-fit grouping, independent morphology features and probability threshold for hit-like candidates; these are not genotype calls.
records.translation: Hópun fyrir víxlaðfellingu, óháðir formgerðareiginleikar og líkindaþröskuldur fyrir kandídata sem líkjast jákvæðum niðurstöðum; þetta eru ekki arfgerðargreiningar.

records.key: Cross-fitting candidate cells…
records.source: Cross-fitting candidate cells…
records.translation: Víxlaðfelling á kandídatsfrumum…

records.key: Cross-validation folds per trial. Folds are grouped by well, so crops from one well never straddle a split.
records.source: Cross-validation folds per trial. Folds are grouped by well, so crops from one well never straddle a split.
records.translation: Krossprófunarbrot í hverri tilraun. Brotin eru flokkuð eftir brunni, svo myndskurðir úr einum brunni lenda aldrei báðum megin við skiptingu.

records.key: Curated gene annotation CSVs. Each is collapsed to one row per gene before it is joined, so a file with one row per transcript cannot multiply a hit.
records.source: Curated gene annotation CSVs. Each is collapsed to one row per gene before it is joined, so a file with one row per transcript cannot multiply a hit.
records.translation: Yfirfarnar CSV-skrár með genamerkingum. Hver þeirra er dregin saman í eina röð á gen áður en hún er tengd, svo skrá með eina röð á hvert umrit getur ekki margfaldað jákvæða niðurstöðu.

records.key: Custom merging changes spaCR's standard table relationships and aggregation rules. It is intended for non-spaCR databases or deliberately different schemas. Incorrect settings can link unrelated objects, duplicate or omit observations, and change measurements used in plots and gates. Check the join keys, output level, aggregation, and preview before applying.
records.source: Custom merging changes spaCR's standard table relationships and aggregation rules. It is intended for non-spaCR databases or deliberately different schemas. Incorrect settings can link unrelated objects, duplicate or omit observations, and change measurements used in plots and gates. Check the join keys, output level, aggregation, and preview before applying.
records.translation: Sérsniðin sameining breytir stöðluðum töflutengslum og samsöfnunarreglum spaCR. Hún er ætluð fyrir gagnagrunna sem ekki eru frá spaCR eða skemu sem eru vísvitandi frábrugðin. Rangar stillingar geta tengt ótengda hluti, tvítekið eða sleppt athugunum og breytt mælingum sem notaðar eru í gröfum og valmörkum. Athugaðu tengilyklana, úttaksstigið, samsöfnunina og forskoðunina áður en þú beitir þeim.

records.key: Define a threshold on a histogram or a polygon on a two-variable scatter plot, then save the region as a named filter shared by open views. Gates can be nested. Each gate reports its sample size and its percentage of both the parent population and the complete table. Saved gating strategies can be applied to subsequent plates.
records.source: Define a threshold on a histogram or a polygon on a two-variable scatter plot, then save the region as a named filter shared by open views. Gates can be nested. Each gate reports its sample size and its percentage of both the parent population and the complete table. Saved gating strategies can be applied to subsequent plates.
records.translation: Skilgreindu þröskuld á stuðlariti eða marghyrning á tvíbreytu dreifiriti og vistaðu svo svæðið sem nefnda síu sem opnar sýnir deila. Valmörk geta verið hreiðruð. Hver valmörk sýna úrtaksstærð sína og hlutfall sitt bæði af yfirþýðinu og allri töflunni. Hægt er að beita vistuðum valmarkaáætlunum á síðari plötur.

records.key: Deletes the gate and everything gated inside it — a child whose parent is gone is a gate on a population that no longer exists.
records.source: Deletes the gate and everything gated inside it — a child whose parent is gone is a gate on a population that no longer exists.
records.translation: Eyðir valmörkunum og öllu sem er afmarkað innan þeirra — undirvalmörk sem hafa misst yfirvalmörk sín eru valmörk á þýði sem er ekki lengur til.

records.key: Departures from spaCRPower that do not change the power on screen, but do change how these numbers compare with the R package's.
records.source: Departures from spaCRPower that do not change the power on screen, but do change how these numbers compare with the R package's.
records.translation: Frávik frá spaCRPower sem breyta ekki tölfræðilega aflinu á skjánum, en breyta því hvernig þessar tölur bera sig saman við tölur R-pakkans.

records.key: Describe plate, control and covariate columns used to remove technical batch structure without treating real biological differences as nuisance variation.
records.source: Describe plate, control and covariate columns used to remove technical batch structure without treating real biological differences as nuisance variation.
records.translation: Lýstu plötu-, viðmiðs- og fylgibreytudálkum sem notaðir eru til að fjarlægja tæknilega lotuskipan án þess að meðhöndla raunverulegan líffræðilegan mun sem truflandi breytileika.

records.key: Detect and quantify plaques in plaque-assay images.
records.source: Detect and quantify plaques in plaque-assay images.
records.translation: Greina og magngreina sýkingarskellur í myndum af skellumælingum.

records.key: Display each cell's value in a heatmap.
records.source: Display each cell's value in a heatmap.
records.translation: Sýna gildi hvers reits í hitakorti.

records.key: Displayed channel. 'All channels' renders the crops from the PNG channels in Crop settings; picking one shows that channel alone.
records.source: Displayed channel. 'All channels' renders the crops from the PNG channels in Crop settings; picking one shows that channel alone.
records.translation: Rásin sem er birt. 'All channels' birtir myndskurðina úr PNG-rásunum í stillingum myndskurðar; ef ein er valin birtist sú rás ein og sér.

records.key: Displays image channels, label masks, points, and regions of interest in a shared coordinate system. Configure each layer's colour map, opacity, blending, visibility, and order. Object selection is synchronized with other open views.
records.source: Displays image channels, label masks, points, and regions of interest in a shared coordinate system. Configure each layer's colour map, opacity, blending, visibility, and order. Object selection is synchronized with other open views.
records.translation: Birtir myndrásir, merkjagrímur, punkta og áhugasvæði í sameiginlegu hnitakerfi. Stilltu litakort, ógegnsæi, blöndun, sýnileika og röð hvers lags. Val hluta er samstillt við aðrar opnar sýnir.

records.key: Divide the score distribution into this many equal-count strata and allocate the annotation budget evenly across them.
records.source: Divide the score distribution into this many equal-count strata and allocate the annotation budget evenly across them.
records.translation: Skiptu stigadreifingunni í þennan fjölda jafnstórra laga og dreifðu merkingarkvótanum jafnt á milli þeirra.

records.key: Do not generate pseudo wells
records.source: Do not generate pseudo wells
records.translation: Ekki búa til gervibrunna

records.key: Double-click a row to re-run that trial and draw its figures below. They are live figures: right-click one to restyle it.
records.source: Double-click a row to re-run that trial and draw its figures below. They are live figures: right-click one to restyle it.
records.translation: Tvísmelltu á röð til að keyra þá tilraun aftur og teikna myndir hennar hér fyrir neðan. Þetta eru lifandi myndir: hægrismelltu á eina til að breyta stíl hennar.

records.key: Download about 280 MB of example data: 2,341 single-cell crops with a measurements database, of which 88 are already labelled. Settings are filled in with it, so the module can be run straight away. Cached afterwards.
records.source: Download about 280 MB of example data: 2,341 single-cell crops with a measurements database, of which 88 are already labelled. Settings are filled in with it, so the module can be run straight away. Cached afterwards.
records.translation: Sækja um 280 MB af dæmigögnum: 2,341 myndskurð af stökum frumum með mæligagnagrunni, þar af eru 88 þegar merktir. Stillingarnar eru fylltar út með þeim, svo hægt er að keyra eininguna strax. Vistað í skyndiminni eftir það.

records.key: Download about 370 MB of example data for Measure: sixteen fields across four wells, already segmented, so Measure can be run without generating masks first. Cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.source: Download about 370 MB of example data for Measure: sixteen fields across four wells, already segmented, so Measure can be run without generating masks first. Cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.translation: Sækja um 370 MB af dæmigögnum fyrir Measure: sextán sjónsvið í fjórum brunnum, þegar hlutuð, svo hægt er að keyra Measure án þess að búa fyrst til grímur. Vistað í skyndiminni eftir það, svo það gerist samstundis ef ýtt er aftur.

records.key: Download an example plate to annotate, and fill in the settings that go with it.
records.source: Download an example plate to annotate, and fill in the settings that go with it.
records.translation: Sækja dæmiplötu til að merkja og fylla út stillingarnar sem fylgja henni.

records.key: Download raw reads from the published screen (NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935, four sequenced plates). You choose which runs and how many reads from each — the full set is about 20 GB, while a hundred thousand reads from each file is about 30 MB.
records.source: Download raw reads from the published screen (NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935, four sequenced plates). You choose which runs and how many reads from each — the full set is about 20 GB, while a hundred thousand reads from each file is about 30 MB.
records.translation: Sækja hrálestra úr birtu skimuninni (NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935, fjórar raðgreindar plötur). Þú velur hvaða keyrslur og hversu marga lestra úr hverri — allt safnið er um 20 GB, en hundrað þúsund lestrar úr hverri skrá eru um 30 MB.

records.key: Download the approximately 400 MB toxo_mito example plate and set its image directory as the source (src). Later requests reuse the cached files. The download includes compatible example settings.
records.source: Download the approximately 400 MB toxo_mito example plate and set its image directory as the source (src). Later requests reuse the cached files. The download includes compatible example settings.
records.translation: Sækja um það bil 400 MB toxo_mito-dæmiplötuna og setja myndamöppu hennar sem uppruna (src). Síðari beiðnir endurnýta skrárnar í skyndiminni. Niðurhalið inniheldur samrýmanlegar dæmistillingar.

records.key: Draw a gate before exporting.
records.source: Draw a gate before exporting.
records.translation: Teiknaðu valmörk áður en flutt er út.

records.key: Draw any per-well measurement as a plate heatmap and test whether the outer ring reads differently from the interior — the edge artefact that turns a screen hit into a failed follow-up.
records.source: Draw any per-well measurement as a plate heatmap and test whether the outer ring reads differently from the interior — the edge artefact that turns a screen hit into a failed follow-up.
records.translation: Teiknaðu hvaða mælingu sem er á brunnsstigi sem plötuhitakort og prófaðu hvort ytri hringurinn mælist öðruvísi en innri hlutinn — jaðaráhrifin sem breyta jákvæðri niðurstöðu í skimun í misheppnaða eftirfylgnitilraun.

records.key: Draw gates on a scatter of your measurements, then annotate what falls inside. Opens the real Gate Editor.
records.source: Draw gates on a scatter of your measurements, then annotate what falls inside. Opens the real Gate Editor.
records.translation: Teiknaðu valmörk á dreifirit mælinganna þinna og merktu svo það sem lendir innan þeirra. Opnar hinn raunverulega Gate Editor.

records.key: Drop intensity images and label masks made outside spaCR, review the detected cell, nucleus, pathogen and organelle assignments, then build merged arrays, measurements and single-object crops ready for Annotate.
records.source: Drop intensity images and label masks made outside spaCR, review the detected cell, nucleus, pathogen and organelle assignments, then build merged arrays, measurements and single-object crops ready for Annotate.
records.translation: Slepptu inn styrkleikamyndum og merkjagrímum sem gerðar voru utan spaCR, yfirfarðu greindar úthlutanir frumna, kjarna, sýkla og frumulíffæra og byggðu síðan sameinuð fylki, mælingar og myndskurði af stökum hlutum, tilbúna fyrir Annotate.

records.key: Each guide is tested independently, as a marginal association rather than as one coefficient in a design holding every guide at once -- so these are marginal associations, not conditional coefficients. Its read fraction and the well phenotype are first residualised against the block (normally plateID) and any nuisance columns; the P value is then the share of Freedman-Lane permutations -- the phenotype residual reshuffled WITHIN each block -- whose statistic reaches the observed one, so it is empirical and two-sided and can never be smaller than 1/(permutations + 1). A guide becomes testable once it appears in guide_min_wells wells above guide_presence_threshold, and each of those thresholds is corrected as its own family. This avoids the rank requirement of a simultaneous guide model and can be used when guides outnumber wells; interpretation still depends on valid blocking, exchangeability, and adequate guide support.
records.source: Each guide is tested independently, as a marginal association rather than as one coefficient in a design holding every guide at once -- so these are marginal associations, not conditional coefficients. Its read fraction and the well phenotype are first residualised against the block (normally plateID) and any nuisance columns; the P value is then the share of Freedman-Lane permutations -- the phenotype residual reshuffled WITHIN each block -- whose statistic reaches the observed one, so it is empirical and two-sided and can never be smaller than 1/(permutations + 1). A guide becomes testable once it appears in guide_min_wells wells above guide_presence_threshold, and each of those thresholds is corrected as its own family. This avoids the rank requirement of a simultaneous guide model and can be used when guides outnumber wells; interpretation still depends on valid blocking, exchangeability, and adequate guide support.
records.translation: Hvert leiðsögu-RNA er prófað sjálfstætt, sem jaðartengsl frekar en sem einn stuðull í líkani sem inniheldur öll leiðsögu-RNA í einu -- svo þetta eru jaðartengsl, ekki skilyrtir stuðlar. Lestrarhlutfall þess og svipgerð brunnsins eru fyrst leiðrétt með leifum gagnvart blokkinni (venjulega plateID) og öllum truflunardálkum; P-gildið er þá hlutfall Freedman-Lane-umraðana -- þar sem svipgerðarleifinni er stokkað INNAN hverrar blokkar -- þar sem prófstærðin nær þeirri sem mældist, svo það er reynslubundið og tvíhliða og getur aldrei verið minna en 1/(permutations + 1). Leiðsögu-RNA verður prófanlegt þegar það kemur fyrir í guide_min_wells brunnum yfir guide_presence_threshold, og hver þessara þröskulda er leiðréttur sem sín eigin fjölskylda. Þetta forðast kröfuna um fulla stigatölu (rank) í samtímis líkani allra leiðsögu-RNA og má nota þegar leiðsögu-RNA eru fleiri en brunnar; túlkunin veltur samt á gildri blokkun, skiptanleika og nægum stuðningi fyrir hvert leiðsögu-RNA.

records.key: Edit the plate / well / field / channel / time columns as needed. The Filename column updates live. Apply writes a filename_map.csv next to your data — the pipeline uses it to name every extracted image.
records.source: Edit the plate / well / field / channel / time columns as needed. The Filename column updates live. Apply writes a filename_map.csv next to your data — the pipeline uses it to name every extracted image.
records.translation: Breyttu dálkunum plata / brunnur / sjónsvið / rás / tími eftir þörfum. Dálkurinn Filename uppfærist jafnóðum. Apply skrifar filename_map.csv við hlið gagnanna þinna — vinnsluferlið notar hana til að nefna hverja útdregna mynd.

records.key: Elastic net combines L1 and L2 through l1_ratio (1 is lasso; 0 is ridge), with alpha='auto' chosen by 5-fold cross-validation. It reports bootstrap selection frequency across lasso_n_boot resamples, not p-values, and applies lasso_selection_threshold.
records.source: Elastic net combines L1 and L2 through l1_ratio (1 is lasso; 0 is ridge), with alpha='auto' chosen by 5-fold cross-validation. It reports bootstrap selection frequency across lasso_n_boot resamples, not p-values, and applies lasso_selection_threshold.
records.translation: Elastic net sameinar L1 og L2 með l1_ratio (1 er lasso; 0 er ridge), þar sem alpha='auto' er valið með 5-faldri krossprófun. Það birtir tíðni bootstrap-vals yfir lasso_n_boot endurúrtök, ekki p-gildi, og beitir lasso_selection_threshold.

records.key: Enable the interactive Image UMAP view. Select a point to preview its image, draw a region around a cluster, and write manual or model-assisted labels to the database.
records.source: Enable the interactive Image UMAP view. Select a point to preview its image, draw a region around a cluster, and write manual or model-assisted labels to the database.
records.translation: Virkja gagnvirku Image UMAP-sýnina. Veldu punkt til að forskoða mynd hans, teiknaðu svæði utan um klasa og skrifaðu handvirkar merkingar eða merkingar með aðstoð líkans í gagnagrunninn.

records.key: Encoding runs separately for every stain and names it in the column. Projection mixes them into three and is faster.
records.source: Encoding runs separately for every stain and names it in the column. Projection mixes them into three and is faster.
records.translation: Kóðun keyrir sér fyrir hverja litun og nefnir hana í dálkinum. Vörpun blandar þeim saman í þrjár og er hraðari.

records.key: Enter comma-separated guide wells from which positive candidates are selected. The montage supplies its current wells by default. Leave empty to allow all displayed wells.
records.source: Enter comma-separated guide wells from which positive candidates are selected. The montage supplies its current wells by default. Leave empty to allow all displayed wells.
records.translation: Sláðu inn kommuaðgreinda brunna leiðsögu-RNA sem jákvæðir kandídatar eru valdir úr. Myndasamsetningin leggur sjálfgefið til núverandi brunna sína. Skildu eftir autt til að leyfa alla birta brunna.

records.key: Enter comma-separated wells containing experimentally defined positive controls.
records.source: Enter comma-separated wells containing experimentally defined positive controls.
records.translation: Sláðu inn kommuaðgreinda brunna sem innihalda tilraunalega skilgreind jákvæð viðmið.

records.key: Errors at or above this confidence suggest a wrong label; below it, a boundary the model has not learned.
records.source: Errors at or above this confidence suggest a wrong label; below it, a boundary the model has not learned.
records.translation: Villur með þessa vissu eða meiri benda til rangrar merkingar; undir henni benda þær til marka sem líkanið hefur ekki lært.

records.key: Evaluates object-level and well-level deviations separately, allowing detection of wells whose distributions shift without producing extreme individual objects. Available methods include modified z scores based on the median absolute deviation, Tukey fences, and robust minimum-covariance-determinant Mahalanobis distance with a specified false-positive threshold. Results are added as columns; input rows are retained.
records.source: Evaluates object-level and well-level deviations separately, allowing detection of wells whose distributions shift without producing extreme individual objects. Available methods include modified z scores based on the median absolute deviation, Tukey fences, and robust minimum-covariance-determinant Mahalanobis distance with a specified false-positive threshold. Results are added as columns; input rows are retained.
records.translation: Metur frávik á hlutastigi og brunnsstigi sérstaklega, sem gerir kleift að greina brunna þar sem dreifingin hliðrast án þess að einstakir hlutir verði öfgakenndir. Tiltækar aðferðir eru breytt z-gildi byggð á miðgildi algildra frávika, Tukey-girðingar og traust Mahalanobis-fjarlægð byggð á lágmarks-samdreifniákveðu (MCD) með tilgreindum þröskuldi fyrir falska jákvæða. Niðurstöðum er bætt við sem dálkum; inntaksraðir haldast.

records.key: Every guide against every measurement, blocked on plate and corrected across the whole grid. Identifier columns are left out. Each row also reports the absolute Spearman rank correlation between the measurement and the classification score, which identifies results that may reflect the score's existing measurement basis.
records.source: Every guide against every measurement, blocked on plate and corrected across the whole grid. Identifier columns are left out. Each row also reports the absolute Spearman rank correlation between the measurement and the classification score, which identifies results that may reflect the score's existing measurement basis.
records.translation: Hvert leiðsögu-RNA á móti hverri mælingu, blokkað eftir plötu og leiðrétt yfir allt netið. Auðkennisdálkum er sleppt. Hver röð sýnir einnig algilda Spearman-raðfylgni milli mælingarinnar og flokkunarstigsins, sem greinir niðurstöður sem gætu endurspeglað þann mælingagrunn sem stigið byggir þegar á.

records.key: Every piece of text in the figure: the title, the axis labels, the tick labels, the legend and any annotation.
records.source: Every piece of text in the figure: the title, the axis labels, the tick labels, the legend and any annotation.
records.translation: Allur texti á myndinni: titillinn, ásmerkingar, kvarðamerkingar, skýringartaflan og allar textamerkingar.

records.key: Everything that decides which rows reach the model — minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. Each one silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing any of them.
records.source: Everything that decides which rows reach the model — minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. Each one silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing any of them.
records.translation: Allt sem ræður því hvaða raðir ná til líkansins — lágmarksfjöldi frumna á brunn, lágmarksfjöldi athugana á leiðsögu-RNA, lágmark lestrarhlutfalls og fjarlæging útlaga. Hvert þeirra minnkar gagnasafnið án viðvörunar, svo skoðaðu greiningarupplýsingarnar eftir að hafa breytt einhverju þeirra.

records.key: Everything that produces the cell mask: model and expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. The group to open when cells are missed, merged or split.
records.source: Everything that produces the cell mask: model and expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. The group to open when cells are missed, merged or split.
records.translation: Allt sem býr til frumugrímuna: líkan og áætlað þvermál, líkinda- og flæðiþröskuldar, fjarlæging bakgrunns og stærðar-, styrkleika- og jaðarsíurnar sem beitt er á eftir. Hópurinn sem á að opna þegar frumur gleymast, renna saman eða klofna.

records.key: Everything that produces the nucleus mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Usually the easiest object to get right, so a good sanity check on the channel assignment.
records.source: Everything that produces the nucleus mask: model and expected diameter, thresholds, background removal, and the size, intensity and border filters applied afterwards. Usually the easiest object to get right, so a good sanity check on the channel assignment.
records.translation: Allt sem býr til kjarnagrímuna: líkan og áætlað þvermál, þröskuldar, fjarlæging bakgrunns og stærðar-, styrkleika- og jaðarsíurnar sem beitt er á eftir. Yfirleitt auðveldasti hluturinn til að fá réttan, svo þetta er góð heilbrigðisathugun á úthlutun rása.

records.key: Expected a merged (height, width, channels) array for {field}; found shape {shape}.
records.source: Expected a merged (height, width, channels) array for {field}; found shape {shape}.
records.translation: Bjóst við sameinuðu fylki (hæð, breidd, rásir) fyrir {field}; fann lögunina {shape}.

records.key: Explore measurements using visualization, tabulation, gating and feature-analysis tools.
records.source: Explore measurements using visualization, tabulation, gating and feature-analysis tools.
records.translation: Kannaðu mælingar með sjónrænni framsetningu, töflugerð, valmörkum og verkfærum til eiginleikagreiningar.

records.key: Fade fields towards the right
records.source: Fade fields towards the right
records.translation: Láta sjónsvið dofna til hægri

records.key: Fetch the four-plate example screen and put its count tables and score tables into the two slots below. About 35 MB the first time; cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.source: Fetch the four-plate example screen and put its count tables and score tables into the two slots below. About 35 MB the first time; cached afterwards, so pressing it again is instant.
records.translation: Sækja dæmiskimunina með fjórum plötum og setja talningartöflur hennar og stigatöflur í raufarnar tvær hér fyrir neðan. Um 35 MB í fyrsta skipti; vistað í skyndiminni eftir það, svo það gerist samstundis ef ýtt er aftur.

records.key: Fewer wells than guides puts a joint guide fit below the information limit. Penalties, priors and groups do not create information. The permutation test is the exception because it tests one guide at a time.
records.source: Fewer wells than guides puts a joint guide fit below the information limit. Penalties, priors and groups do not create information. The permutation test is the exception because it tests one guide at a time.
records.translation: Færri brunnar en leiðsögu-RNA setja sameiginlega aðfellingu leiðsögu-RNA undir upplýsingamörkin. Refsingar, forlíkur og hópar búa ekki til upplýsingar. Umröðunarprófið er undantekningin vegna þess að það prófar eitt leiðsögu-RNA í einu.

records.key: Field / plane changed — run the preview to read it.
records.source: Field / plane changed — run the preview to read it.
records.translation: Sjónsvið / plan breyttist — keyrðu forskoðunina til að lesa það.

records.key: Field fade
records.source: Field fade
records.translation: Dofnun sjónsviða

records.key: Field of view — the (plate, well, field) group previewed. Each group is one time series. Lists a random sample of the plate, not all of it.
records.source: Field of view — the (plate, well, field) group previewed. Each group is one time series. Lists a random sample of the plate, not all of it.
records.translation: Sjónsvið — hópurinn (plata, brunnur, sjónsvið) sem er forskoðaður. Hver hópur er ein tímaröð. Listar slembiúrtak af plötunni, ekki hana alla.

records.key: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the image sets in this folder — set the sample size on its left.
records.source: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the image sets in this folder — set the sample size on its left.
records.translation: Sjónsvið. Listar slembiúrtak af myndasettunum í þessari möppu — stilltu úrtaksstærðina vinstra megin við það.

records.key: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the merged .npy arrays beside the loaded one; picking one loads it.
records.source: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the merged .npy arrays beside the loaded one; picking one loads it.
records.translation: Sjónsvið. Listar slembiúrtak af sameinuðu .npy-fylkjunum við hlið þess sem er hlaðið; ef eitt er valið er það hlaðið.

records.key: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the sequences sitting beside the loaded one; picking one loads it.
records.source: Field of view. Lists a random sample of the sequences sitting beside the loaded one; picking one loads it.
records.translation: Sjónsvið. Listar slembiúrtak af röðunum sem liggja við hlið þeirrar sem er hlaðin; ef ein er valin er hún hlaðin.

records.key: Fill the screen, or restore the previous size if the window is already maximised.
records.source: Fill the screen, or restore the previous size if the window is already maximised.
records.translation: Fylla skjáinn, eða endurheimta fyrri stærð ef glugginn er þegar hámarkaður.

records.key: Filter the columns — a channel, a shape, anything
records.source: Filter the columns — a channel, a shape, anything
records.translation: Sía dálkana — rás, lögun, hvað sem er

records.key: Find dense populations with DBSCAN and turn each one into a gate you can edit, nest and save like any other.
records.source: Find dense populations with DBSCAN and turn each one into a gate you can edit, nest and save like any other.
records.translation: Finndu þétta hópa með DBSCAN og breyttu hverjum þeirra í valmörk sem þú getur breytt, hreiðrað og vistað eins og öll önnur.

records.key: Fit a model on the labels made so far, score every crop with it, and re-rank the uncertainty queue — without leaving this screen. Held out by well, so the accuracy is not an artefact of labelling one field of view. Each round writes a model card.
records.source: Fit a model on the labels made so far, score every crop with it, and re-rank the uncertainty queue — without leaving this screen. Held out by well, so the accuracy is not an artefact of labelling one field of view. Each round writes a model card.
records.translation: Aðfelldu líkan á merkingarnar sem gerðar hafa verið hingað til, gefðu hverjum myndskurði stig með því og endurraðaðu óvissubiðröðinni — án þess að yfirgefa þennan skjá. Haldið til hliðar eftir brunni, svo nákvæmnin er ekki gervifrávik sem stafar af því að merkja eitt sjónsvið. Hver umferð skrifar líkanaspjald.

records.key: Fit boosted trees on the labels made so far and write the model's proposed label onto every crop you have not answered yet — most confident first, dashed rather than solid, and only where you have not already decided. Then keep them all, throw them all away, or answer the ones it got wrong one at a time.
records.source: Fit boosted trees on the labels made so far and write the model's proposed label onto every crop you have not answered yet — most confident first, dashed rather than solid, and only where you have not already decided. Then keep them all, throw them all away, or answer the ones it got wrong one at a time.
records.translation: Aðfelldu styrkt tré (boosted trees) á merkingarnar sem gerðar hafa verið hingað til og skrifaðu tillögu líkansins að merkingu á hvern myndskurð sem þú hefur ekki svarað enn — öruggustu fyrst, strikaðar frekar en heilar, og aðeins þar sem þú hefur ekki þegar ákveðið. Haltu þeim síðan öllum, hentu þeim öllum, eða svaraðu þeim sem það gerði rangt einni í einu.

records.key: Fit on every label you have made, but write suggestions only onto the crops in front of you. The model is the same either way — this narrows what you have to review, not what it learns.
records.source: Fit on every label you have made, but write suggestions only onto the crops in front of you. The model is the same either way — this narrows what you have to review, not what it learns.
records.translation: Aðfelldu á allar merkingar sem þú hefur gert, en skrifaðu tillögur aðeins á myndskurðina sem eru fyrir framan þig. Líkanið er það sama hvort sem er — þetta þrengir það sem þú þarft að yfirfara, ekki það sem það lærir.

records.key: Fitting on the labels so far, then suggesting…
records.source: Fitting on the labels so far, then suggesting…
records.translation: Mátar á merkingunum hingað til og stingur síðan upp á…

records.key: Fixes the sampling, the folds and the reducer, so the same seed reproduces the same sweep.
records.source: Fixes the sampling, the folds and the reducer, so the same seed reproduces the same sweep.
records.translation: Festir úrtökuna, brotin og víddarminnkunina, svo sama slembifræ endurskapar sömu skönnun.

records.key: Full screen (F11). The window has no title bar; drag the menu bar to move it.
records.source: Full screen (F11). The window has no title bar; drag the menu bar to move it.
records.translation: Allur skjárinn (F11). Glugginn hefur enga titilstiku; dragðu valmyndastikuna til að færa hann.

records.translation: Útflutningur valmarka: {summary}
