records.translation: Athugun á læsingu valmarka mistókst: {error}

records.key: Generate a reproducible example microscopy plate in the spaCR cache, then fill this form with its folder, channels, and acquisition settings. This operation does not require a network connection.
records.source: Generate a reproducible example microscopy plate in the spaCR cache, then fill this form with its folder, channels, and acquisition settings. This operation does not require a network connection.
records.translation: Búa til endurtakanlega dæmiplötu úr smásjá í skyndiminni spaCR og fylla síðan þetta form með möppu hennar, rásum og myndatökustillingum. Þessi aðgerð krefst ekki nettengingar.

records.key: Generate a training dataset from the current annotations and train a Torch CNN / Transformer classifier, then apply it to the full dataset. Opens the Classify screen with this source pre-selected.
records.source: Generate a training dataset from the current annotations and train a Torch CNN / Transformer classifier, then apply it to the full dataset. Opens the Classify screen with this source pre-selected.
records.translation: Búa til þjálfunargagnasafn úr núverandi merkingum og þjálfa Torch CNN / Transformer-flokkara og beita honum síðan á allt gagnasafnið. Opnar Classify-skjáinn með þessa uppsprettu forvalda.

records.key: Group-penalised least squares treats A GENE'S GUIDES AS ONE BLOCK, retaining or zeroing the whole block. group_lasso_lambda sets the penalty relative to group_lasso.max_lambda; hits use bootstrap selection frequency over lasso_n_boot resamples and lasso_selection_threshold.
records.source: Group-penalised least squares treats A GENE'S GUIDES AS ONE BLOCK, retaining or zeroing the whole block. group_lasso_lambda sets the penalty relative to group_lasso.max_lambda; hits use bootstrap selection frequency over lasso_n_boot resamples and lasso_selection_threshold.
records.translation: Hópsektuð minnstu kvaðröt meðhöndla LEIÐARA GENS SEM EINA BLOKK og halda allri blokkinni eða setja hana alla á núll. group_lasso_lambda stillir sektina miðað við group_lasso.max_lambda; marktækar niðurstöður byggja á bootstrap-valtíðni yfir lasso_n_boot endurúrtök og lasso_selection_threshold.

records.key: Hand the summary to the Graph Builder — one row per cell, one column per statistic
records.source: Hand the summary to the Graph Builder — one row per cell, one column per statistic
records.translation: Senda samantektina í Graph Builder — ein röð á hverja frumu, einn dálkur á hverja tölfræðistærð

records.key: Held-out cells
records.source: Held-out cells
records.translation: Frumur haldnar utan

records.key: Hide modules and settings that are in regular use but not yet signed off. Stable and Alpha features are unaffected.
records.source: Hide modules and settings that are in regular use but not yet signed off. Stable and Alpha features are unaffected.
records.translation: Fela einingar og stillingar sem eru í reglulegri notkun en hafa ekki enn verið samþykktar. Stable- og Alpha-eiginleikar verða ekki fyrir áhrifum.

records.key: How a tracked cell is called infected, uninfected or ambiguous — which strategy is used, which table it reads, and where the probability cutoffs are placed. The selected strategy determines which settings groups below are applicable.
records.source: How a tracked cell is called infected, uninfected or ambiguous — which strategy is used, which table it reads, and where the probability cutoffs are placed. The selected strategy determines which settings groups below are applicable.
records.translation: Hvernig rakin fruma er flokkuð sem sýkt, ósýkt eða óviss — hvaða aðferð er notuð, hvaða töflu hún les og hvar líkindamörkin eru sett. Valin aðferð ræður því hvaða stillingahópar hér fyrir neðan eiga við.

records.key: How each measurement combines when several child objects roll up onto one parent. Four pathogens in a cell: their areas SUM, their minimum intensity is the MINIMUM of the four, their mean is the mean. Change any row that is wrong for your data.
records.source: How each measurement combines when several child objects roll up onto one parent. Four pathogens in a cell: their areas SUM, their minimum intensity is the MINIMUM of the four, their mean is the mean. Change any row that is wrong for your data.
records.translation: Hvernig hver mæling er sameinuð þegar nokkrir undirhlutir eru teknir saman á eitt foreldri. Fjórir sýklar í frumu: flatarmál þeirra er lagt saman (SUM), lágmarksstyrkur þeirra er lágmark (MINIMUM) fjórmenninganna, meðaltal þeirra er meðaltalið. Breyttu hverri röð sem er röng fyrir þín gögn.

records.key: How each measurement combines when several children roll up onto one cell, and a dropdown to change any of it.
records.source: How each measurement combines when several children roll up onto one cell, and a dropdown to change any of it.
records.translation: Hvernig hver mæling er sameinuð þegar nokkrir undirhlutir eru teknir saman á eina frumu, og fellilisti til að breyta hverju sem er af því.

records.key: How externally generated images and label masks are found and paired — the input list, the project folder written to, recursion, plate and well layout, z handling and naming. Preview the mapping before writing anything; this is where a mismatched pairing is caught.
records.source: How externally generated images and label masks are found and paired — the input list, the project folder written to, recursion, plate and well layout, z handling and naming. Preview the mapping before writing anything; this is where a mismatched pairing is caught.
records.translation: Hvernig utanaðkomandi myndir og merkjagrímur eru fundnar og paraðar — inntakslistinn, verkefnamappan sem skrifað er í, endurkvæm leit, uppsetning platna og brunna, meðhöndlun z og nafngiftir. Forskoðaðu vörpunina áður en nokkuð er skrifað; hér kemur röng pörun í ljós.

records.key: How figures are rendered into the Figures panel. PDF also writes a vector page with TrueType-embedded text — sharper on screen when zoomed, and editable in Illustrator or Inkscape. Figures a pipeline saves to its results folder keep the format that pipeline chose and are not affected.
records.source: How figures are rendered into the Figures panel. PDF also writes a vector page with TrueType-embedded text — sharper on screen when zoomed, and editable in Illustrator or Inkscape. Figures a pipeline saves to its results folder keep the format that pipeline chose and are not affected.
records.translation: Hvernig myndrit eru teiknuð í Figures-spjaldið. PDF skrifar einnig vigursíðu með ívöfðum TrueType-texta — skarpari á skjánum við aðdrátt og breytanleg í Illustrator eða Inkscape. Myndrit sem ferli vistar í niðurstöðumöppu sína halda sniðinu sem ferlið valdi og verða ekki fyrir áhrifum.

records.key: How grouped parasites become a replication state: the largest vacuole accepted, the warning for biologically implausible counts, and whether wells with cells but no parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the mean.
records.source: How grouped parasites become a replication state: the largest vacuole accepted, the warning for biologically implausible counts, and whether wells with cells but no parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the mean.
records.translation: Hvernig hópuð sníkjudýr verða að fjölgunarstöðu: stærsta safabóla sem er samþykkt, viðvörunin um líffræðilega ósennilegar tölur og hvort brunnar með frumum en engum sníkjudýrum eru skráðir sem núll. Ef þeim brunnum er sleppt hækkar meðaltalið án þess að það sjáist.

records.key: How hard the run pushes the machine and what it does when a field fails — worker count, batch size, the tolerated failure rate, and how much it prints. Turn strict errors on while debugging; raise the failure tolerance for a plate with known-bad fields.
records.source: How hard the run pushes the machine and what it does when a field fails — worker count, batch size, the tolerated failure rate, and how much it prints. Turn strict errors on while debugging; raise the failure tolerance for a plate with known-bad fields.
records.translation: Hversu mikið álag keyrslan setur á vélina og hvað hún gerir þegar sjónsvið mistekst — fjöldi vinnsluferla, lotustærð, leyfilegt villuhlutfall og hversu mikið hún prentar. Kveiktu á ströngum villum við villuleit; hækkaðu villuþolið fyrir plötu með þekkt gölluð sjónsvið.

records.key: How individual parasites are grouped into vacuoles — an existing vacuole identifier, or a spatial link whose distance scales with parasite size — and whether a host cell is required. The whole replication readout rests on this grouping.
records.source: How individual parasites are grouped into vacuoles — an existing vacuole identifier, or a spatial link whose distance scales with parasite size — and whether a host cell is required. The whole replication readout rests on this grouping.
records.translation: Hvernig einstök sníkjudýr eru hópuð í safabólur — með fyrirliggjandi auðkenni safabólu eða rúmfræðilegri tengingu þar sem fjarlægðin fer eftir stærð sníkjudýrsins — og hvort hýsilfruma sé áskilin. Öll fjölgunarmælingin byggir á þessari hópun.

records.key:
How long something spaCR is holding — a merged frame, a loaded image, a model's weights — may sit unused before it is dropped. Zero drops it as soon as nothing needs it, which costs time when you go back to it.

This does NOT unload a library: a Python C extension cannot be unloaded, and nothing here pretends otherwise. What it governs is what spaCR chose to keep.

records.translation:
Hversu lengi eitthvað sem spaCR geymir — sameinaður rammi, hlaðin mynd, vægi líkans — má liggja ónotað áður en því er sleppt. Núll sleppir því um leið og ekkert þarf á því að halda, sem kostar tíma þegar þú ferð aftur í það.

Þetta afhleður EKKI safn: ekki er hægt að afhlaða C-viðbót í Python, og ekkert hér þykist annað. Það sem þetta stýrir er það sem spaCR valdi að geyma.

Tillaga:
{levels}

records.key: How many cells a well's montage puts on a row. The count stays the same whatever size the window is — a wider panel draws the same cells larger, up to their natural size, rather than fitting more of them in, so two wells are always laid out alike. How many ROWS fit is still measured, because that is what decides the page.
records.source: How many cells a well's montage puts on a row. The count stays the same whatever size the window is — a wider panel draws the same cells larger, up to their natural size, rather than fitting more of them in, so two wells are always laid out alike. How many ROWS fit is still measured, because that is what decides the page.
records.translation: Hve margar frumur myndasamsetning brunns setur í hverja röð. Fjöldinn helst sá sami hver sem stærð gluggans er — breiðara spjald teiknar sömu frumur stærri, upp að náttúrulegri stærð þeirra, í stað þess að koma fleiri fyrir, svo tveir brunnar eru alltaf eins uppsettir. Hve margar RAÐIR komast fyrir er samt mælt, því það ræður síðunni.

records.key: How many fields of view to stack. Each one keeps its own rendered frames in memory, so this is a memory setting as much as a layout one.
records.source: How many fields of view to stack. Each one keeps its own rendered frames in memory, so this is a memory setting as much as a layout one.
records.translation: Hve mörgum sjónsviðum á að stafla. Hvert þeirra geymir eigin teiknaða ramma í minni, svo þetta er jafnmikið minnisstilling og útlitsstilling.

records.key: How many fields the correction is estimated from and whether each plate gets its own estimate. More fields make a steadier surface and a slower run; per-plate estimates matter when plates were acquired in separate sessions.
records.source: How many fields the correction is estimated from and whether each plate gets its own estimate. More fields make a steadier surface and a slower run; per-plate estimates matter when plates were acquired in separate sessions.
records.translation: Út frá hve mörgum sjónsviðum leiðréttingin er metin og hvort hver plata fær eigið mat. Fleiri sjónsvið gefa stöðugri flöt og hægari keyrslu; mat fyrir hverja plötu skiptir máli þegar plötur voru myndaðar í aðskildum lotum.

records.key: How many files were read, how many distinct wells, fields and channels they hold, what could not be placed, and what was named unlike the rest and therefore not interpreted.
records.source: How many files were read, how many distinct wells, fields and channels they hold, what could not be placed, and what was named unlike the rest and therefore not interpreted.
records.translation: Hve margar skrár voru lesnar, hve marga ólíka brunna, sjónsvið og rásir þær innihalda, hvað var ekki hægt að staðsetja og hvað var nefnt öðruvísi en hitt og því ekki túlkað.

records.key: How many neighbours an object needs before it can seed a cluster. Raise it to stop debris forming populations of its own; lower it to keep a small real population.
records.source: How many neighbours an object needs before it can seed a cluster. Raise it to stop debris forming populations of its own; lower it to keep a small real population.
records.translation: Hve marga nágranna hlutur þarf áður en hann getur myndað kjarna klasa. Hækkaðu gildið til að koma í veg fyrir að rusl myndi eigin þýði; lækkaðu það til að halda litlu raunverulegu þýði.

records.key: How many reads each well is allotted. Too few and guide counts become noise before any biology is involved, which no amount of extra replicates recovers.
records.source: How many reads each well is allotted. Too few and guide counts become noise before any biology is involved, which no amount of extra replicates recovers.
records.translation: Hve marga lestra hver brunnur fær úthlutað. Of fáir, og talningar leiðara verða að suði áður en nokkur líffræði kemur við sögu, sem engar viðbótarendurtekningar bæta upp.

records.key: How many worker processes the assay uses. Lower it when the machine has other work to do.
records.source: How many worker processes the assay uses. Lower it when the machine has other work to do.
records.translation: Hve mörg vinnsluferli prófið notar. Lækkaðu gildið þegar vélin hefur annað að gera.

records.key: How much of the table to load. Drawing and hit-testing a million objects is what makes this module slow; a fifth of them is the same cloud. Gates are applied to EVERY object on export, whatever fraction was loaded.
records.source: How much of the table to load. Drawing and hit-testing a million objects is what makes this module slow; a fifth of them is the same cloud. Gates are applied to EVERY object on export, whatever fraction was loaded.
records.translation: Hve mikið af töflunni á að hlaða. Það sem gerir þessa einingu hæga er að teikna og prófa smelli á milljón hluti; fimmtungur þeirra myndar sama ský. Valmörkum er beitt á HVERN hlut við útflutning, hvaða hlutfall sem var hlaðið.

records.key: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up when a well comes out empty and you need to see which step discarded its parasites.
records.source: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up when a well comes out empty and you need to see which step discarded its parasites.
records.translation: Hve mikið prófið prentar meðan það keyrir. Auktu það þegar brunnur kemur tómur út og þú þarft að sjá hvaða skref henti sníkjudýrum hans.

records.key: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up while you are still deciding on a threshold and need to see which wells the controls were drawn from.
records.source: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up while you are still deciding on a threshold and need to see which wells the controls were drawn from.
records.translation: Hve mikið prófið prentar meðan það keyrir. Auktu það meðan þú ert enn að ákveða þröskuld og þarft að sjá úr hvaða brunnum viðmiðin voru tekin.

records.key: How object outlines are found: 'otsu' (fast threshold) or 'cellpose' (a small Cellpose model — cleaner, slower).
records.source: How object outlines are found: 'otsu' (fast threshold) or 'cellpose' (a small Cellpose model — cleaner, slower).
records.translation: Hvernig útlínur hluta eru fundnar: 'otsu' (hraður þröskuldur) eða 'cellpose' (lítið Cellpose-líkan — hreinna, hægara).

records.key: How saved figures handle their background, text and lines. Print uses a light page with dark figure elements; Screen keeps the colours shown in spaCR; Transparent removes the page and chooses figure-element colours for the current theme. SPACR_FIGURE_SAVE_MODE can temporarily override this setting for command-line and notebook runs.
records.source: How saved figures handle their background, text and lines. Print uses a light page with dark figure elements; Screen keeps the colours shown in spaCR; Transparent removes the page and chooses figure-element colours for the current theme. SPACR_FIGURE_SAVE_MODE can temporarily override this setting for command-line and notebook runs.
records.translation: Hvernig vistuð myndrit fara með bakgrunn, texta og línur. Print notar ljósa síðu með dökkum myndritsþáttum; Screen heldur litunum sem sýndir eru í spaCR; Transparent fjarlægir síðuna og velur liti myndritsþátta fyrir núverandi þema. SPACR_FIGURE_SAVE_MODE getur tímabundið hnekkt þessari stillingu fyrir keyrslur á skipanalínu og í vinnubókum.

records.key: How solid cards, settings sections, consoles, previews and the rounded Home panel are. This applies in every theme, including Glass, Space, Cell, Dark and Light. In Glass this controls material strength while preserving its designed translucency; in other themes it is literal surface opacity. A surface will not go thinner than the point where its text stops clearing WCAG AA over the background.
records.source: How solid cards, settings sections, consoles, previews and the rounded Home panel are. This applies in every theme, including Glass, Space, Cell, Dark and Light. In Glass this controls material strength while preserving its designed translucency; in other themes it is literal surface opacity. A surface will not go thinner than the point where its text stops clearing WCAG AA over the background.
records.translation: Hversu þétt spjöld, stillingahlutar, stjórnborð, forskoðanir og ávala Home-spjaldið eru. Þetta gildir í öllum þemum, þar á meðal Glass, Space, Cell, Dark og Light. Í Glass stýrir þetta styrk efnisins en varðveitir hannað gegnsæi þess; í öðrum þemum er það bókstaflegt ógegnsæi flatarins. Flötur verður ekki þynnri en að þeim punkti þar sem texti hans uppfyllir ekki lengur WCAG AA gagnvart bakgrunninum.

records.key: How strongly the rain shows through behind the screen content. Higher is more visible; too high and the settings in front of it get harder to read.
records.source: How strongly the rain shows through behind the screen content. Higher is more visible; too high and the settings in front of it get harder to read.
records.translation: Hversu sterkt regnið sést í gegn á bak við efni skjásins. Hærra gildi er sýnilegra; of hátt og stillingarnar fyrir framan verða erfiðari aflestrar.

records.key: How the axis is laid out. These change the spacing, never the values, so a gate drawn before the change still selects the same objects. 'log' is skipped on a measurement that reaches zero, where it would draw nothing at all.
records.source: How the axis is laid out. These change the spacing, never the values, so a gate drawn before the change still selects the same objects. 'log' is skipped on a measurement that reaches zero, where it would draw nothing at all.
records.translation: Hvernig ásinn er settur upp. Þetta breytir bilunum, aldrei gildunum, svo valmörk sem teiknuð voru fyrir breytinguna velja enn sömu hluti. 'log' er sleppt fyrir mælingu sem nær núlli, þar sem hann myndi ekkert teikna.

records.key: How the cell mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds. What is done to the channel first, and which of the masks it produces are kept, are under Advanced settings, where the same choices for the other objects sit beside them. Open it when cells are missed, merged into their neighbours, or split in two.
records.source: How the cell mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds. What is done to the channel first, and which of the masks it produces are kept, are under Advanced settings, where the same choices for the other objects sit beside them. Open it when cells are missed, merged into their neighbours, or split in two.
records.translation: Hvernig frumugríman er fundin — líkan, áætlað þvermál, líkinda- og flæðisþröskuldar. Hvað er fyrst gert við rásina og hvaða grímum sem hún framleiðir er haldið er undir Advanced settings, þar sem sömu valkostir fyrir hina hlutina eru við hliðina. Opnaðu það þegar frumur missast, renna saman við nágranna sína eða klofna í tvennt.

records.key: How the cells are drawn: channels, size, normalisation, outlines. The same settings the annotation application offers, under the same names. What the chosen mode cannot use is greyed with the reason rather than hidden.
records.source: How the cells are drawn: channels, size, normalisation, outlines. The same settings the annotation application offers, under the same names. What the chosen mode cannot use is greyed with the reason rather than hidden.
records.translation: Hvernig frumurnar eru teiknaðar: rásir, stærð, stöðlun, útlínur. Sömu stillingar og merkingarforritið býður, undir sömu heitum. Það sem valinn hamur getur ekki notað er gráað með ástæðu frekar en falið.

records.key: How the estimate itself is produced — the level the score is computed at, the backend that runs it, and the random seed. Fix the seed when you want two designs compared rather than two draws.
records.source: How the estimate itself is produced — the level the score is computed at, the backend that runs it, and the random seed. Fix the seed when you want two designs compared rather than two draws.
records.translation: Hvernig matið sjálft er framleitt — stigið sem skorið er reiknað á, bakendinn sem keyrir það og slembifræið. Festu slembifræið þegar þú vilt bera saman tvær hannanir frekar en tvö úrtök.

records.key: How the library is spread over physical plates — wells per plate, plate count, replicates and cells sampled per well. These values determine the physical plate and acquisition requirements.
records.source: How the library is spread over physical plates — wells per plate, plate count, replicates and cells sampled per well. These values determine the physical plate and acquisition requirements.
records.translation: Hvernig safninu er dreift á efnislegar plötur — brunnar á plötu, fjöldi platna, endurtekningar og frumur teknar í úrtak á hvern brunn. Þessi gildi ákvarða kröfur um efnislegar plötur og myndatöku.

records.key: How the measurement behaves. A proportion's or a count's cell variance follows its mean, so the effect is the signed change from the pilot mean. Default Continuous.
records.source: How the measurement behaves. A proportion's or a count's cell variance follows its mean, so the effect is the signed change from the pilot mean. Default Continuous.
records.translation: Hvernig mælingin hegðar sér. Dreifni hlutfalls eða talningar milli frumna fylgir meðaltali hennar, svo áhrifin eru formerkt breyting frá meðaltali forprófunar. Sjálfgefið Continuous.

records.key: How the model is fitted — epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.source: How the model is fitted — epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.translation: Hvernig líkanið er mátað — þjálfunarlotur, námshraði, áætlun og hvaða tapfall. Opnaðu það þegar þjálfun er óstöðug, staðnar eða hunsar minni flokkinn.

records.key: How the model is fitted: epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.source: How the model is fitted: epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.translation: Hvernig líkanið er mátað: þjálfunarlotur, námshraði, áætlun og hvaða tapfall. Opnaðu það þegar þjálfun er óstöðug, staðnar eða hunsar minni flokkinn.

records.key: How the nucleus mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Nuclei are the easiest object to get right, so they are a good place to check the channel assignment.
records.source: How the nucleus mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Nuclei are the easiest object to get right, so they are a good place to check the channel assignment.
records.translation: Hvernig kjarnagríman er fundin — líkan, áætlað þvermál, líkinda- og flæðisþröskuldar; forvinnsla rásarinnar og stærðarsíurnar eru undir Advanced settings. Kjarnar eru auðveldasti hluturinn að ná réttum, svo þeir eru góður staður til að athuga úthlutun rása.

records.key: How the pathogen mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Tightly packed parasites fusing into one object are the usual reason to come here.
records.source: How the pathogen mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Tightly packed parasites fusing into one object are the usual reason to come here.
records.translation: Hvernig sýklagríman er fundin — líkan, áætlað þvermál, líkinda- og flæðisþröskuldar; forvinnsla rásarinnar og stærðarsíurnar eru undir Advanced settings. Þétt pökkuð sníkjudýr sem renna saman í einn hlut eru algengasta ástæðan fyrir því að koma hingað.

records.key: How wells that received too few reads are detected and whether they are dropped before the rest of the analysis. Leaving them in drags every plate-level summary toward noise, so exclude them once you trust the read floor above.
records.source: How wells that received too few reads are detected and whether they are dropped before the rest of the analysis. Leaving them in drags every plate-level summary toward noise, so exclude them once you trust the read floor above.
records.translation: Hvernig brunnar sem fengu of fáa lestra eru greindir og hvort þeim er sleppt áður en restin af greiningunni fer fram. Ef þeir eru hafðir með dregst hver samantekt á plötustigi í átt að suði, svo útilokaðu þá þegar þú treystir lestralágmarkinu hér að ofan.

records.key: Image channels measured from the merged array.
records.source: Image channels measured from the merged array.
records.translation: Myndrásir sem mældar eru úr sameinaða fylkinu.

records.key: Image channels to put in the crop, in order. Three make an RGB picture; one makes greyscale.
records.source: Image channels to put in the crop, in order. Three make an RGB picture; one makes greyscale.
records.translation: Myndrásir sem setja á í myndskurðinn, í röð. Þrjár mynda RGB-mynd; ein myndar grátóna.

records.key: Image crops
records.source: Image crops
records.translation: Myndskurðir

records.key: Image linking is unavailable without verified spaCR image/object provenance; tabular plotting and gating remain available.
records.source: Image linking is unavailable without verified spaCR image/object provenance; tabular plotting and gating remain available.
records.translation: Tenging við myndir er ekki tiltæk án staðfests uppruna mynda/hluta í spaCR; teikning úr töflum og valmörk eru áfram tiltæk.

records.key: Image/object navigation is unavailable: this merge has no verified spaCR image provenance. Plotting and tabular gating remain available.
records.source: Image/object navigation is unavailable: this merge has no verified spaCR image provenance. Plotting and tabular gating remain available.
records.translation: Leiðsögn um myndir/hluti er ekki tiltæk: þessi sameining hefur engan staðfestan uppruna mynda í spaCR. Teikning og valmörk á töflum eru áfram tiltæk.

records.key: Import images and tables into spaCR projects and execute reproducible multi-plate workflows.
records.source: Import images and tables into spaCR projects and execute reproducible multi-plate workflows.
records.translation: Flytja myndir og töflur inn í spaCR-verkefni og keyra endurtakanleg verkferli fyrir margar plötur.

records.key: Increase Maximum preview crops to include every checked image.
records.source: Increase Maximum preview crops to include every checked image.
records.translation: Hækkaðu Maximum preview crops til að taka með hverja hakaða mynd.

records.key: Input fields ignore Page opacity and dissolve instead: solid where the value starts, fully transparent at their right edge, fading faster the further right it goes. The outline fades with the box; the text inside never fades. Clear this for plain opaque fields.
records.source: Input fields ignore Page opacity and dissolve instead: solid where the value starts, fully transparent at their right edge, fading faster the further right it goes. The outline fades with the box; the text inside never fades. Clear this for plain opaque fields.
records.translation: Innsláttarreitir hunsa Page opacity og dofna í staðinn: heilir þar sem gildið byrjar, alveg gegnsæir við hægri brún sína og dofna hraðar eftir því sem lengra er farið til hægri. Útlínan dofnar með reitnum; textinn inni í honum dofnar aldrei. Hreinsaðu þetta fyrir venjulega ógegnsæja reiti.

records.key: Join the crop table: its path and its classification score. Every morphological measurement is in the object tables beside it, and the score is not in any of them.
records.source: Join the crop table: its path and its classification score. Every morphological measurement is in the object tables beside it, and the score is not in any of them.
records.translation: Tengja myndskurðatöfluna: slóð hans og flokkunarskor. Allar formfræðimælingar eru í hlutatöflunum við hliðina, og skorið er ekki í neinni þeirra.

records.key: Keep uninfected cells. Off marks them as excluded.
records.source: Keep uninfected cells. Off marks them as excluded.
records.translation: Halda ósýktum frumum. Slökkt merkir þær sem útilokaðar.

records.key: Kernel containment is unavailable because systemd-run --user --scope could not be started. This is common in containers and SSH sessions without a user manager. Thread limits and the free-memory check still apply, but they cannot prevent a single trial from exhausting system memory. Reduce the worker count or run the sweep from a systemd user session before using a large search space.
records.source: Kernel containment is unavailable because systemd-run --user --scope could not be started. This is common in containers and SSH sessions without a user manager. Thread limits and the free-memory check still apply, but they cannot prevent a single trial from exhausting system memory. Reduce the worker count or run the sweep from a systemd user session before using a large search space.
records.translation: Kjarnaafmörkun (kernel containment) er ekki tiltæk vegna þess að ekki tókst að ræsa systemd-run --user --scope. Þetta er algengt í gámum og SSH-lotum án notendastjóra. Takmörk á þráðum og athugun á lausu minni gilda áfram, en þau geta ekki komið í veg fyrir að ein tilraun klári minni kerfisins. Fækkaðu vinnsluferlum eða keyrðu skönnunina úr systemd-notendalotu áður en stórt leitarrými er notað.

records.key: Keys a filter is merged back onto the object tables with. The object label alone repeats in every field, so dropping a key merges objects that are not the same object.
records.source: Keys a filter is merged back onto the object tables with. The object label alone repeats in every field, so dropping a key merges objects that are not the same object.
records.translation: Lyklar sem sía er tengd aftur á hlutatöflurnar með. Merki hlutar eitt og sér endurtekur sig í hverju sjónsviði, svo ef lykli er sleppt eru sameinaðir hlutir sem eru ekki sami hluturinn.

records.key: L1-penalised least squares sets coefficients to zero; alpha='auto' selects the penalty by 5-fold cross-validation. It reports bootstrap selection frequency across lasso_n_boot resamples, not p-values, and applies lasso_selection_threshold.
records.source: L1-penalised least squares sets coefficients to zero; alpha='auto' selects the penalty by 5-fold cross-validation. It reports bootstrap selection frequency across lasso_n_boot resamples, not p-values, and applies lasso_selection_threshold.
records.translation: L1-sektuð minnstu kvaðröt setja stuðla á núll; alpha='auto' velur sektina með 5-brota krossprófun. Hún tilkynnir bootstrap-valtíðni yfir lasso_n_boot endurúrtök, ekki p-gildi, og beitir lasso_selection_threshold.

records.key: LOAD IMAGES reads the crops the measure step exported under data/. STREAM IMAGES cuts them out of merged/*.npy as the page is drawn, which needs no export. Either mode falls back to the other when its folder is missing, and says which route drew.
records.source: LOAD IMAGES reads the crops the measure step exported under data/. STREAM IMAGES cuts them out of merged/*.npy as the page is drawn, which needs no export. Either mode falls back to the other when its folder is missing, and says which route drew.
records.translation: LOAD IMAGES les myndskurðina sem mælingaskrefið flutti út undir data/. STREAM IMAGES sker þá út úr merged/*.npy um leið og síðan er teiknuð, sem þarf engan útflutning. Hvor hamur fellur aftur á hinn þegar mappa hans finnst ekki, og segir hvor leiðin teiknaði.

records.key: Label (optional) — e.g. 'plate 3 mask, 30 px'
records.source: Label (optional) — e.g. 'plate 3 mask, 30 px'
records.translation: Merki (valfrjálst) — t.d. 'plate 3 mask, 30 px'

records.key: Label a whole population at once — by metadata, by measurement thresholds, by a gate, or by UMAP cluster.
records.source: Label a whole population at once — by metadata, by measurement thresholds, by a gate, or by UMAP cluster.
records.translation: Merkja heilt þýði í einu — eftir lýsigögnum, eftir mæliþröskuldum, eftir valmörkum eða eftir UMAP-klasa.

records.key: Label written to the output column for this condition. Use a nonempty label; several boxes may assign the same label.
records.source: Label written to the output column for this condition. Use a nonempty label; several boxes may assign the same label.
records.translation: Merki sem skrifað er í úttaksdálkinn fyrir þetta skilyrði. Notaðu merki sem er ekki tómt; nokkrir reitir mega úthluta sama merki.

records.key: Leave empty for a one-parameter histogram, which is what a threshold gate is drawn on.
records.source: Leave empty for a one-parameter histogram, which is what a threshold gate is drawn on.
records.translation: Hafðu autt fyrir súlurit með einni breytu, sem er það sem þröskuldsvalmörk eru teiknuð á.

records.key: Leave out a guide present in more than this share of the wells. Highly prevalent guides can have much greater precision than rare guides and may be associated with many measurements. Use the 'hits vs representation' view to choose a threshold from this screen rather than assuming prevalence is harmless.
records.source: Leave out a guide present in more than this share of the wells. Highly prevalent guides can have much greater precision than rare guides and may be associated with many measurements. Use the 'hits vs representation' view to choose a threshold from this screen rather than assuming prevalence is harmless.
records.translation: Sleppa leiðara sem er til staðar í stærri hluta brunna en þetta. Mjög algengir leiðarar geta haft mun meiri nákvæmni en sjaldgæfir leiðarar og geta tengst mörgum mælingum. Notaðu 'hits vs representation'-sýnina til að velja þröskuld út frá þessari skimun frekar en að gera ráð fyrir að algengi sé skaðlaust.

records.key: Legacy BGR (old unmarked crops)
records.source: Legacy BGR (old unmarked crops)
records.translation: Legacy BGR (gamlir ómerktir myndskurðir)

records.key: Line style used for significance or effect-size thresholds.
records.source: Line style used for significance or effect-size thresholds.
records.translation: Línustíll fyrir þröskulda marktækni eða áhrifastærðar.

records.key: Linking masks of the same object across frames when the data has a time axis. Only relevant to a time series; a single-timepoint plate ignores it.
records.source: Linking masks of the same object across frames when the data has a time axis. Only relevant to a time series; a single-timepoint plate ignores it.
records.translation: Tengir grímur sama hlutar milli ramma þegar gögnin hafa tímaás. Á aðeins við um tímaraðir; plata með einum tímapunkti hunsar þetta.

records.key: Links a selected regression run, gene, phenotype direction, false-discovery rate, and guide support to measured cells. The initial output ranks candidates by their scores. An optional hierarchical mixture model estimates cross-fitted hit-like probabilities without equating sequencing fraction with cell prevalence. Comparisons treat wells as independent units, and stored calls are versioned without replacing manual annotations.
records.source: Links a selected regression run, gene, phenotype direction, false-discovery rate, and guide support to measured cells. The initial output ranks candidates by their scores. An optional hierarchical mixture model estimates cross-fitted hit-like probabilities without equating sequencing fraction with cell prevalence. Comparisons treat wells as independent units, and stored calls are versioned without replacing manual annotations.
records.translation: Tengir valda aðhvarfskeyrslu, gen, stefnu svipgerðar, hlutfall falskra uppgötvana og stuðning leiðara við mældar frumur. Fyrsta úttakið raðar kandídötum eftir skori þeirra. Valfrjálst stigskipt blöndulíkan metur krossmátaðar líkur á að um marktæka niðurstöðu sé að ræða án þess að leggja raðgreiningarhlutfall að jöfnu við algengi frumna. Samanburðir meðhöndla brunna sem óháðar einingar, og vistaðar flokkanir eru útgáfustýrðar án þess að koma í stað handvirkra merkinga.

records.key: Load a gating strategy
records.source: Load a gating strategy
records.translation: Hlaða valmarkastefnu

records.key: Load a table and press Scan. Everything printed here — the counts, the thresholds and the caveats — comes from spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model, which is also the headless entry point.
records.source: Load a table and press Scan. Everything printed here — the counts, the thresholds and the caveats — comes from spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model, which is also the headless entry point.
records.translation: Hlaðaðu töflu og ýttu á Scan. Allt sem prentast hér — talningarnar, þröskuldarnir og fyrirvararnir — kemur frá spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model, sem er líka aðgangspunkturinn án viðmóts.

records.key: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.source: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.translation: Hlaðaðu töflu eða notaðu Merge tables til að búa til vinnusafn með staðfestum lyklum og samantekt. Skilgreindu þröskulds- eða marghyrningsvalmörk á raunverulegum eiginleika-/hnitadálkum og beittu síðan vistuðu valmörkunum á samhæfa hluti. Notaðu Annotate til að skrifa sýnd valmörk í merkingadálk; farðu yfir valda hluti og veldu tvíkosta eða fjölflokka merki.

records.key: Load crops first
records.source: Load crops first
records.translation: Hlaða myndskurðum fyrst

records.key: Load crops first.
records.source: Load crops first.
records.translation: Hlaða myndskurðum fyrst.

records.key: Look something up or administer work that already exists: run history, the pipeline graph, the database browser, reports and the job runners.
records.source: Look something up or administer work that already exists: run history, the pipeline graph, the database browser, reports and the job runners.
records.translation: Fletta einhverju upp eða stjórna verkum sem þegar eru til: keyrslusaga, ferlagrafið, gagnagrunnsvafrinn, skýrslur og verkkeyrarar.

records.key: MAGeCK alpha-RRA ranks guides across the screen, then scores each gene from its strongest ranks within rra_alpha. It builds an empirical null with rra_permutations for each guide count and reports depletion and enrichment separately.
records.source: MAGeCK alpha-RRA ranks guides across the screen, then scores each gene from its strongest ranks within rra_alpha. It builds an empirical null with rra_permutations for each guide count and reports depletion and enrichment separately.
records.translation: MAGeCK alpha-RRA raðar leiðurum yfir alla skimunina og skorar síðan hvert gen út frá sterkustu sætum þess innan rra_alpha. Það byggir reynslubundna núlldreifingu með rra_permutations fyrir hvern fjölda leiðara og tilkynnir tæmingu og auðgun sérstaklega.

records.key: MEASURED 2026-08-18: {small_genes} genes/{small_wells} wells took {small_ols:g}s as ols and {small_mixed:g}s as mixed ({small_ratio:g}x); {big_genes}/{big_wells}, {big_ols:g}s against {big_mixed:g}s ({big_ratio:g}x) -- and both were gene level only. This fit adds a random effect per guide too, so {guides} guides over {wells} wells is tens of minutes to hours. Single-threaded REML: one core at 100% is a healthy fit, not a hang. For an answer now, use ols at level='both'.
records.source: MEASURED 2026-08-18: {small_genes} genes/{small_wells} wells took {small_ols:g}s as ols and {small_mixed:g}s as mixed ({small_ratio:g}x); {big_genes}/{big_wells}, {big_ols:g}s against {big_mixed:g}s ({big_ratio:g}x) -- and both were gene level only. This fit adds a random effect per guide too, so {guides} guides over {wells} wells is tens of minutes to hours. Single-threaded REML: one core at 100% is a healthy fit, not a hang. For an answer now, use ols at level='both'.
records.translation: MÆLT 2026-08-18: {small_genes} gen/{small_wells} brunnar tóku {small_ols:g}s sem ols og {small_mixed:g}s sem mixed ({small_ratio:g}x); {big_genes}/{big_wells}, {big_ols:g}s á móti {big_mixed:g}s ({big_ratio:g}x) -- og hvort tveggja var aðeins á genastigi. Þessi mátun bætir líka við slembiáhrifum fyrir hvern leiðara, svo {guides} leiðarar yfir {wells} brunna taka tugi mínútna til klukkustunda. REML í einum þræði: einn kjarni á 100% er eðlileg mátun, ekki frosin. Fyrir svar strax, notaðu ols með level='both'.

records.key: Map sequencing reads to gRNA barcodes and link them to screen wells.
records.source: Map sequencing reads to gRNA barcodes and link them to screen wells.
records.translation: Varpa raðgreiningarlestrum á gRNA-strikamerki og tengja þá við brunna skimunarinnar.

records.key: Marks the objects inside each shown gate. The rest of the cloud stays on screen either way — a gate highlights, it never hides.
records.source: Marks the objects inside each shown gate. The rest of the cloud stays on screen either way — a gate highlights, it never hides.
records.translation: Merkir hlutina innan hverra sýndra valmarka. Restin af skýinu helst á skjánum hvort sem er — valmörk auðkenna, þau fela aldrei.

records.key:
Maximum images shown at once.

Shift-click cells to show several together; shift-clicking a row header takes every channel of that field, a column header every field of that channel. Whatever the selection, this many are drawn.
records.source:
Maximum images shown at once.

Shift-click cells to show several together; shift-clicking a row header takes every channel of that field, a column header every field of that channel. Whatever the selection, this many are drawn.
records.translation:
Hámarksfjöldi mynda sem sýndar eru í einu.

Shift-smelltu á reiti til að sýna nokkra saman; shift-smellur á línuhaus tekur allar rásir þess sjónsviðs, á dálkhaus öll sjónsvið þeirrar rásar. Hvert sem valið er eru svona margar teiknaðar.

records.key:
Maximum number of image sets loaded by the preview.

For large experiments, filenames are grouped into image sets comprising one field of view and all of its channels. The specified number of sets is sampled across the plate; files outside the sample are not opened.

Sampling is deterministic: the same folder and maximum produce the same sets. Changing the maximum selects a new sample, whereas re-rendering with the same settings preserves the selection.
records.source:
Maximum number of image sets loaded by the preview.

For large experiments, filenames are grouped into image sets comprising one field of view and all of its channels. The specified number of sets is sampled across the plate; files outside the sample are not opened.

Sampling is deterministic: the same folder and maximum produce the same sets. Changing the maximum selects a new sample, whereas re-rendering with the same settings preserves the selection.
records.translation:
Hámarksfjöldi myndasafna sem forskoðunin hleður.

Í stórum tilraunum eru skráarheiti flokkuð í myndasöfn sem samanstanda af einu sjónsviði og öllum rásum þess. Tilgreindur fjöldi safna er tekinn í úrtak yfir plötuna; skrár utan úrtaksins eru ekki opnaðar.

Úrtakan er ákveðin: sama mappa og sama hámark gefa sömu söfn. Ef hámarkinu er breytt er nýtt úrtak valið, en endurteiknun með sömu stillingum heldur valinu.

records.key: Maximum number of objects in one montage. For merged image sources, input/output cost depends primarily on the number of source fields accessed rather than the number of crops. A montage spanning many wells can therefore be expensive even when it contains few crops from each well.
records.source: Maximum number of objects in one montage. For merged image sources, input/output cost depends primarily on the number of source fields accessed rather than the number of crops. A montage spanning many wells can therefore be expensive even when it contains few crops from each well.
records.translation: Hámarksfjöldi hluta í einni myndasamsetningu. Fyrir sameinaðar myndauppsprettur fer inntaks-/úttakskostnaður fyrst og fremst eftir fjölda upprunasjónsviða sem lesin eru frekar en fjölda myndskurða. Myndasamsetning sem nær yfir marga brunna getur því verið dýr jafnvel þegar hún inniheldur fáa myndskurði úr hverjum brunni.

records.key: Maximum number of similar crops; the reference crop is shown separately.
records.source: Maximum number of similar crops; the reference crop is shown separately.
records.translation: Hámarksfjöldi svipaðra myndskurða; viðmiðunarmyndskurðurinn er sýndur sér.

records.key: Measure is running. Stop or finish that run before changing which fields it can see.
records.source: Measure is running. Stop or finish that run before changing which fields it can see.
records.translation: Measure er í keyrslu. Stöðvaðu eða kláraðu þá keyrslu áður en þú breytir því hvaða sjónsvið hún sér.

records.key: Measurement thresholds
records.source: Measurement thresholds
records.translation: Mæliþröskuldar

records.key: Metadata (plate, row, column, field)
records.source: Metadata (plate, row, column, field)
records.translation: Lýsigögn (plata, röð, dálkur, sjónsvið)

records.key: Name the independent observational unit used by the test. Use wells rather than individual cells when wells are the replicates; treating correlated cells as independent can greatly overstate significance.
records.source: Name the independent observational unit used by the test. Use wells rather than individual cells when wells are the replicates; treating correlated cells as independent can greatly overstate significance.
records.translation: Nefndu óháðu athuganaeininguna sem prófið notar. Notaðu brunna frekar en einstakar frumur þegar brunnarnir eru endurtekningarnar; ef fylgnar frumur eru meðhöndlaðar sem óháðar getur marktækni verið stórlega ofmetin.

records.key: Needs a positive and a negative level selected below. Charts the per-plate assay window rather than one control's level.
records.source: Needs a positive and a negative level selected below. Charts the per-plate assay window rather than one control's level.
records.translation: Krefst þess að jákvætt og neikvætt stig séu valin hér fyrir neðan. Sýnir prófgluggann fyrir hverja plötu frekar en stig eins viðmiðs.

records.key: Next flagged field (Right arrow)
records.source: Next flagged field (Right arrow)
records.translation: Næsta flaggaða sjónsvið (hægri ör)

records.key: No (plate, well, field) group has two or more time points — a motility preview needs a time series.
records.source: No (plate, well, field) group has two or more time points — a motility preview needs a time series.
records.translation: Enginn (plate, well, field)-hópur hefur tvo eða fleiri tímapunkta — forskoðun hreyfanleika þarf tímaröð.

records.key: No flagged fields
records.source: No flagged fields
records.translation: Engin flögguð sjónsvið

records.key: No plate loaded — drop a folder holding merged/*.npy here, or choose one
records.source: No plate loaded — drop a folder holding merged/*.npy here, or choose one
records.translation: Engin plata hlaðin — slepptu hér möppu sem inniheldur merged/*.npy, eða veldu eina

records.key: No run yet — set the design and press Run.
records.source: No run yet — set the design and press Run.
records.translation: Engin keyrsla enn — stilltu hönnunina og ýttu á Run.

records.key: No z-stacks here — every field has one plane per channel, so there is nothing to project.
records.source: No z-stacks here — every field has one plane per channel, so there is nothing to project.
records.translation: Engir z-staflar hér — hvert sjónsvið hefur eitt plan á hverja rás, svo það er ekkert að varpa.

records.key: Non-cutting guides define the screen's empirical null and are distinct from negative-control gene knockouts. A gene name selects all associated guides; a guide name selects only that guide. Specifying these controls estimates effects relative to the empirical null rather than zero.
records.source: Non-cutting guides define the screen's empirical null and are distinct from negative-control gene knockouts. A gene name selects all associated guides; a guide name selects only that guide. Specifying these controls estimates effects relative to the empirical null rather than zero.
records.translation: Leiðarar sem skera ekki skilgreina reynslubundna núlldreifingu skimunarinnar og eru aðgreindir frá genaútslætti neikvæðra viðmiða. Heiti gens velur alla tengda leiðara; heiti leiðara velur aðeins þann leiðara. Ef þessi viðmið eru tilgreind eru áhrif metin miðað við reynslubundnu núlldreifinguna frekar en núll.

records.key: Nothing can show crops yet — open the Annotate screen once.
records.source: Nothing can show crops yet — open the Annotate screen once.
records.translation: Ekkert getur sýnt myndskurði enn — opnaðu Annotate-skjáinn einu sinni.

records.key: Nothing searched yet. The search reads a bounded sample, so it costs seconds rather than a run.
records.source: Nothing searched yet. The search reads a bounded sample, so it costs seconds rather than a run.
records.translation: Ekkert leitað enn. Leitin les takmarkað úrtak, svo hún kostar sekúndur frekar en heila keyrslu.

records.key: Nothing to export — run a PCA first.
records.source: Nothing to export — run a PCA first.
records.translation: Ekkert að flytja út — keyrðu fyrst PCA.

records.source: Nothing to export — run a Scan first.

records.key: Nothing to run — every item is already finished.

records.translation: Ekkert að keyra — öllum atriðum er þegar lokið.

records.translation: Kjarni (aukahlutur)

records.key: Number of highest-ranked points labelled by name.

records.translation: Fjöldi hæst röðuðu punkta sem merktir eru með heiti.

records.source: Object-shaped crops follow the object's mask boundary and preserve its morphology. A source containing coordinates but no masks supports bounding-box crops only; object-shaped mode is disabled with an explanation for such sources.
records.translation: Myndskurðir í lögun hlutar fylgja grímumörkum hlutarins og varðveita formgerð hans. Uppspretta sem inniheldur hnit en engar grímur styður aðeins myndskurði eftir afmörkunarramma; hamur í lögun hlutar er óvirkur með skýringu fyrir slíkar uppsprettur.

records.key: Objects included in the plot. 'gRNAs' displays only objects annotated with the guides selected on the volcano. 'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells' also displays the remaining objects from those wells with a distinct encoding. Comparing objects within the same wells controls for their shared plate, acquisition, staining, and imaging conditions.
records.source: Objects included in the plot. 'gRNAs' displays only objects annotated with the guides selected on the volcano. 'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells' also displays the remaining objects from those wells with a distinct encoding. Comparing objects within the same wells controls for their shared plate, acquisition, staining, and imaging conditions.

'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells' sýnir einnig aðra hluti úr þeim brunnum með aðgreindri framsetningu. Samanburður hluta innan sömu brunna leiðréttir fyrir sameiginlegum plötu-, myndatöku-, litunar- og myndgreiningaraðstæðum.

records.key: Objects needed to seed a population. Anything sparser is treated as debris and left out of every gate.
records.source: Objects needed to seed a population. Anything sparser is treated as debris and left out of every gate.
records.translation: Fjöldi hluta sem þarf til að mynda kjarna þýðis. Allt sem er gisnara er meðhöndlað sem rusl og haft utan allra valmarka.

records.key: On, the crop is the rectangle around the object and keeps whatever else falls inside it. Off, everything outside the mask is removed -- which only the array source can do.
records.source: On, the crop is the rectangle around the object and keeps whatever else falls inside it. Off, everything outside the mask is removed -- which only the array source can do.
records.translation: Kveikt: myndskurðurinn er ferhyrningurinn umhverfis hlutinn og heldur öllu öðru sem lendir innan hans. Slökkt: allt utan grímunnar er fjarlægt -- sem aðeins fylkisuppsprettan getur gert.

records.source: On: objects are brighter than background, as in fluorescence. Off: take the dark side instead, for brightfield or stain.
records.translation: Kveikt: hlutir eru bjartari en bakgrunnur, eins og í flúrljómun. Slökkt: taka dökku hliðina í staðinn, fyrir bjartsvið eða litun.

records.key: One coefficient per guide, the unit the screen measures.
records.source: One coefficient per guide, the unit the screen measures.
records.translation: Einn stuðull á hvern leiðara, eininguna sem skimunin mælir.

records.source: One row per image set, one column per channel. Click a cell to show that channel of that field. The number on the left is how many sets are sampled.
records.translation: Ein röð á hvert myndasafn, einn dálkur á hverja rás. Smelltu á reit til að sýna þá rás þess sjónsviðs. Talan vinstra megin er hve mörg söfn eru tekin í úrtak.

nucleus_area < 200

records.key: Only retrieve crops without a human class label in the current annotation column. Cleared labels (blank or 0) and unanswered model suggestions remain eligible. The selected reference crop stays visible even when labelled.
records.source: Only retrieve crops without a human class label in the current annotation column. Cleared labels (blank or 0) and unanswered model suggestions remain eligible. The selected reference crop stays visible even when labelled.
records.translation: Sækja aðeins myndskurði sem hafa ekkert flokksmerki frá manni í núverandi merkingadálki. Hreinsuð merki (autt eða 0) og ósvaraðar tillögur líkansins koma áfram til greina. Valinn viðmiðunarmyndskurður er áfram sýnilegur jafnvel þótt hann sé merktur.

records.key: Open an image and label mask in napari for manual correction. When you import the corrected labels, spaCR validates the mask and records the change in the curation ledger.
records.source: Open an image and label mask in napari for manual correction. When you import the corrected labels, spaCR validates the mask and records the change in the curation ledger.
records.translation: Opna mynd og merkjagrímu í napari til handvirkrar leiðréttingar. Þegar þú flytur leiðréttu merkin inn staðfestir spaCR grímuna og skráir breytinguna í skrá yfir yfirferð gagna.

records.key: Open the Annotate screen first — it is what shows crops.
records.source: Open the Annotate screen first — it is what shows crops.
records.translation: Opnaðu fyrst Annotate-skjáinn — það er hann sem sýnir myndskurði.

records.key: Open these crops in Annotate, least confident first. These sat on the decision boundary; the label is probably right.
records.source: Open these crops in Annotate, least confident first. These sat on the decision boundary; the label is probably right.
records.translation: Opna þessa myndskurði í Annotate, minnst örugga fyrst. Þeir lágu á ákvörðunarmörkunum; merkið er líklega rétt.

records.key: Open these crops in Annotate, most confident first. If the model is this certain and disagrees, look at the annotation.
records.source: Open these crops in Annotate, most confident first. If the model is this certain and disagrees, look at the annotation.

records.key: Optional: point at a folder or stack of ready-made label images to skip segmentation entirely.
records.source: Optional: point at a folder or stack of ready-made label images to skip segmentation entirely.
records.translation: Valfrjálst: bentu á möppu eða stafla af tilbúnum merkjamyndum til að sleppa hlutun alveg.

records.key: Order stored in the PNG file. RGB keeps standard PNG channels unchanged. Auto uses spaCR's sidecar/database format marker. Legacy BGR repairs crops written by older cv2-based releases. After decoding, Annotate always uses RGB arrays.
records.source: Order stored in the PNG file. RGB keeps standard PNG channels unchanged. Auto uses spaCR's sidecar/database format marker. Legacy BGR repairs crops written by older cv2-based releases. After decoding, Annotate always uses RGB arrays.
records.translation: Röðin sem vistuð er í PNG-skránni. RGB heldur stöðluðum PNG-rásum óbreyttum. Auto notar sniðmerki spaCR í fylgiskrá/gagnagrunni. Legacy BGR lagfærir myndskurði sem skrifaðir voru af eldri útgáfum byggðum á cv2. Eftir afkóðun notar Annotate alltaf RGB-fylki.

records.key: Outputs produced after model evaluation: the metric bundle, calibration curve and bins, output score column, and decision threshold. Calibration compares predicted probabilities with observed frequencies. These settings apply to both classifier families.
records.source: Outputs produced after model evaluation: the metric bundle, calibration curve and bins, output score column, and decision threshold. Calibration compares predicted probabilities with observed frequencies. These settings apply to both classifier families.
records.translation: Úttak sem verður til eftir mat líkansins: mælikvarðapakkinn, kvörðunarferill og hólf, úttaksdálkur skors og ákvörðunarþröskuldur. Kvörðun ber spáðar líkur saman við mælda tíðni. Þessar stillingar gilda fyrir báðar fjölskyldur flokkara.

records.key: PNG channels do not exist in this array.
records.source: PNG channels do not exist in this array.
records.translation: PNG-rásirnar eru ekki til í þessu fylki.

records.source: Paste a merged .npy, a merged folder, or a run folder (the one you would put in src). Press Enter to load a field from it.
records.translation: Límdu inn sameinaða .npy-skrá, sameinaða möppu eða keyrslumöppu (þá sem þú myndir setja í src). Ýttu á Enter til að hlaða sjónsviði úr henni.

records.key:
Pause is not available for this module.

Pausing means holding the pipeline at a point where nothing is half-written — between fields, not mid-write. spaCR's pipelines do not yet offer such a checkpoint, so a Pause button here could only freeze the thread wherever it happened to be, which can truncate a mask file or leave a field measured into some tables and not others.

Use Stop, or queue plates so the run can be halted between them.
records.source:
Pause is not available for this module.

Pausing means holding the pipeline at a point where nothing is half-written — between fields, not mid-write. spaCR's pipelines do not yet offer such a checkpoint, so a Pause button here could only freeze the thread wherever it happened to be, which can truncate a mask file or leave a field measured into some tables and not others.

Use Stop, or queue plates so the run can be halted between them.
records.translation:
Hlé er ekki í boði fyrir þessa einingu.

Að gera hlé þýðir að stöðva ferlið á stað þar sem ekkert er hálfskrifað — milli sjónsviða, ekki í miðri skrift. Ferli spaCR bjóða ekki enn upp á slíkan vistunarpunkt, svo Pause-hnappur hér gæti aðeins fryst þráðinn hvar sem hann væri staddur, sem getur stýft grímuskrá eða skilið sjónsvið eftir mælt í sumum töflum en ekki öðrum.

Notaðu Stop, eða settu plötur í biðröð svo hægt sé að stöðva keyrsluna á milli þeirra.

records.key: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.source: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.translation: Á hverja rás (ein umferð á hverja litun)

records.key: Per-cell SHAP
records.source: Per-cell SHAP
records.translation: SHAP á hverja frumu

records.source: Percentile-normalize the field before segmenting it, which is what Cellpose expects. Turn it off only for data already normalized upstream, where doing it twice changes the result.
records.translation: Hundraðshlutastaðla sjónsviðið áður en það er hlutað, sem er það sem Cellpose gerir ráð fyrir. Slökktu aðeins á þessu fyrir gögn sem þegar hafa verið stöðluð fyrr í ferlinu, þar sem tvöföld stöðlun breytir niðurstöðunni.

records.source: Pick the wells off a plate map. Rows (r1), columns (c1) and wells (A01) all read, and what it writes reads back.
records.translation: Velja brunna af plötukorti. Raðir (r1), dálkar (c1) og brunnar (A01) eru allir lesnir, og það sem skrifað er má lesa aftur inn.

records.key: Pixels nearest the click that are not judged. One pixel widening to two is a ratio of 2 and means nothing, so the first rows out of the seed are skipped.
records.source: Pixels nearest the click that are not judged. One pixel widening to two is a ratio of 2 and means nothing, so the first rows out of the seed are skipped.
records.translation: Pixlar næst smellinum sem ekki eru metnir. Þegar einn pixill breikkar í tvo er hlutfallið 2 og merkir ekkert, svo fyrstu röðunum út frá upphafspunktinum er sleppt.

records.key: Plane of the merged array the preview reads its objects from. Bound to 'Tracked mask plane'; changing it drops the cached point table, so run the preview to see it.
records.source: Plane of the merged array the preview reads its objects from. Bound to 'Tracked mask plane'; changing it drops the cached point table, so run the preview to see it.
records.translation: Plan sameinaða fylkisins sem forskoðunin les hluti sína úr. Tengt við 'Tracked mask plane'; breyting á því hendir vistuðu punktatöflunni, svo keyrðu forskoðunina til að sjá það.

records.key: Plate / row / column
records.source: Plate / row / column
records.translation: Plata / röð / dálkur

records.source: Poisson GLM with a log link and offset(log(cell_count)) for per-well counts. The offset makes coefficients represent effects on the per-cell rate rather than total cell count, preventing differences in cell count from being interpreted as phenotype effects.
records.translation: Poisson GLM með log-tengifalli og offset(log(cell_count)) fyrir talningar á brunn. Hliðrunin (offset) lætur stuðlana tákna áhrif á tíðni á hverja frumu frekar en á heildarfjölda frumna, svo munur á frumufjölda er ekki túlkaður sem svipgerðaráhrif.

records.key: Previous flagged field (Left arrow)
records.source: Previous flagged field (Left arrow)

Which measurements are reduced is the xD tab of the settings.

Varpa völdum mælingum á þætti og setja valmörk á þá. Óháð 2D/3D — veldu sérstaklega hve margir ásarnir eru.

Hvaða mælingar eru minnkaðar er stillt í xD-flipa stillinganna.

records.key: Proportion (0 or 1 per cell)
records.source: Proportion (0 or 1 per cell)
records.translation: Hlutfall (0 eða 1 á hverja frumu)

records.key: Put the well hierarchy on the rows — what a plate summary is
records.source: Put the well hierarchy on the rows — what a plate summary is
records.translation: Setja brunnastigveldið í raðirnar — það er það sem plötusamantekt er

records.key: Quarantine field (Q)
records.source: Quarantine field (Q)
records.translation: Setja sjónsvið í sóttkví (Q)

records.key: Quarantined {field} at {path}. Later Measure runs will skip it.
records.source: Quarantined {field} at {path}. Later Measure runs will skip it.
records.translation: {field} sett í sóttkví í {path}. Síðari Measure-keyrslur munu sleppa því.

records.key: Raw reads from the published screen, NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935. Tick the runs you want and set how many reads to take from each — only that much is downloaded.
records.source: Raw reads from the published screen, NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935. Tick the runs you want and set how many reads to take from each — only that much is downloaded.
records.translation: Hráir lestrar úr birtu skimuninni, NCBI BioProject PRJNA1261935. Hakaðu við keyrslurnar sem þú vilt og stilltu hve marga lestra á að taka úr hverri — aðeins það magn er sótt.

records.key: Read a conversion or rename manifest to recover filenames from before Yokogawa conversion. The result gains original_filename and original_path columns for condition annotation. Source measurements and image files are preserved.
records.source: Read a conversion or rename manifest to recover filenames from before Yokogawa conversion. The result gains original_filename and original_path columns for condition annotation. Source measurements and image files are preserved.
records.translation: Lesa umbreytingar- eða endurnefningarskrá (manifest) til að endurheimta skráarheiti frá því fyrir Yokogawa-umbreytingu. Niðurstaðan fær dálkana original_filename og original_path fyrir merkingu skilyrða. Upprunalegar mælingar og myndskrár eru varðveittar.

records.source: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: how many, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable.
records.translation: Aðeins lesið þegar ályktun leiðir til óstikaða prófsins. Þetta stýrir umröðuninni sjálfri: hve margar, hvað er haldið föstu (venjulega platan), slembifræið og í hve mörgum brunnum leiðari þarf að koma fyrir áður en hægt er að prófa hann.

records.key: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: what is measured, how many reshuffles, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable. They apply to the gene pass as well as the guide pass: a gene is tested as a SET, its regressor the sum of its guides' fractions, permuted with the same scheme and the same seed and corrected as its own family — never by combining its guides' P values, which would assume an independence guides scored in the same wells do not have.
records.source: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: what is measured, how many reshuffles, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable. They apply to the gene pass as well as the guide pass: a gene is tested as a SET, its regressor the sum of its guides' fractions, permuted with the same scheme and the same seed and corrected as its own family — never by combining its guides' P values, which would assume an independence guides scored in the same wells do not have.
records.translation: Aðeins lesið þegar ályktun leiðir til óstikaða prófsins. Þetta stýrir umröðuninni sjálfri: hvað er mælt, hve margar uppstokkanir, hvað er haldið föstu (venjulega platan), slembifræið og í hve mörgum brunnum leiðari þarf að koma fyrir áður en hægt er að prófa hann. Þetta gildir jafnt um genaumferðina og leiðaraumferðina: gen er prófað sem MENGI, aðhvarfsbreyta þess er summa hlutfalla leiðara þess, umraðað með sama kerfi og sama slembifræi og leiðrétt sem eigin fjölskylda — aldrei með því að sameina P-gildi leiðara þess, sem myndi gera ráð fyrir óhæði sem leiðarar skoraðir í sömu brunnum hafa ekki.

records.key: Read the cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm tables out of the attached databases and attach them to these cells, so every measurement in the screen can be compared.
records.source: Read the cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm tables out of the attached databases and attach them to these cells, so every measurement in the screen can be compared.
records.translation: Lesa frumu-, kjarna-, sýkla- og umfrymistöflurnar úr tengdu gagnagrunnunum og tengja þær við þessar frumur, svo hægt sé að bera saman allar mælingar í skimuninni.

records.key: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s).

records.translation: Las {plates} plötu(r), {wells} brunn(a), {guides} leiðara, {genes} gen og {objects} hlutaröð(raðir).
