records.source: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s). The response was read from the first {objects} object row(s); the score table is larger than the {row_cap}-row sample this reads.
records.translation: Las {plates} plötu(r), {wells} brunn(a), {guides} leiðara, {genes} gen og {objects} hlutaröð(raðir). Svörunin var lesin úr fyrstu {objects} hlutaröð(röðum); skortaflan er stærri en {row_cap} raða úrtakið sem þetta les.

records.key: Record a SHA-256 of every input and output file in the run manifest, so a result can be traced to the exact data and weights that produced it. Costs minutes on a large plate. The manifest is written either way and says which it was, so a run without hashes is never mistaken for one whose hashes matched.
records.source: Record a SHA-256 of every input and output file in the run manifest, so a result can be traced to the exact data and weights that produced it. Costs minutes on a large plate. The manifest is written either way and says which it was, so a run without hashes is never mistaken for one whose hashes matched.
records.translation: Skrá SHA-256 hverrar inntaks- og úttaksskrár í skrá keyrslunnar (manifest), svo hægt sé að rekja niðurstöðu til nákvæmlega þeirra gagna og vægja sem framleiddu hana. Kostar mínútur á stórri plötu. Skráin er skrifuð hvort sem er og segir hvort var, svo keyrsla án tætigilda er aldrei tekin fyrir keyrslu þar sem tætigildin stemmdu.

records.key: Record failures that stop the run.
records.source: Record failures that stop the run.
records.translation: Skrá villur sem stöðva keyrsluna.

records.key: Recrop: no field open to cut.
records.source: Recrop: no field open to cut.
records.translation: Endurskurður: ekkert sjónsvið opið til að skera.

records.key: Red channel drawn as yellow, for deuteranopia.
records.source: Red channel drawn as yellow, for deuteranopia.
records.translation: Rauð rás teiknuð sem gul, fyrir grænblindu (deuteranopia).

records.key: Red channel drawn as yellow, for protanopia.
records.source: Red channel drawn as yellow, for protanopia.
records.translation: Rauð rás teiknuð sem gul, fyrir rauðblindu (protanopia).

records.key: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.source: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.translation: Draga hvern brunn saman í miðgildi hvers eiginleika og keyra sömu reglu yfir brunnana. Heill gallaður brunnur flaggar nær enga af einstökum hlutum sínum, svo þetta er annað próf frekar en samantekt á prófinu hér að ofan.

records.key: Ref. channel
records.source: Ref. channel
records.translation: Viðmiðunarrás

records.key: Reference used to compute the implied score. The screen median is estimated from all measured objects. The fitted intercept is the model reference and, for a well-level fit, represents a well with zero guide fraction. The selected reference is reported in the caption.
records.source: Reference used to compute the implied score. The screen median is estimated from all measured objects. The fitted intercept is the model reference and, for a well-level fit, represents a well with zero guide fraction. The selected reference is reported in the caption.
records.translation: Viðmið sem notað er til að reikna óbeina skorið. Miðgildi skimunarinnar er metið út frá öllum mældum hlutum. Mátaði skurðpunkturinn er viðmið líkansins og táknar, fyrir mátun á brunnastigi, brunn með ekkert leiðarahlutfall. Valið viðmið er tilgreint í myndatextanum.

records.key: Refresh crops
records.source: Refresh crops
records.translation: Endurnýja myndskurði

records.key: Regress screen phenotypes against guide/gene effects across plates.
records.source: Regress screen phenotypes against guide/gene effects across plates.
records.translation: Aðhvarfsgreina svipgerðir skimunar á móti áhrifum leiðara/gena yfir plötur.

records.key: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.source: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.translation: Umbeðinn fjöldi vinnsluferla. Skönnunin takmarkar hann eftir tiltæku minni; sjá Containment hér fyrir neðan um hvort takmörk á hverja tilraun, framfylgt af kjarnanum, séu virk.

records.key: Resolution of the raster spaCR renders for the Figures panel, and of any image embedded inside a vector PDF page. Very large figures are rendered at a lower DPI for the screen so they stay quick to draw; the PDF page is written at the full resolution chosen here.
records.source: Resolution of the raster spaCR renders for the Figures panel, and of any image embedded inside a vector PDF page. Very large figures are rendered at a lower DPI for the screen so they stay quick to draw; the PDF page is written at the full resolution chosen here.
records.translation: Upplausn rastans sem spaCR teiknar fyrir Figures-spjaldið, og hverrar myndar sem er ívafin í vigur-PDF-síðu. Mjög stór myndrit eru teiknuð með lægra DPI fyrir skjáinn svo þau séu fljót að teiknast; PDF-síðan er skrifuð í fullri upplausn sem valin er hér.

records.key: Restored {field} to {path}.
records.source: Restored {field} to {path}.
records.translation: {field} endurheimt í {path}.

records.key: Resume, failure tolerance, dry runs, worker count and verbosity for the import. Enable strict errors when validating a new external data source.
records.source: Resume, failure tolerance, dry runs, worker count and verbosity for the import. Enable strict errors when validating a new external data source.
records.translation: Halda áfram, villuþol, prufukeyrslur, fjöldi vinnsluferla og ítarleiki úttaks fyrir innflutninginn. Kveiktu á ströngum villum þegar ný utanaðkomandi gagnauppspretta er sannreynd.

records.key: Retraining on the labels so far…
records.source: Retraining on the labels so far…
records.translation: Endurþjálfa á merkingunum hingað til…

records.key: Retraining round {round} on the labels so far…
records.source: Retraining round {round} on the labels so far…
records.translation: Endurþjálfunarumferð {round} á merkingunum hingað til…

records.key: Review single-object image crops on a grid and label them; annotations save back to the database.
records.source: Review single-object image crops on a grid and label them; annotations save back to the database.
records.translation: Fara yfir myndskurði af stökum hlutum í hnitaneti og merkja þá; merkingar vistast aftur í gagnagrunninn.

records.key: Robust M-estimation with a Huber loss, tuned by huber_t (default 1.345, which is 95% efficient under normality). Wells far from the fit are down-weighted instead of dragging it, and no R-squared is reported.
records.source: Robust M-estimation with a Huber loss, tuned by huber_t (default 1.345, which is 95% efficient under normality). Wells far from the fit are down-weighted instead of dragging it, and no R-squared is reported.
records.translation: Traust M-mat með Huber-tapi, stillt með huber_t (sjálfgefið 1.345, sem er 95% skilvirkt við normaldreifingu). Brunnar fjarri mátuninni fá minna vægi í stað þess að draga hana til, og ekkert R-í-öðru er tilkynnt.

records.key: Run two Cellpose models over the same fields and see what changed: object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.source: Run two Cellpose models over the same fields and see what changed: object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.translation: Keyra tvö Cellpose-líkön yfir sömu sjónsvið og sjá hvað breyttist: fjölda hluta, ARI án bakgrunns og hvort aukahlutirnir eru nýjar frumur eða brot af gömlum.

records.key: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.source: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.translation: Meta hve vel tvær eða fleiri merkingaumferðir eru sammála með κ Cohens eða Fleiss, og fara síðan yfir hvern myndskurð sem þær merktu á ólíkan hátt.

records.key: Score-window half-width in robust scales (1.4826 × MAD). Larger values admit more cells and make 'closest' less selective. One value is applied to every coefficient in the screen, preventing gene-specific adjustment after inspecting the output.
records.source: Score-window half-width in robust scales (1.4826 × MAD). Larger values admit more cells and make 'closest' less selective. One value is applied to every coefficient in the screen, preventing gene-specific adjustment after inspecting the output.
records.translation: Hálfbreidd skorgluggans í traustum kvarðaeiningum (1.4826 × MAD). Hærri gildi hleypa inn fleiri frumum og gera 'closest' minna valvíst. Eitt gildi er notað fyrir hvern stuðul í skimuninni, sem kemur í veg fyrir genasértæka aðlögun eftir að úttakið hefur verið skoðað.

records.key: Screen data ready: {path}
records.source: Screen data ready: {path}
records.translation: Skimunargögn tilbúin: {path}

records.key: Search every recorded job and inspect its exact settings, hashed inputs and outputs, warnings, failure traceback, software versions, seeds and performance.
records.source: Search every recorded job and inspect its exact settings, hashed inputs and outputs, warnings, failure traceback, software versions, seeds and performance.
records.translation: Leita í öllum skráðum verkum og skoða nákvæmar stillingar þeirra, inntök og úttök með tætigildum, viðvaranir, villurakningu, hugbúnaðarútgáfur, slembifræ og afköst.

records.key: Search every recorded job and inspect its settings, inputs, outputs, warnings, failure traceback, versions, seeds, and performance in one place.
records.source: Search every recorded job and inspect its settings, inputs, outputs, warnings, failure traceback, versions, seeds, and performance in one place.
records.translation: Leita í öllum skráðum verkum og skoða stillingar þeirra, inntök, úttök, viðvaranir, villurakningu, útgáfur, slembifræ og afköst á einum stað.

records.key: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.source: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.translation: Leit mistókst: vinnsluferlið skilaði engri niðurstöðu.

records.key: Segment cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles with Cellpose and build the merged image+mask arrays.
records.source: Segment cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles with Cellpose and build the merged image+mask arrays.
records.translation: Hluta frumur, kjarna, sýkla og frumulíffæri með Cellpose og byggja sameinuðu mynd- og grímufylkin.

records.key: Segment each frame of a time series and link objects across frames into tracks, then export per-channel movies.
records.source: Segment each frame of a time series and link objects across frames into tracks, then export per-channel movies.
records.translation: Hluta hvern ramma tímaraðar og tengja hluti milli ramma í ferla, og flytja síðan út myndskeið fyrir hverja rás.

records.key: Segment the same three fields with two Cellpose models and see what changed: masks side by side, object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.source: Segment the same three fields with two Cellpose models and see what changed: masks side by side, object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.translation: Hluta sömu þrjú sjónsviðin með tveimur Cellpose-líkönum og sjá hvað breyttist: grímur hlið við hlið, fjölda hluta, ARI án bakgrunns og hvort aukahlutirnir eru nýjar frumur eða brot af gömlum.

records.key: Select a column containing reference annotations. If omitted, reference labels are derived by thresholding the score and the report identifies this limitation.
records.source: Select a column containing reference annotations. If omitted, reference labels are derived by thresholding the score and the report identifies this limitation.
records.translation: Veldu dálk sem inniheldur viðmiðunarmerkingar. Ef honum er sleppt eru viðmiðunarmerkin leidd út með þröskuldun á skorinu og skýrslan tilgreinir þessa takmörkun.

records.key: Select a gate in the hierarchy first.
records.source: Select a gate in the hierarchy first.
records.translation: Veldu fyrst valmörk í stigveldinu.

records.key: Select a strategy and choose “Run the strategy”. No cells are selected and no results are written before the run.
records.source: Select a strategy and choose “Run the strategy”. No cells are selected and no results are written before the run.
records.translation: Veldu aðferð og veldu „Run the strategy“. Engar frumur eru valdar og engar niðurstöður skrifaðar fyrir keyrsluna.

records.key: Select how cells are prioritised for annotation. The description below states the intended use, assumptions, and computational cost of each strategy.
records.source: Select how cells are prioritised for annotation. The description below states the intended use, assumptions, and computational cost of each strategy.
records.translation: Veldu hvernig frumum er forgangsraðað til merkingar. Lýsingin hér fyrir neðan tilgreinir ætlaða notkun, forsendur og reiknikostnað hverrar aðferðar.

records.key: Select the estimation level and inference method independently. 'Level' requests one effect per guide, one per gene, or separate results for both. 'Parametric' inference fits all terms simultaneously and therefore requires more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' inference tests terms by plate-blocked permutation; 'auto' selects the method supported by the design. 'Regression type' selects the fitted model family. The mixed model nests guides within genes and reports both levels.
records.source: Select the estimation level and inference method independently. 'Level' requests one effect per guide, one per gene, or separate results for both. 'Parametric' inference fits all terms simultaneously and therefore requires more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' inference tests terms by plate-blocked permutation; 'auto' selects the method supported by the design. 'Regression type' selects the fitted model family. The mixed model nests guides within genes and reports both levels.
records.translation: Veldu matsstig og ályktunaraðferð hvort í sínu lagi. 'Level' biður um ein áhrif á hvern leiðara, ein á hvert gen eða aðskildar niðurstöður fyrir hvort tveggja. 'Parametric' ályktun mátar alla liði samtímis og krefst því fleiri brunna en liða; 'nonparametric' ályktun prófar liði með umröðun innan platna; 'auto' velur aðferðina sem hönnunin styður. 'Regression type' velur fjölskyldu mátaða líkansins. Blandaða líkanið hreiðrar leiðara innan gena og tilkynnir bæði stigin.

records.key: Select the plate identifier, acquisition order, and control population. The application uses an individuals/moving-range chart for one control well per plate, an X-bar/S chart for multiple wells, or a robust alternative when requested. Limits are estimated from a defined baseline using short-term variation and then applied to subsequent plates. Nelson-rule violations are labelled, together with the expected false-alarm count for the selected rule set and campaign length.
records.source: Select the plate identifier, acquisition order, and control population. The application uses an individuals/moving-range chart for one control well per plate, an X-bar/S chart for multiple wells, or a robust alternative when requested. Limits are estimated from a defined baseline using short-term variation and then applied to subsequent plates. Nelson-rule violations are labelled, together with the expected false-alarm count for the selected rule set and campaign length.
records.translation: Veldu auðkenni plötu, röð myndatöku og viðmiðaþýði. Forritið notar einstaklings-/hreyfispannarit fyrir einn viðmiðunarbrunn á plötu, X-bar/S-rit fyrir marga brunna eða traustan valkost ef þess er óskað. Mörk eru metin út frá skilgreindri grunnlínu með skammtímabreytileika og síðan beitt á síðari plötur. Brot á Nelson-reglum eru merkt, ásamt væntum fjölda falskra viðvarana fyrir valið reglusafn og lengd átaksins.

records.key: Select the stages to execute, enable a small test run over a subset of fields, and configure resumption after interruption. Validate a new dataset with a test run before processing the complete plate.
records.source: Select the stages to execute, enable a small test run over a subset of fields, and configure resumption after interruption. Validate a new dataset with a test run before processing the complete plate.
records.translation: Veldu skrefin sem á að keyra, virkjaðu litla prufukeyrslu á undirmengi sjónsviða og stilltu framhald eftir truflun. Sannreyndu nýtt gagnasafn með prufukeyrslu áður en öll platan er unnin.

records.key: Set the fraction of wells reserved before candidate selection. Reserved wells are excluded from strategy selection and used for evaluation.
records.source: Set the fraction of wells reserved before candidate selection. Reserved wells are excluded from strategy selection and used for evaluation.
records.translation: Stilla hlutfall brunna sem tekið er frá fyrir val kandídata. Fráteknir brunnar eru útilokaðir frá vali aðferðar og notaðir til mats.

records.key: Set the minimum predicted probability required to accept a pseudo-label during self-training. Lower values admit labels faster but increase the risk of error propagation.
records.source: Set the minimum predicted probability required to accept a pseudo-label during self-training. Lower values admit labels faster but increase the risk of error propagation.
records.translation: Stilla lágmarksspálíkur sem þarf til að samþykkja gervimerki í sjálfsþjálfun. Lægri gildi hleypa merkjum hraðar inn en auka hættu á að villur breiðist út.

records.key: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.source: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.translation: Stilla fjölda klasa í eiginleikarúmi sem merkingaráætluninni er dreift á. Núll notar einn klasa á hverja frumu í biðröð.

records.key: Set the number of nearest neighbours evaluated for each seed. Only neighbours within the distance threshold inherit a label.
records.source: Set the number of nearest neighbours evaluated for each seed. Only neighbours within the distance threshold inherit a label.
records.translation: Stilla fjölda næstu nágranna sem metnir eru fyrir hvern upphafspunkt. Aðeins nágrannar innan fjarlægðarþröskuldsins erfa merki.

records.key: Set the random seed used for hold-out selection, sampling, and model fitting. Reusing the seed reproduces the same selection.
records.source: Set the random seed used for hold-out selection, sampling, and model fitting. Reusing the seed reproduces the same selection.
records.translation: Stilla slembifræið sem notað er við val á fráteknum gögnum, úrtöku og mátun líkans. Ef sama slembifræ er notað aftur fæst sama val.

records.key: Set the target number of cells per class. This controls the positive set, matched comparison set, and annotation queue.
records.source: Set the target number of cells per class. This controls the positive set, matched comparison set, and annotation queue.
records.translation: Stilla markfjölda frumna í hverjum flokki. Þetta stýrir jákvæða menginu, pöruðu samanburðarmenginu og merkingarbiðröðinni.

records.key: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.source: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.translation: Stilla samhliða vinnslu vinnsluferla og ítarleika greiningarúttaks. Fækkaðu vinnsluferlum þegar minni er takmarkað, eða auktu skráningu þegar verið er að rekja keyrslu sem mistókst.

records.key: Show only the animated background, full screen, like a screensaver. Any key or click brings the window back.
records.source: Show only the animated background, full screen, like a screensaver. Any key or click brings the window back.
records.translation: Sýna aðeins hreyfða bakgrunninn á öllum skjánum, eins og skjáhvílu. Hvaða lykill eða smellur sem er sækir gluggann aftur.

records.key: Show some cells first — the comparison groups them by what the picker chose, and nothing is picked yet.
records.source: Show some cells first — the comparison groups them by what the picker chose, and nothing is picked yet.
records.translation: Sýndu fyrst nokkrar frumur — samanburðurinn hópar þær eftir því sem valið valdi, og ekkert hefur verið valið enn.

records.key: Show the brushed objects as image crops
records.source: Show the brushed objects as image crops
records.translation: Sýna penslaða hlutina sem myndskurði

records.key: Show the cells
records.source: Show the cells
records.translation: Sýna frumurnar

records.key: Show the next object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.source: Show the next object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.translation: Sýna rás næsta hlutar. Flakkar milli frumu, kjarna og beggja.

records.key: Show the previous object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.source: Show the previous object's channel. Cycles cell, nucleus, both.
records.translation: Sýna rás fyrri hlutar. Flakkar milli frumu, kjarna og beggja.

records.key: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.source: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.translation: Sýna umbeðinn fjölda myndskurða sem hafa mælingar líkastar valda myndskurðinum, þeim með hringnum, líkustu fyrst, svo hægt sé að merkja sjaldgæfan flokk sem fannst einu sinni mörgum sinnum. Fyrsta leit í uppsprettu les mælingar hennar og tekur nokkrar sekúndur; síðari leitir eru tafarlausar. Farðu aftur í alla myndskurði með því að opna uppsprettuna aftur. Sjálfgefið ekki keyrt.

records.key: Show the selected objects as crops, parents first.
records.source: Show the selected objects as crops, parents first.
records.translation: Sýna valda hluti sem myndskurði, foreldra fyrst.

records.key: Show the unlabelled crops the classifier is least sure about first. Needs model scores in png_list, so run Classify (CV) before turning this on.
records.source: Show the unlabelled crops the classifier is least sure about first. Needs model scores in png_list, so run Classify (CV) before turning this on.
records.translation: Sýna fyrst ómerktu myndskurðina sem flokkarinn er minnst viss um. Þarf skor líkans í png_list, svo keyrðu Classify (CV) áður en þú kveikir á þessu.

records.key: Simulate the screen at each point on both sweeps, fit the model to each, and report how often it found the hits.
records.source: Simulate the screen at each point on both sweeps, fit the model to each, and report how often it found the hits.
records.translation: Herma skimunina í hverjum punkti beggja skannana, máta líkanið á hvern og tilkynna hve oft það fann marktæku niðurstöðurnar.

records.key: Space (star field flight)
records.source: Space (star field flight)
records.translation: Geimur (flug um stjörnusvið)

records.key: Stack any combination of modules, plates and settings into a queue and run it unattended — each job is validated when you add it, runs in its own process, and reports what failed, what was skipped because an upstream job failed, and what finished only partly.
records.source: Stack any combination of modules, plates and settings into a queue and run it unattended — each job is validated when you add it, runs in its own process, and reports what failed, what was skipped because an upstream job failed, and what finished only partly.
records.translation: Raða hvaða samsetningu eininga, platna og stillinga sem er í biðröð og keyra hana án eftirlits — hvert verk er sannreynt þegar þú bætir því við, keyrir í eigin ferli og tilkynnir hvað mistókst, hverju var sleppt vegna þess að fyrra verk mistókst og hvað kláraðist aðeins að hluta.

records.key: Stopping after the fit that is running. The runs that finished are complete and stay in the Runs tab.
records.source: Stopping after the fit that is running. The runs that finished are complete and stay in the Runs tab.
records.translation: Stöðvar eftir mátunina sem er í gangi. Keyrslurnar sem lokið er eru heilar og haldast í Runs-flipanum.

records.key: Suggesting labels from a model fitted on the labels so far…
records.source: Suggesting labels from a model fitted on the labels so far…
records.translation: Sting upp á merkjum út frá líkani sem mátað er á merkingunum hingað til…

records.key: Summarize annotation provenance by class, well, plate and active-learning round. This identifies label sets concentrated within a small number of wells or plates.
records.source: Summarize annotation provenance by class, well, plate and active-learning round. This identifies label sets concentrated within a small number of wells or plates.
records.translation: Draga saman uppruna merkinga eftir flokki, brunni, plötu og umferð virks náms. Þetta greinir merkjasöfn sem eru samþjöppuð í fáum brunnum eða plötum.

records.key: Summarizes quality-control results stored by completed runs; opening this screen does not recompute masks or measurements. An out-of-date result was produced from older inputs. A missing result indicates that the corresponding check has not been run and must not be interpreted as a passing result.
records.source: Summarizes quality-control results stored by completed runs; opening this screen does not recompute masks or measurements. An out-of-date result was produced from older inputs. A missing result indicates that the corresponding check has not been run and must not be interpreted as a passing result.
records.translation: Dregur saman niðurstöður gæðaeftirlits sem kláraðar keyrslur hafa vistað; að opna þennan skjá endurreiknar ekki grímur eða mælingar. Úrelt niðurstaða var framleidd úr eldri inntökum. Niðurstaða sem vantar merkir að viðkomandi athugun hefur ekki verið keyrð og má ekki túlka sem standast.

records.key: Summed-guide mode selects cells associated with the gene-level perturbation. Per-guide mode evaluates whether the individual guides select concordant cells; discordance can indicate a guide-specific or off-target effect.
records.source: Summed-guide mode selects cells associated with the gene-level perturbation. Per-guide mode evaluates whether the individual guides select concordant cells; discordance can indicate a guide-specific or off-target effect.
records.translation: Ham samanlagðra leiðara velur frumur sem tengjast truflun á genastigi. Ham hvers leiðara metur hvort einstakir leiðarar velja samræmdar frumur; ósamræmi getur bent til leiðarasértækra áhrifa eða áhrifa utan markraðar.

records.key: Take a third party's images, label masks and measurement table and produce a working spaCR project: Yokogawa-named TIFFs, merged arrays, and a measurements.db carrying their columns next to spaCR's plateID/rowID/columnID/fieldID/object_label — with the column mapping shown, editable and unit-checked before anything is written.
records.source: Take a third party's images, label masks and measurement table and produce a working spaCR project: Yokogawa-named TIFFs, merged arrays, and a measurements.db carrying their columns next to spaCR's plateID/rowID/columnID/fieldID/object_label — with the column mapping shown, editable and unit-checked before anything is written.
records.translation: Taka myndir, merkjagrímur og mælitöflu frá þriðja aðila og búa til nothæft spaCR-verkefni: TIFF-skrár með Yokogawa-heitum, sameinuð fylki og measurements.db með dálkum þeirra við hlið plateID/rowID/columnID/fieldID/object_label frá spaCR — þar sem vörpun dálka er sýnd, breytanleg og einingaprófuð áður en nokkuð er skrifað.

records.key: Ten ways of choosing WHICH of these cells get annotated, each saying what it is for and what it costs — the top-scoring cells against a matched random draw, uncertainty and diversity sampling, control wells as anchors, positive-unlabelled learning, self-training, two-view disagreement, score strata, neighbour propagation, and the plain random draw every one of them is measured against. Wells are never split across train and test, and the fit is reported with the score's own inputs removed as well as kept.
records.source: Ten ways of choosing WHICH of these cells get annotated, each saying what it is for and what it costs — the top-scoring cells against a matched random draw, uncertainty and diversity sampling, control wells as anchors, positive-unlabelled learning, self-training, two-view disagreement, score strata, neighbour propagation, and the plain random draw every one of them is measured against. Wells are never split across train and test, and the fit is reported with the score's own inputs removed as well as kept.
records.translation: Tíu leiðir til að velja HVERJAR af þessum frumum eru merktar, hver með lýsingu á tilgangi og kostnaði — frumur með hæsta skor á móti pöruðu slembiúrtaki, úrtaka eftir óvissu og fjölbreytni, viðmiðunarbrunnar sem akkeri, nám með jákvæðum og ómerktum gögnum, sjálfsþjálfun, ósamræmi tveggja sjónarhorna, skorlög, útbreiðsla til nágranna og einfalda slembiúrtakið sem hver þeirra er borin saman við. Brunnum er aldrei skipt milli þjálfunar og prófunar, og mátunin er tilkynnt bæði með og án eigin inntaka skorsins.

records.key: The barcode references and the counts produced by a mapping run, which the checks below are computed from. Point them at the outputs of the run you want to judge, not at a newer plate.
records.source: The barcode references and the counts produced by a mapping run, which the checks below are computed from. Point them at the outputs of the run you want to judge, not at a newer plate.
records.translation: Strikamerkjaviðmiðin og talningarnar úr vörpunarkeyrslu, sem athuganirnar hér fyrir neðan eru reiknaðar út frá. Beindu þeim að úttaki keyrslunnar sem þú vilt meta, ekki að nýrri plötu.

records.key: The colour map the assay's figures are drawn with, how many QC panels are produced, and whether wells with cells but no scored parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the invasion rate.
records.source: The colour map the assay's figures are drawn with, how many QC panels are produced, and whether wells with cells but no scored parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the invasion rate.
records.translation: Litakortið sem myndrit prófsins eru teiknuð með, hve mörg QC-spjöld eru búin til og hvort brunnar með frumum en engum skoruðum sníkjudýrum eru skráðir sem núll. Ef þeim brunnum er sleppt hækkar innrásarhlutfallið án þess að það sjáist.

records.key: The column saying what each well is. Leave empty when the table is already only the control.
records.source: The column saying what each well is. Leave empty when the table is already only the control.
records.translation: Dálkurinn sem segir hvað hver brunnur er. Hafðu autt þegar taflan inniheldur nú þegar aðeins viðmiðið.

records.key: The diagnostic figures a run draws as it goes — how many example fields, at what size, with which colour map and normalisation. Useful while tuning, and the first thing to switch off for a long unattended run.
records.source: The diagnostic figures a run draws as it goes — how many example fields, at what size, with which colour map and normalisation. Useful while tuning, and the first thing to switch off for a long unattended run.
records.translation: Greiningarmyndritin sem keyrsla teiknar jafnóðum — hve mörg dæmi um sjónsvið, í hvaða stærð, með hvaða litakorti og stöðlun. Gagnlegt við fínstillingu, og það fyrsta sem slökkva á fyrir langa keyrslu án eftirlits.

records.key: The expected plaque diameter, and whether previously written masks are reused instead of segmenting again. Plaques are far larger than cells, so the default cell-sized expectation is almost never right here.
records.source: The expected plaque diameter, and whether previously written masks are reused instead of segmenting again. Plaques are far larger than cells, so the default cell-sized expectation is almost never right here.
records.translation: Áætlað þvermál skellna og hvort áður skrifaðar grímur eru endurnýttar í stað þess að hluta aftur. Skellur eru mun stærri en frumur, svo sjálfgefna frumustærðin á nær aldrei við hér.

records.key: The experiment name, channel list, normalisation and whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived — the frame the imported masks are measured in. Check the channel list matches the images you are importing.
records.source: The experiment name, channel list, normalisation and whether a cytoplasm compartment is derived — the frame the imported masks are measured in. Check the channel list matches the images you are importing.
records.translation: Heiti tilraunarinnar, rásalisti, stöðlun og hvort umfrymishólf er leitt út — ramminn sem innfluttu grímurnar eru mældar í. Athugaðu að rásalistinn passi við myndirnar sem þú flytur inn.

records.key: The field stems this ROI applies to, comma separated (plate1_A01_F001). '*' applies it to every field.
records.source: The field stems this ROI applies to, comma separated (plate1_A01_F001). '*' applies it to every field.
records.translation: Stofnar sjónsviðsheita sem þetta ROI á við um, aðskildir með kommum (plate1_A01_F001). '*' beitir því á hvert sjónsvið.

records.key: The gates you have drawn. Tick one to show it on the plot and highlight its objects, untick it to hide it. Selecting a gate sets the axes to its measurements and makes the next gate you draw a child of it — it never changes what the plot shows.
records.source: The gates you have drawn. Tick one to show it on the plot and highlight its objects, untick it to hide it. Selecting a gate sets the axes to its measurements and makes the next gate you draw a child of it — it never changes what the plot shows.
records.translation: Valmörkin sem þú hefur teiknað. Hakaðu við ein til að sýna þau á grafinu og auðkenna hluti þeirra, taktu hakið af til að fela þau. Ef valmörk eru valin eru ásarnir settir á mælingar þeirra og næstu valmörk sem þú teiknar verða undirvalmörk þeirra — það breytir aldrei því sem grafið sýnir.

records.key: The image folder, which channel holds which object, and how spaCR reads plate, well and field out of the file names. Nothing segments correctly until the channel assignment and the naming convention here are right.
records.source: The image folder, which channel holds which object, and how spaCR reads plate, well and field out of the file names. Nothing segments correctly until the channel assignment and the naming convention here are right.
records.translation: Myndamappan, hvaða rás geymir hvaða hlut og hvernig spaCR les plötu, brunn og sjónsvið úr skráarheitunum. Ekkert er hlutað rétt fyrr en úthlutun rása og nafnavenjan hér eru réttar.

records.key: The interpretable estimator and grouped held-out test used to decide whether it reproduces the CV model well enough to explain it.
records.source: The interpretable estimator and grouped held-out test used to decide whether it reproduces the CV model well enough to explain it.
records.translation: Túlkanlega matsaðferðin og hópaða prófið á fráteknum gögnum sem notað er til að ákveða hvort hún endurskapar CV-líkanið nógu vel til að skýra það.

records.key: The label the brush paints. 0 is background — painting 0 is how you take a piece off the mask.
records.source: The label the brush paints. 0 is background — painting 0 is how you take a piece off the mask.
records.translation: Merkið sem penslinn málar. 0 er bakgrunnur — að mála 0 er leiðin til að taka bút af grímunni.

records.key: The largest single file a saved run copies in. Files over it are recorded with their size and the limit that excluded them.
records.source: The largest single file a saved run copies in. Files over it are recorded with their size and the limit that excluded them.
records.translation: Stærsta staka skráin sem vistuð keyrsla afritar inn. Skrár stærri en það eru skráðar með stærð sinni og mörkunum sem útilokuðu þær.

records.key: The measurement source, which tracked object the assay is about, and which channels carry the cell, nucleus and pathogen signal. The rest of the assay is only as good as this mapping.
records.source: The measurement source, which tracked object the assay is about, and which channels carry the cell, nucleus and pathogen signal. The rest of the assay is only as good as this mapping.
records.translation: Mælingauppsprettan, hvaða rakta hlut prófið fjallar um og hvaða rásir bera merki frumu, kjarna og sýkils. Restin af prófinu er aðeins jafngóð og þessi vörpun.

records.key: The metadata, score and count tables the regression runs on. All three have to agree on well and gRNA naming — disagreement there is the usual cause of an empty result.
records.source: The metadata, score and count tables the regression runs on. All three have to agree on well and gRNA naming — disagreement there is the usual cause of an empty result.
records.translation: Lýsigagna-, skor- og talningatöflurnar sem aðhvarfið keyrir á. Allar þrjár verða að vera samhljóða um heiti brunna og gRNA — ósamræmi þar er algengasta ástæða tómrar niðurstöðu.

records.key: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is a legitimate thing to want and gives a different table.
records.source: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is a legitimate thing to want and gives a different table.
records.translation: Hluturinn sem allt annað er tekið saman á. Hann ákveður hvað röð í sameinuðu töflunni merkir — að taka frumur saman á sýkla er fullgilt markmið og gefur aðra töflu.

records.key: The outer-ring test, the ring-by-ring profile and the row/column gradients appear here once a plate is rendered.
records.source: The outer-ring test, the ring-by-ring profile and the row/column gradients appear here once a plate is rendered.
records.translation: Ytri hrings prófið, prófíllinn hring fyrir hring og halli eftir röðum/dálkum birtast hér þegar plata hefur verið teiknuð.

records.key: The per-object PNGs and arrays written alongside the measurements — crop mode and size, which channels and masks are included, dilation, and how they are normalised. These are the images Annotate and the CV classifier read later.
records.source: The per-object PNGs and arrays written alongside the measurements — crop mode and size, which channels and masks are included, dilation, and how they are normalised. These are the images Annotate and the CV classifier read later.
records.translation: PNG-myndirnar og fylkin fyrir hvern hlut sem skrifuð eru með mælingunum — hamur og stærð myndskurða, hvaða rásir og grímur eru teknar með, útvíkkun og hvernig þau eru stöðluð. Þetta eru myndirnar sem Annotate og CV-flokkarinn lesa síðar.

records.key: The per-object classification score the window is applied to. A screen with more than one classifier output has more than one candidate; the caption identifies the score used for selection.
records.source: The per-object classification score the window is applied to. A screen with more than one classifier output has more than one candidate; the caption identifies the score used for selection.
records.translation: Flokkunarskor hvers hlutar sem glugganum er beitt á. Skimun með fleiri en einu úttaki flokkara hefur fleiri en einn kandídat; myndatextinn tilgreinir skorið sem notað er við valið.

records.key: The per-object images written next to the measurements — crop mode and size, which mask each crop is centred on, how far it is dilated, and which channels are baked in. Annotate and the CV classifier read these later, so set them before generating a training set.
records.source: The per-object images written next to the measurements — crop mode and size, which mask each crop is centred on, how far it is dilated, and which channels are baked in. Annotate and the CV classifier read these later, so set them before generating a training set.
records.translation: Myndirnar fyrir hvern hlut sem skrifaðar eru við hlið mælinganna — hamur og stærð myndskurða, á hvaða grímu hver myndskurður er miðjaður, hve mikið hann er útvíkkaður og hvaða rásir eru bakaðar inn. Annotate og CV-flokkarinn lesa þessar síðar, svo stilltu þær áður en þjálfunarsafn er búið til.

records.key: The plan appears here: canvas size, how many tiles registered, which ones fell back to their stage position, and the largest residuals.
records.source: The plan appears here: canvas size, how many tiles registered, which ones fell back to their stage position, and the largest residuals.
records.translation: Áætlunin birtist hér: stærð strigans, hve margir reitir voru samstilltir, hverjir féllu aftur á stöðu sína á smásjárborðinu og stærstu leifarnar.

records.key: The plan summary and, after a run, what was converted and what was skipped.
records.source: The plan summary and, after a run, what was converted and what was skipped.
records.translation: Samantekt áætlunarinnar og, eftir keyrslu, hvað var umbreytt og hverju var sleppt.

records.key: The plate folder — the one holding merged/ and measurements/
records.source: The plate folder — the one holding merged/ and measurements/
records.translation: Plötumappan — sú sem geymir merged/ og measurements/

records.key: The plate map: which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, which are the positive and negative controls, and how wells are grouped for reporting. Filled in once per plate design; everything downstream labels its results from it.
records.source: The plate map: which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, which are the positive and negative controls, and how wells are grouped for reporting. Filled in once per plate design; everything downstream labels its results from it.
records.translation: Plötukortið: hvaða brunnar geyma hvaða frumulínu, stofn og meðferð, hverjir eru jákvæð og neikvæð viðmið og hvernig brunnar eru hópaðir fyrir skýrslur. Fyllt út einu sinni fyrir hverja plötuhönnun; allt sem á eftir kemur merkir niðurstöður sínar út frá því.

records.key: The plate name written into every filename. spaCR groups by it, so two acquisitions imported under one name are one plate.
records.source: The plate name written into every filename. spaCR groups by it, so two acquisitions imported under one name are one plate.
records.translation: Heiti plötunnar sem skrifað er í hvert skráarheiti. spaCR hópar eftir því, svo tvær myndatökur fluttar inn undir einu heiti eru ein plata.

records.key: The range and resolution of the scan used to show how the results would change under a different cut-off. Widen the span when the chosen threshold sits near the edge of the scanned range.
records.source: The range and resolution of the scan used to show how the results would change under a different cut-off. Widen the span when the chosen threshold sits near the edge of the scanned range.
records.translation: Bil og upplausn skönnunarinnar sem notuð er til að sýna hvernig niðurstöðurnar myndu breytast við önnur mörk. Víkkaðu bilið þegar valinn þröskuldur er nálægt jaðri skannaða bilsins.

records.key: The read files and whether they are treated as a pair or a single direction. Everything downstream assumes this is right, and a single-end run pointed at paired reads finds nothing without reporting an error.
records.source: The read files and whether they are treated as a pair or a single direction. Everything downstream assumes this is right, and a single-end run pointed at paired reads finds nothing without reporting an error.
records.translation: Lestrarskrárnar og hvort þær eru meðhöndlaðar sem par eða ein átt. Allt sem á eftir kemur gerir ráð fyrir að þetta sé rétt, og einenda keyrsla sem beint er að pöruðum lestrum finnur ekkert án þess að tilkynna villu.

records.key: The report will describe selected cells, model fitting, evaluation data, and interpretation limits.
records.source: The report will describe selected cells, model fitting, evaluation data, and interpretation limits.
records.translation: Skýrslan mun lýsa völdum frumum, mátun líkans, matsgögnum og takmörkunum á túlkun.

records.key: The rules that keep implausible tracks out of the result — the largest jump allowed between frames, how straight a path has to be, and the outlier cutoff. Tighten them when tracking errors show up as impossibly fast cells.
records.source: The rules that keep implausible tracks out of the result — the largest jump allowed between frames, how straight a path has to be, and the outlier cutoff. Tighten them when tracking errors show up as impossibly fast cells.
records.translation: Reglurnar sem halda ósennilegum ferlum utan niðurstöðunnar — stærsta stökk sem leyft er milli ramma, hve beinn ferill þarf að vera og frávikamörkin. Hertu þær þegar rakningarvillur birtast sem ómögulega hraðar frumur.

records.key: The six choices you need to segment an organelle: which channel it is in, what KIND of organelle it is, how big it is, and the size and border filters. Setting the type fills in the detection parameters for you and says on the console what it picked — the rest are under Organelle advanced, still editable, if you want to change any of them.
records.source: The six choices you need to segment an organelle: which channel it is in, what KIND of organelle it is, how big it is, and the size and border filters. Setting the type fills in the detection parameters for you and says on the console what it picked — the rest are under Organelle advanced, still editable, if you want to change any of them.
records.translation: Valkostirnir sex sem þú þarft til að hluta frumulíffæri: í hvaða rás það er, hvaða TEGUND frumulíffæris það er, hve stórt það er og stærðar- og jaðarsíurnar. Þegar tegundin er stillt eru greiningarfæribreyturnar fylltar út fyrir þig og stjórnborðið segir hvað var valið — hinar eru undir Organelle advanced, enn breytanlegar, ef þú vilt breyta einhverri þeirra.

records.key: The size and intensity windows an object has to fall inside to count, plus the per-well cell limits. These gates decide which cells the recruitment ratio is averaged over.
records.source: The size and intensity windows an object has to fall inside to count, plus the per-well cell limits. These gates decide which cells the recruitment ratio is averaged over.
records.translation: Stærðar- og styrkgluggarnir sem hlutur þarf að falla innan til að teljast með, auk frumumarka á hvern brunn. Þessi valmörk ráða yfir hvaða frumur nýliðunarhlutfallið er meðaltalið.

records.key: The size and redundancy of the screening library: how many genes are targeted, how many guides each one gets, and how many constructs land in a well. Guides per gene is usually the cheapest lever on detection power.
records.source: The size and redundancy of the screening library: how many genes are targeted, how many guides each one gets, and how many constructs land in a well. Guides per gene is usually the cheapest lever on detection power.
records.translation: Stærð og offramboð skimunarsafnsins: hve mörg gen eru miðuð, hve marga leiðara hvert fær og hve margar genaferjur lenda í brunni. Leiðarar á gen eru yfirleitt ódýrasta leiðin til að auka greiningarstyrk.

records.key: The size of every piece of text in this figure: the title, the axis labels, the tick labels, the legend and any annotation. It is remembered for this figure, so a redraw keeps it. The size every figure starts at is in Preferences → Figures.
records.source: The size of every piece of text in this figure: the title, the axis labels, the tick labels, the legend and any annotation. It is remembered for this figure, so a redraw keeps it. The size every figure starts at is in Preferences → Figures.
records.translation: Stærð alls texta í þessu myndriti: titill, ásamerkingar, kvarðamerki, skýringar og hvers kyns athugasemdir. Hún er munuð fyrir þetta myndrit, svo endurteiknun heldur henni. Stærðin sem hvert myndrit byrjar með er í Preferences → Figures.

records.key: The third measurement. Gates in 3D are drawn against it; in 2D it is remembered but not used.
records.source: The third measurement. Gates in 3D are drawn against it; in 2D it is remembered but not used.
records.translation: Þriðja mælingin. Valmörk í 3D eru teiknuð á móti henni; í 2D er hún munuð en ekki notuð.

records.key: The trained model, the dataset it is applied to, and the input channels, object type and image size it expects. These have to match how the model was trained or the maps mean nothing.
records.source: The trained model, the dataset it is applied to, and the input channels, object type and image size it expects. These have to match how the model was trained or the maps mean nothing.
records.translation: Þjálfaða líkanið, gagnasafnið sem því er beitt á og inntaksrásirnar, hlutagerðin og myndstærðin sem það gerir ráð fyrir. Þetta þarf að passa við hvernig líkanið var þjálfað, annars merkja kortin ekkert.

records.key: The two-colour invasion readout: which channels carry the outside and total stains, how the outside signal is measured, how its threshold is chosen and sanity-checked, and which objects count as parasites at all. The table the parasites are read from is under Measurements.
records.source: The two-colour invasion readout: which channels carry the outside and total stains, how the outside signal is measured, how its threshold is chosen and sanity-checked, and which objects count as parasites at all. The table the parasites are read from is under Measurements.
records.translation: Tveggja lita innrásarmælingin: hvaða rásir bera ytri litunina og heildarlitunina, hvernig ytra merkið er mælt, hvernig þröskuldur þess er valinn og sannprófaður og hvaða hlutir teljast yfirleitt sníkjudýr. Taflan sem sníkjudýrin eru lesin úr er undir Measurements.

records.key: The unsupervised alternative: how many clusters, how the pathogen channel is weighted, and the minimum separation and silhouette a split has to reach before it is trusted. Use it when there are no labels to train on.
records.source: The unsupervised alternative: how many clusters, how the pathogen channel is weighted, and the minimum separation and silhouette a split has to reach before it is trusted. Use it when there are no labels to train on.
records.translation: Valkosturinn án leiðbeinanda: hve margir klasar, hvernig sýklarásin er vegin og lágmarksaðskilnaður og silhouette-gildi sem skipting þarf að ná áður en henni er treyst. Notaðu þetta þegar engin merki eru til að þjálfa á.

records.key:
The window an object must fall inside to be outlined in this colour. Area is the object's size in pixels; intensity is its mean brightness in that colour, 0–255.

LEAVE A FIELD EMPTY for no bound on that side. An empty field is how half a filter is turned off, and it is not the same as a zero.
records.source:
The window an object must fall inside to be outlined in this colour. Area is the object's size in pixels; intensity is its mean brightness in that colour, 0–255.

LEAVE A FIELD EMPTY for no bound on that side. An empty field is how half a filter is turned off, and it is not the same as a zero.
records.translation:
Glugginn sem hlutur þarf að falla innan til að útlína hans sé teiknuð í þessum lit. Area er stærð hlutarins í pixlum; intensity er meðalbirta hans í þeim lit, 0–255.

HAFÐU REIT AUÐAN til að hafa engin mörk þeim megin. Auður reitur er leiðin til að slökkva á hálfri síu, og það er ekki það sama og núll.

records.key: There is nothing to compare yet — press “Show the cells” first. The comparison groups the cells by what the picker chose, and nothing is picked until a montage is loaded.
records.source: There is nothing to compare yet — press “Show the cells” first. The comparison groups the cells by what the picker chose, and nothing is picked until a montage is loaded.
records.translation: Það er ekkert til að bera saman enn — ýttu fyrst á „Show the cells“. Samanburðurinn flokkar frumurnar eftir því sem valtólið valdi, og ekkert er valið fyrr en myndasamsetning er hlaðin.

records.key: These came from a model with INVENTED negatives — only one class was annotated, so the other was drawn at random from unlabelled crops. Treat this as a ranking to review, not as answers: accepting them in bulk is not offered.
records.source: These came from a model with INVENTED negatives — only one class was annotated, so the other was drawn at random from unlabelled crops. Treat this as a ranking to review, not as answers: accepting them in bulk is not offered.
records.translation: Þessar komu frá líkani með TILBÚNUM neikvæðum dæmum — aðeins einn flokkur var merktur, svo hinn var dreginn af handahófi úr ómerktum myndskurðum. Líttu á þetta sem röðun til að yfirfara, ekki sem svör: ekki er boðið upp á að samþykkja þær allar í einu.

records.key: These sources have different or unknown layouts. Run each layout separately with its matching mask settings.
records.source: These sources have different or unknown layouts. Run each layout separately with its matching mask settings.
records.translation: Þessar uppsprettur hafa ólíka eða óþekkta uppsetningu. Keyrðu hverja uppsetningu sér með samsvarandi grímustillingum.

records.key: This choice adjusts the significance threshold and, when recall is prioritized, the multiple-testing correction. The appropriate balance depends on the screen objective and the cost of downstream validation.
records.source: This choice adjusts the significance threshold and, when recall is prioritized, the multiple-testing correction. The appropriate balance depends on the screen objective and the cost of downstream validation.
records.translation: Þetta val stillir marktektarþröskuldinn og, þegar næmi (recall) er sett í forgang, leiðréttinguna fyrir fjölprófun. Rétt jafnvægi fer eftir markmiði skimunarinnar og kostnaði við staðfestingu í kjölfarið.

records.key: This field is implicated by the plate-level QC finding.
records.source: This field is implicated by the plate-level QC finding.
records.translation: Þetta sjónsvið tengist QC-niðurstöðunni á plötustigi.

records.key: This merge has no verified image/object provenance; save the gating strategy for tabular reuse.
records.source: This merge has no verified image/object provenance; save the gating strategy for tabular reuse.
records.translation: Þessi sameining hefur engan staðfestan uppruna mynda/hluta; vistaðu valmarkaáætlunina til endurnotkunar á töflugögnum.

records.key: This prior informs the multiple-testing threshold. A screen expected to contain 5 hits per 1,000 tests requires a different threshold from one expected to contain 200; the input tables do not provide this experimental assumption.

records.key:
Two questions, asked in order. WHAT IS ESTIMATED is 'Level': 'gRNA' gives one estimate per guide, 'gene' one estimate per gene with its guides pooled, 'both' gives each separately, corrected as its own family. HOW THE P VALUE IS REACHED is 'Inference': 'parametric' fits every term at once and needs more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' tests each term on its own by permutation and has no such limit; 'auto' counts them and picks. The two are independent — every level is available under either.
A THIRD ANALYSIS exists on the fitted side only: 'Regression type' = 'mixed' estimates gene effects while modelling the guide-to-guide spread inside each gene, which is why it answers both levels at once and greys 'Level'. There is no permutation equivalent — a variance component is something a model estimates — so under nonparametric inference the family is not read at all and says so.
Below them: the multiple-testing correction applied across the tested family, the level it targets, and the control-based effect-size threshold. With hundreds of guides an uncorrected P value is not evidence. Together, these settings define what counts as a hit.

Tvær spurningar, spurðar í röð. HVAÐ ER METIÐ er 'Level': 'gRNA' gefur eitt mat á hvert leiðsögu-RNA, 'gene' eitt mat á hvert gen með leiðsögu-RNA þess sameinuð, 'both' gefur hvort tveggja sér, leiðrétt sem eigin fjölskylda. HVERNIG P-GILDIÐ FÆST er 'Inference': 'parametric' aðfellir alla liði í einu og þarf fleiri brunna en liði; 'nonparametric' prófar hvern lið sér með umröðun og hefur engin slík mörk; 'auto' telur þá og velur. Þetta tvennt er óháð — hvert stig er tiltækt undir hvoru sem er.
ÞRIÐJA GREININGIN er aðeins til á aðfellingarhliðinni: 'Regression type' = 'mixed' metur genaáhrif á meðan dreifingin milli leiðsögu-RNA innan hvers gens er líkönuð, og þess vegna svarar hún báðum stigum í einu og gerir 'Level' grátt. Það er engin umröðunarhliðstæða — dreifniþáttur er eitthvað sem líkan metur — svo undir óstikaðri ályktun er fjölskyldan alls ekki lesin og það kemur fram.
Fyrir neðan þær: leiðréttingin fyrir fjölprófun sem beitt er yfir prófuðu fjölskylduna, stigið sem hún miðar á og þröskuldur áhrifastærðar byggður á viðmiðum. Með hundruð leiðsögu-RNA er óleiðrétt P-gildi ekki sönnunargagn. Saman skilgreina þessar stillingar hvað telst jákvæð niðurstaða.

Það sem fullgerð keyrsla skráir um vinnusvæðið í kringum hana — tengdu gagnagrunnana, myndasamsetninguna og sýnina sem byggð er á hverri mynd.

Hvar skrárnar eru: slóðir, stærðir og gátsummur, svo endurheimt geti sagt að gagnagrunnur hafi verið færður í stað þess að mistakast á óljósan hátt. Kílóbæti.

Afrit af skránum: einnig gagnagrunnarnir og töflurnar, upp að hámarkinu á hverja skrá hér að neðan. Upprunamappa með myndum er tugir til hundruð gígabæta, svo allt yfir hámarkinu er nefnt í eigin skrá keyrslunnar í stað þess að vera afritað — engu er sleppt án þess að það komi fram.

Myndir sem setan bjó til eru afritaðar hvort sem er: þær eru hvergi annars staðar til.

records.key:
What colours the channels are drawn in. A VIEW setting: it changes nothing on disk and nothing measured.

CMY is the publication style most multichannel micrographs use now. The three colourblind modes are separate because which PAIR of colours collapses depends on the deficiency — red-green for a deuteranope or protanope, blue-yellow for a tritanope — so one setting cannot serve all three. CMY is NOT one of them: measured against a red-green deficiency it separates the channels less well than plain RGB.
