It cannot make an old figure editable again — a PDF page has no legend to toggle — but it does make it legible.
records.translation: Þegar þú ferð aftur fyrir töluna hér að ofan og velur mynd, hlaða PDF-síðu hennar ef hún er til, svo gömul mynd haldist skörp við hvaða aðdrátt sem er í stað þess að vera stækkuð skjámynd í rastaformi. Þetta getur ekki gert gamla mynd breytanlega aftur — PDF-síða hefur enga skýringartöflu til að kveikja eða slökkva á — en það gerir hana læsilega.

records.key: Where the cell-probability map is cut. Lower it to keep dimmer objects the network was unsure about; raise it to keep only confident ones. Open the Cell probability tab after a run and the number has something to be judged against.
records.source: Where the cell-probability map is cut. Lower it to keep dimmer objects the network was unsure about; raise it to keep only confident ones. Open the Cell probability tab after a run and the number has something to be judged against.
records.translation: Hvar frumulíkindakortið er skorið. Lækkaðu það til að halda daufari hlutum sem netið var óvisst um; hækkaðu það til að halda aðeins öruggum hlutum. Opnaðu flipann Cell probability eftir keyrslu og þá hefur talan eitthvað til að miða við.

records.key: Where the module reads its images or tables from, plus any lookup file it needs alongside them. Set these when you point the module at a new plate or experiment; every other group assumes they are right.
records.source: Where the module reads its images or tables from, plus any lookup file it needs alongside them. Set these when you point the module at a new plate or experiment; every other group assumes they are right.
records.translation: Hvaðan einingin les myndir sínar eða töflur, auk uppflettiskrár sem hún þarf með þeim. Stilltu þetta þegar þú beinir einingunni að nýrri plötu eða tilraun; allir aðrir hópar gera ráð fyrir að þetta sé rétt.

records.key: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.source: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.translation: Hvaðan þjálfunarmyndirnar koma og hvernig þær eru skornar — uppspretta myndskurða, slóðar- og sniðsíur fyrir myndskurði sem þegar eru á diski, og rásirnar og hluturinn sem skorið er í kringum fyrir myndskurði sem búnir eru til eftir þörfum.

records.key: Where the training images come from and how they are cut. Loading reads crops that were already exported, selected by one path pattern; streaming cuts them from the merged arrays as training runs, which needs the channel arrays and either an object table or a mask array to cut around. The settings that do not apply to the chosen source and stream method are greyed rather than hidden.
records.source: Where the training images come from and how they are cut. Loading reads crops that were already exported, selected by one path pattern; streaming cuts them from the merged arrays as training runs, which needs the channel arrays and either an object table or a mask array to cut around. The settings that do not apply to the chosen source and stream method are greyed rather than hidden.
records.translation: Hvaðan þjálfunarmyndirnar koma og hvernig þær eru skornar. Hleðsla les myndskurði sem þegar voru fluttir út, valda með einu slóðarmynstri; streymi sker þá úr sameinuðu fylkjunum á meðan þjálfunin keyrir, sem krefst rásafylkjanna og annaðhvort hlutatöflu eða grímufylkis til að skera í kringum. Stillingar sem eiga ekki við valda uppsprettu og streymisaðferð eru gráar frekar en faldar.

records.key: Whether maps are saved, whether the input order is shuffled, and the batch size and worker count used to generate them.
records.source: Whether maps are saved, whether the input order is shuffled, and the batch size and worker count used to generate them.
records.translation: Hvort kort eru vistuð, hvort inntaksröðinni er stokkað, og lotustærð og fjöldi vinnsluferla sem notaður er til að búa þau til.

records.key: Whether masks and results are written, the GPU batch size, and how much the run prints. Leave saving off for the first pass over a new plate.
records.source: Whether masks and results are written, the GPU batch size, and how much the run prints. Leave saving off for the first pass over a new plate.
records.translation: Hvort grímur og niðurstöður eru skrifaðar, lotustærð GPU og hversu mikið keyrslan prentar. Hafðu slökkt á vistun í fyrstu umferð yfir nýja plötu.

records.key: Whether one y unit is drawn the same length as one x unit ('equal', which is what keeps a plate's wells square), or the panel is filled instead ('auto'). This locks the axis scales, which is a statement about the data; the proportions of the figure are 'Page shape'.
records.source: Whether one y unit is drawn the same length as one x unit ('equal', which is what keeps a plate's wells square), or the panel is filled instead ('auto'). This locks the axis scales, which is a statement about the data; the proportions of the figure are 'Page shape'.
records.translation: Hvort ein y-eining er teiknuð jafnlöng einni x-einingu ('equal', sem er það sem heldur brunnum plötu ferningslaga), eða spjaldið fyllt í staðinn ('auto'). Þetta læsir kvörðum ásanna, sem er fullyrðing um gögnin; hlutföll myndarinnar eru 'Page shape'.

records.key: Whether per-plate offsets are removed before analysis, which column identifies the batch, and which wells anchor the correction. Use it when plates were run on different days or instruments and plate identity shows up as a larger effect than the biology.
records.source: Whether per-plate offsets are removed before analysis, which column identifies the batch, and which wells anchor the correction. Use it when plates were run on different days or instruments and plate identity shows up as a larger effect than the biology.
records.translation: Hvort hliðranir einstakra platna eru fjarlægðar fyrir greiningu, hvaða dálkur auðkennir lotuna og hvaða brunnar festa leiðréttinguna. Notaðu þetta þegar plötur voru keyrðar á mismunandi dögum eða tækjum og auðkenni plötu birtist sem meiri áhrif en líffræðin.

records.key: Whether the comparison figures and masks are written, the GPU batch size, and how much each candidate run prints on its way through.
records.source: Whether the comparison figures and masks are written, the GPU batch size, and how much each candidate run prints on its way through.
records.translation: Hvort samanburðarmyndir og grímur eru skrifaðar, lotustærð GPU og hversu mikið hver kandídatskeyrsla prentar á leiðinni.

records.key: Whether the masks are written, how many images are handed to the GPU at once, and how much the run prints. Reduce the batch size when the GPU runs out of memory.
records.source: Whether the masks are written, how many images are handed to the GPU at once, and how much the run prints. Reduce the batch size when the GPU runs out of memory.
records.translation: Hvort grímurnar eru skrifaðar, hversu margar myndir eru sendar til GPU í einu og hversu mikið keyrslan prentar. Minnkaðu lotustærðina þegar GPU verður uppiskroppa með minni.

records.key: Whether the microscope's uneven lighting is estimated from these fields and divided out before any intensity is measured, and how that estimate is made and checked. Turn it on when the same cell measures differently depending on where in the field it sat; leaving it off keeps that bias in every intensity feature.
records.source: Whether the microscope's uneven lighting is estimated from these fields and divided out before any intensity is measured, and how that estimate is made and checked. Turn it on when the same cell measures differently depending on where in the field it sat; leaving it off keeps that bias in every intensity feature.
records.translation: Hvort ójöfn lýsing smásjárinnar er metin út frá þessum sjónsviðum og deilt út áður en nokkur styrkur er mældur, og hvernig það mat er gert og athugað. Kveiktu á þessu þegar sama fruman mælist ólík eftir því hvar í sjónsviðinu hún var; ef slökkt er á þessu helst sú skekkja í hverjum styrkleikaeiginleika.

records.key: Which algorithm links objects between frames — Trackastra, Ultrack or a plain distance/overlap linker — and the parameters belonging to whichever you pick. Switch backends when cells swap identities or tracks break at division.
records.source: Which algorithm links objects between frames — Trackastra, Ultrack or a plain distance/overlap linker — and the parameters belonging to whichever you pick. Switch backends when cells swap identities or tracks break at division.
records.translation: Hvaða reiknirit tengir hluti milli ramma — Trackastra, Ultrack eða einfaldur fjarlægðar-/skörunartengill — og færibreyturnar sem tilheyra því sem þú velur. Skiptu um bakenda þegar frumur skipta um auðkenni eða ferlar rofna við skiptingu.

records.key: Which animation drifts behind a settings window. Separate from the module screens' own backdrop above: what belongs behind a screen of figures is not necessarily what belongs behind a form you are reading. None keeps the card and the rim and drops only the movement.
records.source: Which animation drifts behind a settings window. Separate from the module screens' own backdrop above: what belongs behind a screen of figures is not necessarily what belongs behind a form you are reading. None keeps the card and the rim and drops only the movement.
records.translation: Hvaða hreyfimynd líður á bak við stillingaglugga. Aðskilið frá eigin bakgrunni einingaskjánna hér að ofan: það sem á heima á bak við skjá með myndum er ekki endilega það sem á heima á bak við eyðublað sem þú ert að lesa. None heldur spjaldinu og brúninni og sleppir aðeins hreyfingunni.

records.key: Which channels carry the signals the assay compares, the statistic each object is summarised by, and whether background is subtracted first. Swapping two channels here inverts the result without producing an error.
records.source: Which channels carry the signals the assay compares, the statistic each object is summarised by, and whether background is subtracted first. Swapping two channels here inverts the result without producing an error.
records.translation: Hvaða rásir bera merkin sem mælingin ber saman, tölfræðin sem hver hlutur er dreginn saman með, og hvort bakgrunnur er dreginn frá fyrst. Ef tveimur rásum er víxlað hér snýst niðurstaðan við án þess að villa komi upp.

records.key: Which feature the heatmap shows, how wells are grouped, and the colour map and value range used to draw it. Presentation of the classifier's output; it does not change the fit.
records.source: Which feature the heatmap shows, how wells are grouped, and the colour map and value range used to draw it. Presentation of the classifier's output; it does not change the fit.
records.translation: Hvaða eiginleika hitakortið sýnir, hvernig brunnar eru flokkaðir, og litakortið og gildisbilið sem notað er til að teikna það. Framsetning á úttaki flokkarans; hún breytir ekki aðfellingunni.

records.key: Which intensity channel holds each compartment, and which one the recruitment is measured on. These are indices into the merged stack, so a wrong one measures the wrong compartment without complaining.
records.source: Which intensity channel holds each compartment, and which one the recruitment is measured on. These are indices into the merged stack, so a wrong one measures the wrong compartment without complaining.
records.translation: Hvaða styrkleikarás geymir hvert hólf og á hvaða rás nýliðunin er mæld. Þetta eru vísar inn í sameinaða staflann, svo rangur vísir mælir rangt hólf án þess að kvarta.

records.key: Which plates the classifier is built from, the experiment it is filed under, and which stages run — build the training set, train, test. Uncheck the stages you have already done to re-run only the part you are iterating on.
records.source: Which plates the classifier is built from, the experiment it is filed under, and which stages run — build the training set, train, test. Uncheck the stages you have already done to re-run only the part you are iterating on.
records.translation: Úr hvaða plötum flokkarinn er byggður, tilraunin sem hann er skráður undir og hvaða þrep keyra — byggja þjálfunarsafnið, þjálfa, prófa. Taktu hakið af þrepunum sem þú hefur þegar lokið til að keyra aftur aðeins þann hluta sem þú ert að ítra á.

records.key: Which rows reach the model, and what they are measured against. The plate identifier, the positive and negative control wells, any row filter — and every cutoff that drops data: minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. The controls set the scale the effect sizes are reported on; each cutoff silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing one.
records.source: Which rows reach the model, and what they are measured against. The plate identifier, the positive and negative control wells, any row filter — and every cutoff that drops data: minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. The controls set the scale the effect sizes are reported on; each cutoff silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing one.
records.translation: Hvaða raðir ná til líkansins og við hvað þær eru mældar. Plötuauðkennið, jákvæðu og neikvæðu viðmiðunarbrunnarnir, raðasía — og öll mörk sem fella út gögn: lágmarksfjöldi frumna á brunn, lágmarksfjöldi athugana á leiðsögu-RNA, lágmark lestrarhlutfalls og fjarlæging útlaga. Viðmiðin ákvarða kvarðann sem áhrifastærðir eru birtar á; hver mörk minnka gagnasafnið án viðvörunar, svo skoðaðu greiningarupplýsingarnar eftir að hafa breytt einhverjum þeirra.

records.key: Which segmented objects survive into the measurement table: the minimum size per compartment, whether uninfected cells are kept, and whether a pathogen straddling two cells merges them. Change them when debris is being measured, or when real cells vanish.
records.source: Which segmented objects survive into the measurement table: the minimum size per compartment, whether uninfected cells are kept, and whether a pathogen straddling two cells merges them. Change them when debris is being measured, or when real cells vanish.
records.translation: Hvaða hlutuðu hlutir komast inn í mælingatöfluna: lágmarksstærð á hvert hólf, hvort ósýktum frumum er haldið, og hvort sýkill sem liggur yfir tvær frumur sameinar þær. Breyttu þessu þegar rusl er mælt eða þegar raunverulegar frumur hverfa.

records.key: Which source channel is drawn in each colour slot. This is a VIEW setting and changes nothing on disk and nothing measured — it does not say how the file was written, which is the row above. Use it when a project authored before the crop-format fix should be seen in the colours it was authored for: B G R restores that picture without marking the folder as a format it is not.
records.source: Which source channel is drawn in each colour slot. This is a VIEW setting and changes nothing on disk and nothing measured — it does not say how the file was written, which is the row above. Use it when a project authored before the crop-format fix should be seen in the colours it was authored for: B G R restores that picture without marking the folder as a format it is not.
records.translation: Hvaða upprunarás er teiknuð í hverri litarauf. Þetta er SÝNARSTILLING og breytir engu á diski og engu sem er mælt — hún segir ekki hvernig skráin var skrifuð, það er röðin hér að ofan. Notaðu hana þegar verkefni sem var búið til fyrir leiðréttingu myndskurðarsniðsins á að sjást í litunum sem það var gert fyrir: B G R endurheimtir þá mynd án þess að merkja möppuna með sniði sem hún hefur ekki.

records.key: Which stages run, whether this is a small test pass, and how the run behaves under load and failure — workers, batch size, tolerated failure rate and verbosity. Track a few fields in test mode before committing to a whole plate.
records.source: Which stages run, whether this is a small test pass, and how the run behaves under load and failure — workers, batch size, tolerated failure rate and verbosity. Track a few fields in test mode before committing to a whole plate.
records.translation: Hvaða þrep keyra, hvort þetta er lítil prófunarumferð, og hvernig keyrslan hegðar sér undir álagi og við bilanir — vinnsluferli, lotustærð, leyfilegt bilanahlutfall og magn úttaks. Rektu nokkur sjónsvið í prófunarham áður en þú leggur í heila plötu.

records.key: Which weights do the segmenting — a packaged model, or a checkpoint of your own — and the object size they should expect. Nothing is trained here; this is the picker, and the expected size matters more than the choice of weights.
records.source: Which weights do the segmenting — a packaged model, or a checkpoint of your own — and the object size they should expect. Nothing is trained here; this is the picker, and the expected size matters more than the choice of weights.
records.translation: Hvaða vægi sjá um hlutunina — innbyggt líkan eða eigin vistunarpunktur — og hlutastærðin sem þau eiga að búast við. Ekkert er þjálfað hér; þetta er valtólið, og væntanleg stærð skiptir meira máli en val vægjanna.

records.key: Which wells anchor the threshold, and how many objects a well or a plate must contribute before its number is believed. Raise the minimums when sparse wells produce implausibly extreme rates.
records.source: Which wells anchor the threshold, and how many objects a well or a plate must contribute before its number is believed. Raise the minimums when sparse wells produce implausibly extreme rates.
records.translation: Hvaða brunnar festa þröskuldinn og hversu marga hluti brunnur eða plata þarf að leggja til áður en talan er tekin trúanleg. Hækkaðu lágmörkin þegar strjálir brunnar gefa ótrúlega öfgakennd hlutföll.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the conditions are grouped and reported at.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the conditions are grouped and reported at.
records.translation: Hvaða brunnar innihalda hvaða frumulínu, stofn og meðferð, og dálkurinn og stigið sem skilyrðin eru flokkuð og birt á.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the invasion rates are grouped and reported at.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the invasion rates are grouped and reported at.
records.translation: Hvaða brunnar innihalda hvaða frumulínu, stofn og meðferð, og dálkurinn og stigið sem innrásarhlutföllin eru flokkuð og birt á.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and which channel the recruitment is measured on. Filled in once per plate design.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and which channel the recruitment is measured on. Filled in once per plate design.
records.translation: Hvaða brunnar innihalda hvaða frumulínu, stofn og meðferð, og á hvaða rás nýliðunin er mæld. Fyllt út einu sinni fyrir hverja plötuhönnun.

records.key: With one facet channel in use, lay the levels out this many panels wide instead of in one long strip. Ignored when both facet channels are in use.
records.source: With one facet channel in use, lay the levels out this many panels wide instead of in one long strip. Ignored when both facet channels are in use.
records.translation: Þegar ein flötunarrás (facet) er í notkun eru stigin lögð út með þessum fjölda spjalda á breidd í stað einnar langrar ræmu. Hunsað þegar báðar flötunarrásirnar eru í notkun.

records.key: Write a suggestion onto every crop with no answer yet, most confident first. Nothing you have already annotated is touched.
records.source: Write a suggestion onto every crop with no answer yet, most confident first. Nothing you have already annotated is touched.
records.translation: Skrifaðu tillögu á hvern myndskurð sem hefur ekki enn svar, öruggustu fyrst. Engu sem þú hefur þegar merkt er breytt.

records.key: Write every gate to the database as a column of the `filters` table — the gate's name, 1 inside and 0 outside. The gate is applied to EVERY object, whatever fraction of the table is loaded, so a gate drawn on a sample still labels everything.
records.source: Write every gate to the database as a column of the `filters` table — the gate's name, 1 inside and 0 outside. The gate is applied to EVERY object, whatever fraction of the table is loaded, so a gate drawn on a sample still labels everything.
records.translation: Skrifaðu öll valmörk í gagnagrunninn sem dálk í `filters`-töflunni — heiti valmarkanna, 1 innan og 0 utan. Valmörkunum er beitt á HVERN hlut, óháð því hve stór hluti töflunnar er hlaðinn, svo valmörk sem teiknuð eru á úrtaki merkja samt allt.

records.key: Write selected cells, hold-out cells, predictions, and the run report as separate files.
records.source: Write selected cells, hold-out cells, predictions, and the run report as separate files.
records.translation: Skrifaðu valdar frumur, frumur sem haldið er til hliðar, spár og keyrsluskýrsluna sem aðskildar skrár.

records.key: Write the annotation selection into…
records.source: Write the annotation selection into…
records.translation: Skrifa merkingarvalið í…

records.key: Write the corrected labels back to the mask file, with the correction ledger beside them
records.source: Write the corrected labels back to the mask file, with the correction ledger beside them
records.translation: Skrifa leiðréttu merkin aftur í grímuskrána, með leiðréttingaskránni við hlið þeirra

records.key: Write the current filter set to a file, so the same rows can be selected again on another plate.
records.source: Write the current filter set to a file, so the same rows can be selected again on another plate.
records.translation: Skrifa núverandi síusafn í skrá, svo hægt sé að velja sömu raðir aftur á annarri plötu.

records.key: Write the displayed gates to one annotation column. Binary mode marks objects inside all gates; multi-class mode assigns a separate class to each observed gate combination.
records.source: Write the displayed gates to one annotation column. Binary mode marks objects inside all gates; multi-class mode assigns a separate class to each observed gate combination.
records.translation: Skrifaðu birtu valmörkin í einn merkingardálk. Tvíkostahamur merkir hluti innan allra valmarka; fjölflokkahamur úthlutar sérstökum flokki fyrir hverja samsetningu valmarka sem kemur fyrir.

records.key: Write the figure, the plotted data, the statistics, the settings, and the cell images into one folder.
records.source: Write the figure, the plotted data, the statistics, the settings, and the cell images into one folder.
records.translation: Skrifaðu myndina, teiknuðu gögnin, tölfræðina, stillingarnar og frumumyndirnar í eina möppu.

records.key: Write the gating strategy to a file. It re-applies to any table carrying the same measurements — which is the whole difference between a gate and a lasso.
records.source: Write the gating strategy to a file. It re-applies to any table carrying the same measurements — which is the whole difference between a gate and a lasso.
records.translation: Skrifaðu valmarkaáætlunina í skrá. Henni má beita aftur á hvaða töflu sem hefur sömu mælingar — og það er allur munurinn á valmörkum og lassói.

records.key: Write the graph as it appears, including the gates drawn on it. The format follows the figure format in Preferences — PNG at the resolution set there, or a real vector PDF whose text stays selectable and editable — and you can override it for one save in the file dialog.
records.source: Write the graph as it appears, including the gates drawn on it. The format follows the figure format in Preferences — PNG at the resolution set there, or a real vector PDF whose text stays selectable and editable — and you can override it for one save in the file dialog.
records.translation: Skrifa grafið eins og það birtist, þar á meðal valmörkin sem teiknuð eru á það. Sniðið fylgir myndasniðinu í Preferences — PNG í upplausninni sem stillt er þar, eða raunverulegt vigur-PDF þar sem texti er áfram veljanlegur og breytanlegur — og þú getur breytt því fyrir eina vistun í skráarglugganum.

records.key: Write the plate map into
records.source: Write the plate map into
records.translation: Skrifa plötukortið í

records.key: Write the whole table with the flag columns added, the flagged rows on their own, and the per-well summary
records.source: Write the whole table with the flag columns added, the flagged rows on their own, and the per-well summary
records.translation: Skrifa alla töfluna með flaggdálkunum bættum við, flögguðu raðirnar sér, og samantekt á hvern brunn

records.key: X-bar / S — sigma = S-bar / c4(n), per plate over sqrt(n)
records.source: X-bar / S — sigma = S-bar / c4(n), per plate over sqrt(n)
records.translation: X-bar / S — sigma = S-bar / c4(n), á plötu deilt með sqrt(n)

records.translation: [example] merkingardæmið var ekki sótt: {detail}

records.translation: [screen] ekki sótt: {detail}

records.key: a box gate needs three measurements on screen; choose a Z
records.source: a box gate needs three measurements on screen; choose a Z
records.translation: kassavalmörk þurfa þrjár mælingar á skjánum; veldu Z

records.key: a spike — one plate that was not like the others
records.source: a spike — one plate that was not like the others
records.translation: toppur — ein plata sem var ekki eins og hinar

records.key: a trend — something degrading plate after plate
records.source: a trend — something degrading plate after plate
records.translation: leitni — eitthvað sem versnar plötu eftir plötu

records.key: as the run saved them
records.source: as the run saved them
records.translation: eins og keyrslan vistaði þær

records.key: both -- the two fits below, run SEPARATELY
records.source: both -- the two fits below, run SEPARATELY
records.translation: both -- aðfellingarnar tvær hér fyrir neðan, keyrðar AÐSKILIÐ

records.key: channels to outline, e.g. g
records.source: channels to outline, e.g. g

records.key: gene id {gene!r} is not shaped like a Toxoplasma accession, so no ToxoDB record is offered for it. If this is a screen of another organism, spaCR has no annotation for it.
records.source: gene id {gene!r} is not shaped like a Toxoplasma accession, so no ToxoDB record is offered for it. If this is a screen of another organism, spaCR has no annotation for it.
records.translation: gen-auðkennið {gene!r} er ekki á formi Toxoplasma-aðgangsnúmers, svo engin ToxoDB-færsla er boðin fyrir það. Ef þetta er skimun á annarri lífveru hefur spaCR engar merkingar fyrir hana.

records.key: grid evaluates every combination; random samples n trials from the space with the seed below, which is reproducible.
records.source: grid evaluates every combination; random samples n trials from the space with the seed below, which is reproducible.
records.translation: grid metur allar samsetningar; random tekur n tilraunir af handahófi úr rýminu með slembifræinu hér að neðan, sem er endurtakanlegt.

records.key: guide {identifier} is a non-targeting control, not a gene. It has no gene record and no ToxoDB entry; it is in the fit so the screen has a null to measure the real guides against.
records.source: guide {identifier} is a non-targeting control, not a gene. It has no gene record and no ToxoDB entry; it is in the fit so the screen has a null to measure the real guides against.
records.translation: leiðsögu-RNA {identifier} er óbeint viðmið (non-targeting), ekki gen. Það hefur enga genafærslu og enga ToxoDB-færslu; það er í aðfellingunni svo skimunin hafi núllviðmið til að mæla raunveruleg leiðsögu-RNA á móti.

records.key: hinge — parametric: a linear boundary between a positive and a negative class: the response is thresholded, so the question is which class a well is in, not by how much
records.source: hinge — parametric: a linear boundary between a positive and a negative class: the response is thresholded, so the question is which class a well is in, not by how much
records.translation: hinge — stikað: línuleg mörk milli jákvæðs og neikvæðs flokks: svörunin er þröskulduð, svo spurningin er í hvaða flokki brunnur er, ekki hve mikið

records.key: huber — robust/semiparametric: squared loss near the centre and linear in the tails, so a handful of bright wells cannot set a coefficient
records.source: huber — robust/semiparametric: squared loss near the centre and linear in the tails, so a handful of bright wells cannot set a coefficient
records.translation: huber — traust/hálfstikað: ferningstap nálægt miðju og línulegt í hölunum, svo fáeinir bjartir brunnar geta ekki ráðið stuðli

records.key: keep uninfected cells
records.source: keep uninfected cells
records.translation: halda ósýktum frumum

records.key: logit — parametric: a fraction as a binomial proportion, log-odds linear in the guides, weighted by the cells behind the well
records.source: logit — parametric: a fraction as a binomial proportion, log-odds linear in the guides, weighted by the cells behind the well
records.translation: logit — stikað: hlutfall sem tvíkosta hlutfall, log-odds línulegt í leiðsögu-RNA, vegið með frumunum að baki brunninum

records.key: ols — parametric: least squares: normal errors of constant variance, every well equal
records.source: ols — parametric: least squares: normal errors of constant variance, every well equal
records.translation: ols — stikað: minnstu kvaðröt: normaldreifðar villur með fasta dreifni, allir brunnar jafnir

records.key: only cells that have the child object
records.source: only cells that have the child object
records.translation: aðeins frumur sem hafa undirhlutinn

records.key: poisson — parametric: counts, variance equal to the mean, log cell count as exposure so the effect is on a per-cell rate
records.source: poisson — parametric: counts, variance equal to the mean, log cell count as exposure so the effect is on a per-cell rate
records.translation: poisson — stikað: talningar, dreifni jöfn meðaltali, log af frumufjölda sem útsetning svo áhrifin eru á hlutfall á hverja frumu

records.key: rlm — robust/semiparametric: a linear model fitted by an M-estimator, so extreme wells are downweighted rather than assumed absent
records.source: rlm — robust/semiparametric: a linear model fitted by an M-estimator, so extreme wells are downweighted rather than assumed absent
records.translation: rlm — traust/hálfstikað: línulegt líkan aðfellt með M-metli, svo öfgakenndir brunnar fá minna vægi frekar en að gert sé ráð fyrir að þeir séu ekki til

records.key: rra — rank-based: only the ORDER of the wells, so no distribution at all; its p value is a permutation p value over guide ranks
records.source: rra — rank-based: only the ORDER of the wells, so no distribution at all; its p value is a permutation p value over guide ranks
records.translation: rra — byggt á röðun: aðeins RÖÐ brunnanna, svo engin dreifing yfirleitt; p-gildi þess er umröðunar-p-gildi yfir röðun leiðsögu-RNA

records.key: spaCR defaults active — one row per {base}. Children are aggregated before joining; unmatched measurements stay missing. Nucleus uses an inner join; pathogen/organelle retain uninfected cells by default.
records.source: spaCR defaults active — one row per {base}. Children are aggregated before joining; unmatched measurements stay missing. Nucleus uses an inner join; pathogen/organelle retain uninfected cells by default.
records.translation: Sjálfgildi spaCR virk — ein röð á hvert {base}. Undirhlutir eru dregnir saman fyrir tengingu; mælingar sem passa ekki saman haldast tómar. Nucleus notar innri tengingu; pathogen/organelle halda sjálfgefið ósýktum frumum.

records.key: the other {count} control guides are listed with it: they are the null this screen measures every real guide against.
records.source: the other {count} control guides are listed with it: they are the null this screen measures every real guide against.
records.translation: hin {count} viðmiðsleiðsögu-RNA eru talin upp með því: þau eru núllviðmiðið sem þessi skimun mælir hvert raunverulegt leiðsögu-RNA á móti.

records.key: anndata_export
records.source: Write the measured objects out as an AnnData object for single-cell analysis downstream
records.translation: Skrifa mældu hlutina út sem AnnData-hlut fyrir einfrumugreiningu í kjölfarið

records.key: embeddings
records.source: Encode every object with a self-supervised model and keep the channel each dimension came from
records.translation: Kóða hvern hlut með sjálfstýrðu líkani og halda utan um rásina sem hver vídd kom frá

records.key: gate_editor
records.source: Define threshold and polygon gates as reusable data filters
records.translation: Skilgreina þröskulds- og marghyrningsvalmörk sem endurnýtanlegar gagnasíur

records.key: illumination
records.source: Estimate the flat-field from the plate itself and divide it out of the pixels at every enabled stage
records.translation: Meta flatsviðið (flat-field) út frá plötunni sjálfri og deila því út úr pixlunum á hverju virku stigi

records.key: image_scatter
records.source: Hover a point to see the cell; click it to open the crop
records.translation: Færðu bendilinn yfir punkt til að sjá frumuna; smelltu á hann til að opna myndskurðinn

records.key: investigate_hit
records.source: Link a regression hit to cross-fitted candidate cells and well-level quantitative evidence
records.translation: Tengja jákvæða niðurstöðu aðhvarfs við víxlaðfelldar kandídatsfrumur og megindleg gögn á brunnsstigi

records.key: lineage
records.source: Inspect cell-containment relationships for nuclei, pathogens, and organelles
records.translation: Skoða innihaldstengsl frumna fyrir kjarna, sýkla og frumulíffæri

records.key: methods_export
records.source: Draft the methods and results sections from the run, with every number traced
records.translation: Semja drög að aðferða- og niðurstöðuköflum út frá keyrslunni, þar sem hver tala er rekjanleg

records.key: napari_bridge
records.source: Correct a segmentation mask in napari and import the revised labels into spaCR.
records.translation: Leiðréttu hlutunargrímu í napari og fluttu endurskoðuðu merkin inn í spaCR.

records.key: outliers
records.source: Detect robust univariate and multivariate outliers at object and well levels
records.translation: Greina trausta einbreytu- og fjölbreytuútlaga á hluta- og brunnsstigi

records.key: power
records.source: Estimate the cells and wells required to detect a specified effect size
records.translation: Áætla fjölda frumna og brunna sem þarf til að greina tiltekna áhrifastærð

records.key: qc_dashboard
records.source: Review stored checks for segmentation, units, leakage, plate effects, and annotation agreement
records.translation: Yfirfara vistaðar athuganir á hlutun, einingum, leka, plötuáhrifum og samræmi merkinga
